, v. בָּאיָין
Pl. בָּאגָנֵי. B. Kam. 61 b top, Ms. M. נָאגָנֵי q. v.

sense.definition: (cmp. בְּקִיעַ I, a. בקע Josh. IX, 4) broken or burst water-vessel.
sense.notes: —Pl. as above. Ber. 58 a באגני גליא Ms. M. (read לְיֵא, v. יֵא I; ed. כגני, read בָּגָגֵי; Ms. F. כאגני דשיג' ניגני, read: ב' ויש ג(ורסין) נ', v. נָאגָנֵי) whither do the broken vessels go? (i.e. what has the blind man to do here?).

sense.definition: Badan, a Samaritan place noted for its pomegranats.
sense.notes: Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VI, 10 בא'; Kel. XVII, 5 בדאן. Orl. III, 7; Bets. 3 b
, Targ. Prov. XXIV, 12 read באקי, v. בְּקָא.

sense.definition: [ sour,] an inferior kind of grapes, unripe grapes.
sense.notes: Y. Maasr. I, 48 d משיקראו באי' (corr. acc.) when they are called b’ushah; v. בָּאַשׁ 4).— Pl. בְּאוּשִׁין. Maasr. I, 2 Y. ed., v. אוּבְשִׁין.
Ḥull. 63 a בא' שבעופות (Ar. בואת) the bavath among the birds.

sense.definition: groper in the dark, mole or salamander (for תנשמת Lev. XI, 30).
sense.notes: Ib. ב' שבשרצים the bavath among the reptiles. [Targ. O. for 1): בָּוְתָא; for 2): אָשׁוּתָא q. v.; v. also סַלְמַנְדְּרָא.—Var. in Targ. O. to Lev. XI, 18 בבתא, בּוֹתָא, כַּוְתָא, כּוֹסָא, v. Berl. Targ. O. II, p. 34.]
, v. בְּזָא II
, v. next w.

sense.definition: (Pers. bâzyâran, Fl., R. Hai Gaon) falconers.
sense.notes: Sabb. 94 a דב' (סוסא) Ar. (some ed. ד for ר; ed. בי וייאדן, Ms. בי זירין, בי זייארין, corr. acc.) the falconers’ horse (used for carrying falcons, hawks &c. on his back).
— Pl. בָּאטֵי, בָּטֵי. Ab. Zar. 39 a דהוה קרי ליה בא' ed. (Ar. בטי) that he (the Gentile) called the brine baté
Gitt. 11 a as an un-Jewish name, v. בָּהַק. Ab. Zar. 76 b; Kidd. 70 b (בטי) B. bar Tobi, name of a freedman.
, Yalk. Ps. 662 פת קלא ב', read אַקּוּבִּיטוֹן.

sense.definition: (βάϊον-βάϊς, a Coptic word; denomin. βάϊνος; cmp. I Macc. XIII, 5

sense.notes: Lev. R. s. 30; Pesik. Ul’kaḥ. p. 180 a באגין (read באינון βάϊνον); Tanḥ. Emor 18 אגין (corr. acc.; ed. Bub. 27 אגוז [!]); Yalk. Lev. 651.—Midr. Till. to Ps. XVII ובא; Yalk. Ps. 670 בימין (corr. acc.); v. אַפּוֹפְסִין.

sense.definition: (= בי אימה) pr. n. pl. B’Imah or Imah.
sense.notes: Y. Orl. end, 63 b; Tosef. Kil. II, 16 אומה ed. Zuck. (oth. ed. אימא); v. next w.

sense.definition: (= בי אינה) pr. n. pl. B’Inah a. B’Imah (v. preced.), two gentile conclaves in Northern Palestine.
sense.notes: Y. Orl. end, 63 b. Tosef. Kil. II, 16 בַּת עֲנָה (Var. בֵּית); cmp. בית ענות, בית ענת Josh. XV, 59; XIX, 38.
, v. בְּאֵר
Targ. Gen. XXI, 11; a. fr.—Y. Sabb. VIII, 11 a bot. ובְאֵשׁ לר' וכ' it displeased R. … Y. Ber. III, 6 a bot.; VII, 11 c top; a. fr.
Ned. 40 a top.

sense.definition: (with לבא, עינא, or נפשא) to be displeased, angry, troubled.
sense.notes: Targ. Deut. XV, 9; 10 (some ed. יַבְאֵשׁ Af.). Targ. I. Sam. I, 8; a. e.—Lam. R., introd., end נפשך בְּאִישָׁא עלך thou art discontented.

sense.definition: to make bad; to do evil; to harm one (with ל or ב of the person).
sense.notes: Targ. I Sam. XII, 25. Targ. Is. XIV, 20; a. fr.—Targ. Gen. XIX, 9. Ib. Y. XVI, 12; a. fr.

Ber. 22 ab ב' הוה בקילעא וכ' Ar. (vers. quot. in marg. note to Ber. l. c. ב' הות f.) (ed. באושא הוה עובדא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) there was a patient in the anteroom of &c. Sabb. 30 a מקמי ב' for the sake of a patient. Cmp. בִּישׁ.
, v. בְּאוּשָׁה
f., v. בִּישׁוּ
part. of בִּית.

sense.definition: (= h. בּוּל, cmp. יְבוּל) growth (of grass); whence prairie, pasture ground (in mountains &c.; cmp. Job. XL, 20 expl. in Lev. R. s. 22).
sense.notes: —Ḥull. 80 a עזי דב' wild goats. V. תּוּרְבָּלָא.
, v. בַּלְשָׁא

sense.definition: (part. of בלי, contr. of בהל, cmp. b. h. בַּלָּהוּת)
hurrying: Nidd. 26 b ב' ואתי he came in a hurry.
sense.notes: he came in a hurry.
17 a ב' דידבי (Tosaf. בָּלֵי) chased the flies off. [Var. כאלי, v. כלי.]
Ber. 25 b; Taan. 18 a. Sabb. 17 b; Ab. Zar. 36 b. Cmp. וָולִיס.
(Mus. a. Maar.), Cant. R. to III, 4, read: פורני פלייאה קקוסכימי πόρνη παλαιὰ κακόσχημε, thou ungainly old harlot, מהו את וכ' (not מחי) what thinkest thou of thyself? Cmp. פֹּורְנִי.

sense.definition: , read בַּארְגְּטוֹן m. (farctum) the stuffing of sausage.
sense.notes: Y. Sabb. VII, 10 a bot. כד משקע ב' when he puts the stuffing in (on the Sabbath); v. בגומא.
, v. בַּנִּי
, v. בַּנָּאָה
part. of בְּצָא.

sense.definition: to break forth, come to light.
sense.notes: Denom. בְּאֵר; cmp. טוּף.

—Pi. בֵּאֵר (b. h.) to proclaim (cmp. Deut. I, 5), to explain; to make clear ( to one’s self), to understand clearly. Y. M. Kat. III, 83 b top לבָאֵר משנתו to explain (argue on) what he has learned. Koh. R. to VI, 9 better is he שהוא מְבָאֵר משנתו וכ' who dwells on his studies to make them clear to himself, than he who learns to recite fluently.—Part. pass. מְבֹאָר proven, clear. Yed. III, 1 מ' הדבר (Talm. ed. מ' את הד') from this fact it is proven.
בָּאֵר same. Y. M. Kat. III, 83 b top לא חכמין מְבָאֲרָה know not how to make clear (argue).

Gen. R. s. 93; a. fr.—Erub. X, 14 (104 ab), v. הָקֵר. Taan. 9 a ב' בזכות מרים the well in the desert was given to the Israelites for Miriam’s sake; a. fr.—Transf. origin. Y. Sot. II, 18 a (play on בוראיך, Koh. XII,

sense.definition: remember בְּאֵירְךָ וכ' thy well (whence thou camest), thy pit (grave), thy Creator; Lev. R. s. 18, beg.— Pl. בְּאֵרוֹת.
sense.notes: Y. Erub. II, beg. 20 a ב' הקר, v. הָקֵר. V. בּוֹר II.
Targ. Cant. I, 1; v. בֵּירָא

sense.definition: (dial. for בַּרְקָא, v. ברק a. deriv.; cmp. בָּאגָא a. בִּקְעָא) sparkling, effervescent; white-shining.
sense.notes: Ab. Zar. 30 a מתוק חמר ב' Ar. (ed. מי ב') by ‘sweet wine’ we understand effervescent wine (liquid) ( mulsum vinum or mulsa aqua, v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Vinum).—Snh. 98 a סוסיא ב' quot. in Rashi to Ab. Zar. l. c., Ar. s. v. ברקא (ed. ברקא) a white-shining horse. [Deriv. fr. Pers. bârah is refuted by ברקא being used as an equivalent of our w.; v. also Fl. to Levy Talm. Dict. I, 284 a.]
ident. with בֵּירַי in Galilee. Pesik. R. s. 28; Midr. Till. to Ps. CXXXVII; Yalk. a. l.
בֵּי ב' in Babylon, v. בֵּירַאי

sense.definition: , v. בּוֹא) to be disordered, bad (cmp. רַע).
to cause decay, to make smell badly.
sense.notes: . Ex. R. s. 26; a. e.

sense.definition: (with דברים, or sub. דברים) to use insulting language.
sense.notes: . Koh. R. to X, 1.

Ter. X, 2 אע"פ שה' מימיו מותרין Ms. M. (ed. מימיו מימיו corr. acc.) though the barley has begun to ferment &c. Cant. R. to I, 2 b המים מַבְאִישִׁים liquids grow stale. Pesik. B’shall. p. 81 b דג מב' ill-smelling fish.

sense.definition: (v. בְּאוּשָׁה) [ to begin to ferment, to boil,] to be in the early stage of ripening, to be b’ushah.
sense.notes: Maasr. I, 2 grapes are subject to the law of tithes משהִבְ' from the time they would be called b’ushah, cmp. Y. ib. 48 d. Shebi. IV, 8. Tosef. Maasr. I, 1.
, v. בָּתַר

sense.definition: (reduplic. of בא, v. בּוֹא; cmp. b. h. בִּאָה a. מָבוֹא) entrance, door, gate.
sense.notes: Targ. Esth. V, 14.—Sabb. 32 a, v. חוּטְרָא a. בִּזְיוּנָא I. Ib. 156 b קרי אכ' called at the door (begging). Erub. 11 b; a. fr.— Pl. בָּבֵי. Ber. 58 b; a. fr. Men. 34 a בָּאבֵי.—Trnsf. (of writings) section, clause. ב' דרישא the clause of the first proposition. Sabb. 3 a top; a. fr.—Hence ב' קמא (abbr. ב"ק), (ב"מ) ב' מציעא, (ב"ב) ב' בתרא Baba Kamma, Baba Metsia, Baba Bathra (first, middle, last section), names of three Talmudic treatises of the order of N’zikin (civil law); v. נֶזֶק. [Tosefta Kelim is likewise divided into three Babas with the same names.].— Pl. as above. R. Hash. 33 b תקיעה דכולי ב' the tune T’kiah in all the three sections.

sense.definition: Bab Nahãra (Gate of the River) name of a tributary or a canal of the Euphrates.
sense.notes: Ab. Zar. 39 a דב' נ' (Ms. M. דנהרא); Succ. 18 a (Ms. M. 1 דבנהרא, 2 דפום נהרא, cmp. Yeb. 16 b sq.).
, v. בָּב I a. בָּבִיתָא.

sense.definition: Baba (ben Buta), a disciple of Shammai, blinded by Herod.
sense.notes: B. Bath. 3 b. Kerith. VI, 3. (Cmp. Jos. Ant. XV, 7, 10.)
f. (b. h.), only in בָּבַת עין the pupil of the eye. Ex. R. s. 30 ב' ע' העליונה (some ed. בת; corr. acc.) the Lord’s &c. V. בָּבִיתָא I

sense.definition: hatred (only in Targ. Y., = דְּבָבוּ; ד rejected through false analogy, v. דְּבָבָא).
sense.notes: Targ. Y. Gen. XXV, 11; a. e.

sense.definition: (in Babli), בּוּבְיָא, בּוּבְיָה (in Y.) f. (onomatop., v. Fl. to Levy Chald. Dict. I, 419 a. Fried. Del. Assyr. Stud. I, 142; v., however, בָּבִיתָא) reflected image in metal, water &c.; image, shadow.
sense.notes: Ned. 9 b ונסתכלתי בבב' שלי (Ar. with two ב, corr. acc.) and I was looking at my image (in the water); Tosef. Naz. IV, 7 (Var. בוביא); Y. Ned. I, 36 d bot. בובייה; Num. R. s. 10 בוביא. Yeb. 122 a ב' דב' a shadow of a shadow. Ab. Zar. 47 a לב' קא סגיד he worships the image (in the water). Gen. R. s. 4 ב' גדולה magnified image. Treat. Sof’rim. III, 8 ב' שלו the outlines of an effaced letter.

sense.definition: (v. preced.) prop. mirror, hence (from its shape) a musical instrument, a little drum, tympanum (used at orgies, v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Tympanum).
sense.notes: Y. Taan. I, 64 b bot.
, v. בֵּיבַי

sense.definition: (cmp. בָּב a. בַּיִת) = h. בָּבָה, [ the innermost,] with עֵינָא, pupil of the eye.
sense.notes: Targ. O. Deut. XXXII, 10 בָּבַת ע' (plur.) the pupils of their (the Israelites’) eyes; [Targ. Y. בבא דעיוניה Ar. (ed. בָּבֵי) the innermost or the gates of His thought, v. בָּב I]. Targ. Prov. VII, 2 בבתא (Ms. בבייתא). Targ. Koh. XII, 2 בבי עינך (some ed. בני, גבי, corr. acc.). Gitt. 69 a בביתא.
Ḥull. 85 b על ב' דמיא Ar. (ed. בו') over the outlet (wherein the flax is put); v. יָנִיבָא.

sense.definition: (fr. בָּבָא or fr. בית) gate (or lodging) money, contribution for the support of traveling poor.
sense.notes: Y. Dem. III, beg. 23 b

sense.definition: (b. h.) pr. n. Babel, the city of Babylon; Babylonia, a country of varying limits, chiefly comprising Mesopotamia, a portion of Great Armenia and some neighbouring countries east of the Tigris (v. Neub. Géogr. p. 320).
sense.notes: [Owing to the continued political disturbances in Palestine, Babylonia gradually became the centre of Jewish scholarship; hence both the frequent comparisons and jealousies between the East and the West (Babyl. a. Palest.); cmp. אֶרֶץ, חֲנַנְיָה, תַּלְמוּד. Kidd. 69 b; 71 b. Sot. 49 b. Y. Snh. I, 19 a; Y. Ned. VI, 40 a bot. כי מב' תצא וכ' (sarcastic imitation of Is. II, 3). Snh. 24 a תלמודה של ב' Babylonian method (Talmud). עולי ב' those coming from Bab. to visit the Temple, pilgrims. Ned. V, 4 דבר של ע' ב' that in which pilgrims from Bab. (i.e. Jews living abroad) have a share, as the Temple Mount &c. [Macc. 24 a, a. e. המונה של ב', read רומי as Ms. M.; cmp. אֲרָמִי.]

Targ. Josh. VII, 21 (some ed. בַּבְלִי).—Sabb. 105 b ב' O, thou Babylonian! B. Mets. 85 a גמרא ב' (Ms. M. תלמודיה דבבל) the method he had learned in Babylonia; cmp. preced.—Y. Sabb. VI, 8 a bot.; a. fr.— Pl. בַּבְלָאֵי. Targ. Ps. CXXXVII, 3. Ḥull. 45 a חברין ב' our Babyl. colleagues. Keth. 75 a, a. fr. ב' טפשאי foolish Babylonians.—Fem. בַּבְלִיתָא. Targ. l. c. v. 8.— Pl. בַּבְלָיָתָא, בַּבְלָיָיתָא. Targ. II Esth. I, 10.—Sabb. 81 a
Cant. R. to I, 6 (a legend about the origin of Rome) and they called it רומי ב' Rome-Babylon.

Pes. 66 a הילל הב' Hillel the Babylonian; a. fr.— Pl. בַּבְלִיִּים, בַּבְלִיִּין. Yoma 66 b; Men. 100 a. Cant. R. to VIII, 9; Lam. R. to I, 13 ספסלין מלאין ב' וכ' students’ seats in Palestine occupied by Babylonians; [for מונחי Lam. R. l. c. prob. to be read מומחין].
, v. בַּבְלָאָה
Yalk. Josh. 18 פורפירא ב'; (Gen. R. s. 85 בבליא).
, v. בַּבְלָאָה
, v. בָּעוּ
, v. בָּבִיתָא I
, v. בָּאוָת
B. Kam. 27 b; a. fr. Kidd. 10 b Joh. son of B. B.
, v. בָּאגָא

sense.definition: v. infra) to act violently, to rebel, be faithless.
sense.notes: Snh. 37 a (allud. to Gen. XXVII, 27) א"ת בְּגָדָיו אלא בּוֹגְדָיו do not read b’gadav (his garments), but bog’dav (his faithless ones). Y. Peah I, 16 b top; Num. R. s. 10, beg.; Cant. R. to V, 16, v. בְּגִידָה.—Mekh. Mishp., N’zikin 3 מאחר שב' בה וכ' (b’bigdo bah, Ex. XXI, 8) since he &c., treated her contemptuously (opp. to the interpretation of בגדו as his garment, שפירש בגדו עליה he spread his bed-cloth over her). [From Targ. renderings as well as from Agadic interpretations it appears that the primitive meaning of בגד (√בג) is, to tear; also to despise, corresp. to the meanings of √בז; v. Targ. Job VI, 5; Is. XXXIII, 1; Prov. XXI, 18; Snh. 94 a, cit. s. v. בזוזא; Esth. R. to I, 10, cit. s. v. בּוּז; Mekh. l. c.; cmp. also K’thib בג for K’ri בַּז Ezek. XXV, 7.—בֶּגֶד seems to be a piece, web, corresp. in meaning and use to φᾶρος.]

Men. 40 b היא של ב' וכ' if (the garment) itself is a web, but its borders are of leather. Ib. the principal element ב' בעינן must be a web (in order to require Tsitsith). Mekh. Mishp., N’zikin 3, v. preced. Sabb. 26 b; a. fr.— Pl. בְּגָדִים, constr. בִּגְדֵי. Gen. R. s. 20 ב' א"הר Adam’s garments, v. אוֹר II, 3. Yoma 60 b ב' לבן the Highpriest’s white garments (for the Day of Atone, Lev. XVI, 4), contrad. to ב' זהב gold-embroidered &c. Ib. 68 b; a. fr.
, v. אֲוָנָא II

sense.definition: , Gen. R. s. 98 ב' דין, read מִגְדַּל יוֹן pr. n. pl. Migdal Yon, near Sidon; v. Neub. Géogr. p. 295.
Bagdath (prob. Eski Bagdad, Neub. Géogr. p. 360), birth place of R. Ḥanna.
sense.notes: [Kidd. 71 b, v. אֲוָנָא II.]—Hence:
Yeb. 67 a; a. e.—Succ. 52 b Ms. M. (ed. באגדתא, corr. acc.).

sense.definition: , read בַּרְגִּימִינִין or בַּרְגִּימִינָא m. pl. (farcimen,—ina) stuffings of sausage, sausages.
sense.notes: Y. Sabb. VII, 10 a bot. כד מקטע ב' when cutting the sausages through (dividing them off), v. באנטרין. Y. Bets. IV, 62 c bot. the sausage-maker is forbidden to work on a Holy Day משום מקטע ב' because he cuts the sausage-bags apart; v. סיקורא.

— Pl. בְּגִידוֹת. Y. Peah I, 16 b top (play on bigdothekha, Ps. XLV, 9) כל בגידות שבגדת וכ' all sinful acts thou hast committed, shall (after repentance) be like myrrh &c.; Num. R. s. 10, beg.; Cant. R. to V, 16.
, v. גִּין
Targ. Y. Gen. XXVII, 11 quot. in Tosef. Yom Tob to Keth. III, 8, a. e. (ed. סערן).
, v. גְּלָאי

sense.definition: , Ms. Oxf. בגלאטורי, Sabb. 103 b, a corrupt. of בּוֹגָלִיס לִיטִירָא (or בּוֹגָאלִיס) (vocalis litera) open sound, vowel.
sense.notes: כיון דאיתיה ב' וכ' since it has merely the value of a vowel letter, one is guilty for writing two Alephs on the Sabbath (v. R. S.’s opinion ib. מלאכה שכיוצא בה מתקיימת). [Differ. in commentaries.]
, v. פָּגַן

sense.definition: (√בג, v. בָּאגָא; cmp. חֲזָזִית) [ to be rough (of surface, voice &c.);] to be wrinkled (of a female’s nipples), whence; to become of age (at twelve years and a half).
sense.notes: Keth. III, 8 הבּוֹגֶרֶת a girl of beginning maturity (v. Tosef. Yom Tob a. l.). Nidd. V, 7 כיון שבָּגְרָה as soon as she is mature, v. צֶמֶל. Pes. 113 a (prov.) בתך ב' וכ' has thy daughter become of age? Set thy slave free and give him to her (as husband); a. fr.—Tosef. Keth. III, 8 תִּיבָּגֵר (Nif.); Y. ib. 27 c bot. תִּבְגּוֹר.
. Targ. Y. Num. XXX, 11, sq.
B. Bath. 167 b בגר לה קלא her voice has become rough (from old age).—Denom. בַּגִּיר.

sense.definition:
to produce a rough surface, to heat and
bruise by friction.
sense.notes: Nidd. 66 a שפופרת אַבְגּוּרֵי מבגר לה Ar. (Var. אנג' מנג', ed. אפג' מפג') will not a tube bruise her?—Keth. 65 a מבגר לה (the ropes of the bedstead) hurt her.

Y. Kidd. I, 59 b ימות הב' the period of majority. Y. B. Bath. IX, beg. 16 d. Kidd. 4 a ב' דאיילונית majority of a barren (or wombless) woman (who has no signs of maturity and becomes of age at twenty years). Keth. 38 b יש ב' בקבר can the legal consequences of becoming of age enter after the woman’s death? [Other form: בּוֹגֶר. Y. Keth. V, 29 d לאחר בּוֹגְרָהּ after her becoming of age.] V. בַּגְרוּת.

Tosef. Keth. V, 1 הב' כתביעה (read בת', Var. ed. Zuck. הבּוֹגֶרֶת בתביעה) she who is of age when asked (by her betrothed) to be married; Y. ib. 29 d הב' בשעה (corr. acc.). Ib. נותנין לב' וכ' a girl of age is allowed twelve months for preparation for her wedding.—Ch. v. בַּגִּיר.

sense.definition: , Lev. R. s. 28, end, קומוס ב', read קוֹמִיס פְּרִיבָטוֹן (κόμης πριουάτων) = comes privatarum, v. דומין.

sense.notes: , v. גּוּנְדְּרָא

sense.definition: (v. בֶּגֶר) womanhood, (after twelve years and a half), opp. to נערות, maidenhood (between twelve and twelve and a half) and ילדות childhood (from three to twelve years).
sense.notes: Y. Yeb. I, 3 a top אין בין … לימות הב' וכ' between the period of maidenhood and that of womanhood there is no more than a six months’ interval; Keth. 39 a; a. fr.

sense.definition: prefix (comp. of בְּ a. דְּ = h. בְּשֶׁ־, בְּשֶׁל)
concerning that ( those) of; at the time of; treating of what refers to.
sense.notes: Sabb. 112 a בדטייעי in the case of those (sandals) of the travelling merchants (Arabs). Yoma 78 b, v. הוּצָא. Ḥull. 20 a ומתני' בדלא אהדר our Mishnah treats of a case when he did not turn. Gitt. 49 a בדניזק וכ' we go in our assessment by (the property) of the injured; a. v. fr.
Targ. Y. Gen. XLIII, 5 בִּדְּלֵית unless. Targ. O. Deut. IX, 4 בִּדְּיִתְּבַר; a. e.
= אֲבַד. Targ. Y. II, Num. XXI, 29 ובָדְתוּן (Var. וּבַדְתּוּן = וַאֲ'). Ithpe. אִתְבִּיד, v. אֲבַד

Shebi. VIII, 6 אין … בַּבַּד you must not press olives in the tank (in the Sabbath year).—בית הַבַּד the building containing the tank and all implements for pressing olives. Sabb. I, 9 קורת ב' הב' the beam of the press; a. fr.—Bets. 19 a; Tosef. ib. II, 7, v. גַּב.— Pl. בַּדִּים, בַּדִּין. B. Bath. IV, 7 בית הב'. Toh. IX, 7 בד אחד או שני ב' a quantity of olives for one tank or for two; a. fr.
Ber. 63 b (play on baddim, Jer. L, 36) שיושבין ב' ב' who study separately (without interchange of ideas). Kerith 5 a expl. Ex. XXX, 34 ב' בב'.

sense.definition: with pref. לְ, לְבַד (b. h.) alone, only.
sense.notes: Sot. 8 a אותה לְבַדָּהּ her (Num. V, 19) indicates her alone (each separately); a. fr.—בִּלְבַד (adv.) only. Ber. I, 1 ולא זו ב' (usu. with אמרו) and not only in this case did they make such a rule. Meg. I, 5 אין בין … אלא … ב' there is no difference between Festivals and the Sabbath (as to forbidden labors) except only as to the preparation of the necessaries of life; a. fr.—וּבִלְבַד but only, provided. Zeb. V, 8; a. fr.

Zeb. 18 b ב' שיהו של בוץ וכ' wherever the Law speaks of garments of bad, it means that they must be of byssus, new &c. Ib. how do we know דהאי ב' כיתנא הוא that bad (as material for garments) means linen (and no other fine stuff)? Answ. Something which grows בד בבד in single stalks (v. preced. a. next w.); Yoma 71 b. Ib. 35 a bad is used four times, intimating מובחר בב' the choicest of &c. (for diff. vers. v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); [cmp. Targ. Jer. XLVIII, 30].

sense.definition: (בדד) single stalk, twig; also (b. h.) pole, bar.
sense.notes: Zeb. 18 b; Yoma 71 b; v. preced. Keth. 17 a ב' של הדס myrtle twig. Succ. 44 b even one leaf וב' אחד and (on) one twig. B. Mets. 24 a anything on which something is suspended ב' קרו ליה is called bad.— Pl. בַּדִּים. Y. Yoma V, 42 b bot., a. e. בין הב' between the bars projecting from the Ark (i.e. their corresponding place in the Second Temple). B. Mets. l. c. בַּדֵּי מחטין וכ' poles of peddlars for needles &c. Ib. מאי בדי what does baddé mean? Answ. Twigs.—And why do they call them baddé? Answ., v. supra. V. אַנְפּוֹרְיָא.
Targ. Joël II, 24 Ar. (ed. בֵּירַיָּא). Snh. 95 a תותי בי ב' under the wine press (Var. בי סדיא).

sense.definition: = h. בַּד IV, fine linen woof.
sense.notes: Y. Sabb. XIII, beg. 14 a
, v. בדי
m. ch. = h. בַּדַּאי. Ḥull. 63 a ההוא ביידא הוה (corr. acc.; Yalk. Zech. 578 בדאה) that man was a liar.
, v. בַּדָּיוּת

Snh. 89 b (prov.) כך עונשו של ב' וכ' such is the punishment of the liar &c.; Ab. d’R. Nath. ch. XXX; Gen. R. s. 94 מה טיבו של ב' הזה; v. טִיב. Kidd. 49 a he who translates a Bible verse literally (v. צורה), הרי זה ב' is a liar (misrepresenting the sense).

Deut. R. s. 5, a. fr. דברים של ב' fictitious words (mitigating the original report); ib. דברי ב'.— Pl. בַּדָּאִים, בַּדָּאִין. Y. Gitt. IV, 46 a bot. נמצאו הדברים ב' things turned out to be false. B. Bath. 74 a; Snh. 110 ab Moses and his laws are true והן ב' and they (euphem. for we) are liars. Tosef. Keth. II, 1 ב' אנו (ed. Zuck. מבודין) we have been telling a falsehood.
, v. בָּאדָן

entry.language-reference: √בד; cmp. בז, to enter into, split, separate; v. בדל, בדק, בדר &c.)

sense.notes: Y. Yoma V, 42 c top בּוֹדְדָהּ ברגלו he scatters it (the frank-incense) with his foot (shoves it apart).

sense.definition: to dig out, create, choose, invent.
sense.notes: Denom. בַּד II, בַּדִּים.

Part. בּוֹדֵד lonely. Pesik. R. s. 29 (30), expl. בדד (Lam. I, 1) = בּוֹדֵד lonely, forsaken. Part. pass. בָּדוּד exiled. Lam. R. to I, 1 בגדים בדודים Ar. (read בגדי) garments of the exiled (כלי גולה, Jer. XLVI, 19); [ed. בגדי בָדָד, a. בְּדָדִין, v. next w.].
. Lam. R. introd. (R. Alexandri
(ref. to Ps. CII, 8) as the bird מִתְבּוֹדֵד וכ' is driven (separated from the rest) from roof to roof.

sense.definition: preced.) loneliness, (adv.) in a lonely state, in exile.
sense.notes: Snh. 104 a יהיה ב' מושבם the exile shall be their dwelling. Lam. R. to I, 1 בגדי ב' garments (outfit) of exile, v. preced.— Pl. בְּדָדִים, בְּדָדִין. Ib. בגדי ב' (plur. abstr. as חיים &c.).

sense.definition: (denom. of בַּד II) olive-treader, workingman in the olive press.
sense.notes: Gitt. 62 a.— Pl. בַּדָּדִין. Toh. X, 1 sq. Sabb. 19 b שמן של ב' וכ' the oil (remnants in corners) belonging to the pressers, and the mats which they use. B. Kam. 119 a והב' לוקחין מהן וכ' (read מנשותיהן, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 40) you may buy from the oil pressers’ (Rashi: oil producers’) wives &c. Tosef. Maasr. I, 10 הב' (ה)מדליקין וכ' the oil pressers who take their lighting oil (alternately) from one press and another.
, v. בְּדִידָה
Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. X, end (ed. Zuck. גרדין, v. גַּרְדּוֹן).
, v. בדי
, v. בְּדִי II
, v. next w.

sense.definition: (Arab. dubr, back) with one’s back to.
sense.notes: —Ber. 6 b (speech of an Arab) ב' קיימת וכ' Ar. (Ms. M. בדו בר, ed. כדו בר, corr. acc.) with thy back (to the Synagogue) standest thou before the Lord?
, v. כַּדּוֹרִית
— Pl. בָּדוֹחֵי. Taan. 22 a אינשי ב' וכ' we are merry-makers and cheer up the sad.
Targ. Ps. CL, 5 דמשמעין לבדוחא Ms. (ed. incorr. דשמעין בלחודיהון) which are sounded for rejoicing. Ib. LXVIII, 32 בבודחא Ms. (ed. בנוי דחם).
, v. בדי

sense.definition: (b. h.) b’dola ḥ, name of a jewel, also of a gum, bdellium.
sense.notes: Gen. R. s. 16, beg. את סבור כב' וכ' you might think, b’dolaḥ (Gen. II, 12) means the druggists’ bdellium—let its neighbor (next word אבן השוהם) explain it (correct. acc. to Yalk. Gen. 21).
Targ. Gen. II, 12; a. e.
, read בְּרוּקְלֵי.
— Pl. בְּדוּקַיָּא בְּדוֹ'. Targ. Y. Num. V, 19; a. e.

sense.definition: (בדק) one requiring examination, i.e. one whose father is unknown, usually שְׁתוּקִי.
sense.notes: Kidd. IV, 2 Abba Saul called the sh’thuki ב' b’duki. Y. ib. II, 65 d bot.; Bab. ib. 74 a
Targ. Is. VIII, 22 (ed. Vien. בַּדּוּר), a. e.
Targ. II Sam. XIV, 13 sq.
, v. פַּרְוִילָא
B. Bath. 145 a, a. fr. הא דר' … ב' היא R. …’s account (or opinion) is a mistake. [Ar. reads בָּרוּתָא q. v.]

sense.definition: (denom. of √דח, v. דְּחַהּ; cmp. בִּזְרָא) to be cheerful.
sense.notes: Targ. Y. Ex. XVIII, 9; a. fr.—Ber. 30 b, a. fr. ב' טובא was very cheerful. M. Kat. 17 a בְּדִיחָא דעתאי I feel happy. Sabb. 77 b.—*Ḥull. 32 a לא הוה בדיחנא ביה וכ' I could not make light of my uncle so as to ask him (Ar. ed. pr. בדיקנא).
Taan 22 a, v. בָּדוֹחָא. Ned. 51 a have I not cautioned thee דלא תבדחן not to make us laugh? Ib. 50 b bot. תבדיחן (En Yaak. תבדחן).

sense.definition: , v. בדד) to dig out, whence
(cmp. ברא) to take out (a piece of dough) and shape, to form.
sense.notes: Men. V, 1; Sifra Emor Par. 10, ch. XIII השאור בּוֹדֶה וכ' he gets the leaven required for the loaves out of themselves (taking a piece of dough out of that intended for the loaves).

Ned. 10 a לשון שבָּדוּ וכ' terms (for vows) which the Scholars have (arbitrarily) invented (as disguises). Lev. R. s. 9 לשון בָּדוּי an invented expression. Gen. R. s. 100 דברים בְּדוּיִים fictitious words. Ib. s. 48 בדויים (sub. דברים, some ed. בדאות).

Y. Meg. I, 71 c top בי' להן וכ' made up for them a false Latin translation (of the Bible) from the Greek; v. בָּרַר.—Y. Keth. II, 26 b bot. מְבַדִּין היינו we have been inventing, i.e. speaking in fun; Tosef. ib. II, 1 מבודין אנו (corr. acc.; Var. בדאים). [Y. Kidd. III, 64 d מבדין אתם וכ', prob. to be read מן הדין.] [Y. Shebi. IV, 35 b bot. מבדין בחדשים, v. בָּהָה.]
Tanḥ. Balak, 14; ed. Bub. 23 (ref. to baddim, Is. XLIV, 25) מְבַדִּין וכ' they frustrate their predictions.

sense.definition: to be tempted to a falsehood, turn a liar.
sense.notes: Ber. 4 a; Der. Er. Zut. ch. III train thy tongue to say, I do not know, שמא תִּתְבַּדֶּה וכ' lest thou be induced to tell a falsehood and be caught.
Targ. Y. II. Num. XVI, 28 בְּדֵית (Var. בָּדִית).

sense.definition: to be declared wrong, to be mistaken.
sense.notes: Y. Yeb. VIII, 9 c עברת בִּידָּךְ תלתא נהרין ואִיתְבַּדַּת thy story crossed three rivers (coming from Babylonia) and is found to be a mistake; Y. Sabb. II, 9 a top ואיתבר' (corr. acc.).

sense.definition: , Pa. בַּדֵּי, בַּדֵּה (dialect. = בזי) to despise.
sense.notes: Cant. R. to VIII, 1 (ref. to לא יבזו לי ibid.; read:) לית דו מבדה לי there is none can despise me (for kissing my brother); [Ex. R. s. 5 beg. corrupt].
, Yalk. Deut. 913 ב' פלסטין, v. דִּיפְּלֵי
Bekh. 8 b מילי דב' ed. (Ar. כדי, En Yaak. כדיבי) some stories.

Kel. XXIX, 7 יד הב' the handle of a spade.— Pl. בְּדִידִין. Y’lamd. Sh’laḥ quot. in Ar. ב' בברזל(?).—2) rut, cavity (cmp. next w.).— Pl. as above. M. Kat. 4 b; Tosef. ib. I, 2; ib. Shebi. I, 7 ב' שבעיקרי וכ' the cuts around the roots of trees; v. אוּגְיָה.

sense.definition: (בדד, v. בַּד II) small olive press.
sense.notes: Sifra B’har ch. I one may grind the olives in the large tank ומכניס לבד' and then put them into the small press; Shebi. VIII, 6 לבוד'.— Pl. בְּדִידוֹת. Gen. R. s. 31 Ar. (ed. בדדיות, בדריות, corr. acc.).
Lev. R. s. 9. Gen. R. s. 48, v. בָּדָא.
, v. בְּדַח
Constr. בְּדִיחַת. Targ. Esth. VIII, 17.
Sabb. 30 b מלתא דב' something humorous. Ber. 55 a בדיחותֵיה מפכחא ליה its very cheerfulness frustrates it (the good dream).

sense.definition: (contr. of בי דייני) prop. court-house, in gen. government’s building, public building, treasury.
sense.notes: Ber. 56 a ב' דמלכא וכ' ed. (Mss. בֵּי זְיוּנָא, בִּזְיוּנָא q. v.) the king’s treasury shall be broken into. [Perl. Et. St. p. 25 refers to Pers. divân which, however, seems of too late an origin for the Talmudic date, v. Cycl. Brit. 9 th ed. s. v. Divan.]

Targ. O. Gen. VI, 3; a. e.—Lev. R. s. 28, end אזל ב' בלנאי he went for (the sake of getting) a bather. Y. Kidd. III, 64 a ב' דלא יכפור וכ' in order that he may not deny his owing a cup. Yoma 75 b ב' רבא וכ' (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) through the merit of the teacher is the scholar supported.—בְּדִילִי, בְּדִילָךְ &c. on my, thy account &c. Targ. O. Deut. III, 26; a. e. (Y. בגלל; b. h. למען).
Tanḥ. Mishp. 17 לשון ב' an expression meaning ‘creating a partition’.

sense.definition: fictions, whence lying oracles; trnsf. conjurers.
sense.notes: Targ. Is. XLIV, 25. Targ. Lev. XX, 27; a. fr.
, v. בְּדַק

Pes. I, 1. Y. ib. I, beg. 27 a בְּדִיקַת היום ב' search (after leavened bread) made in day-time is a (valid) search. Kil. IX, 7; a. fr.—Num. R. s. 9 לב' דידיה referring to his search; i.e. intimating that the test by the ‘bitter waters’ (v. סוטה) will also affect him (the adulterer) (Sot. 28 a לידיעה).— Pl. בְּדִיקוֹת; esp. cross-examinations of witnesses as to minor circumstances; v. חֲקִירָה. Snh. V, 2 (40 a); a. fr.

sense.definition: , esp. examination of slaughtered animals as to the condition of the lungs &c., v. בְּדַק.
sense.notes: Ḥull. 48 a לית להו ב' וכ' no examination will avail them to make them permitted; (ib. 46 a לית להו בדיקה). Ib. 10 b מצריך ב' וכ' declares an examination (of the slaughtering knife) necessary &c.; a. e.

sense.definition: (v. בְּדַק Pa., end) detective, police officer.
sense.notes: Taan. 22 a ב' אנא Ms. M. (ed. זנדוקנא, v. זַנְדּוּקָא). [The description of that officer’s doings proves the correctness of the version of Ms. M.]

sense.definition: B’ditha, name of a canal of the Euphrates, v. פּוּמְבְּדִיתָא.
sense.notes: M. Kat. 11 a ב' לבאי כוורי (read בב', Alf. בפומבדיתא) in the B’ditha the fish were laid dry. [Var. בריתא, ברייתא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 300.]

sense.definition: (√בד, v. בדד) to separate, divide, distinguish; (neut. v.) בָּדֵל to keep aloof.
sense.notes: Pes. 87 b בְּדוֹל עצמך וכ' withdraw thyself from (touching) her. Y. Ḥag. II, 78 b top כדי שיהא בָּדֵל מן התרומה in order that he may be careful in handling T’rummah. B. Mets. 59 b it seems to me שחברים בְּדֵילִים וכ' that the colleagues hold themselves aloof from thee (i.e. thou art excommunicated). Ib. 89 a ב' בתמרים to separate (with a tool) dates which stick together (cmp. Rashi a. l.); Y. Maasr. II, 50 a top הבדיל בתמרים (read הבודל). Ber. 5 a יסורין בְּדֵילִין וכ' pains will stay away from him; a. fr.

Ḥull. 21 b מולק ואינו מַבְדִּיל he nips the bird’s neck but must not sever a limb or cut with his nail deeper than required (Lev. I, 17). Ib. I, 7 המבדיל בין וכ' He who established distinctions between (the) sanctity (of the Sabbath) and (the) sanctity (of the Festivals); a. fr.

sense.definition: (denom. of אַבְדָּלָה or הַבְדָּלָה) to recite the benediction Hammabdil on the exit of the Sabbath or Festival, to say Habdalah.
sense.notes: Ibid. כיצד מבדילין what formula must you use (at the exit of the Sabbath and the simultaneous beginning of a Festival)? a. fr.—Part. Hof. מוּבְדָּל separated, distinguished. Num. R. s. 10 beg. מוּבְדָּלִים וכ' are different from the doings of other nations. Naz. 7 a מוּבְדָּלוֹת זו מזו are separated one from another. Tosef. Peah III, 5; a. fr.
ch.
116 b וכ' בדלינן we abstain from them. Ib. לא בדילי וכ' do not abstain; a. e.
Erub. 40 b מי בדלת hast thou said Habd.? … אין בדילנא yes, I have &c.
, v. בָּאדָן
, v. בִּרְסִין

sense.definition: , v. בדד) to split, break into, penetrate.
sense.notes: Keth. XIII, 9 הנוה היפה בּוֹדֵק the removal to a better residence (and style of living) penetrates (the body and creates disease); v. ib. 110 b מאי ב' כדשמואל וכ' what does bodek mean? Answ. As it is expressed by Samuel …, a change of the mode of living (v. וֶסֶת) is the beginning of abdominal disease.—Esp.

Sot. V, 1 as well as the water בּוֹדְקִין אותה וכ' tries her (eventually makes her sick), so does it try him (the adulterer). Pes. I, 1 ב' את החמץ leavened bread is searched after (for the sake of removing it). Ib. 9 b (בית) בָּדוּק a house which has been searched. Snh. III, 6 ב' את העדים the witnesses are cross-examined. Ib. IV, 5; v. דְּרִישָׁה. Sabb. 139 a וכ' בְּדוֹק בדיינו investigate the doings of the Israelitish judges. Keth. VII, 8 הוא בּוֹדְקָהּ וכ' he has her examined (as to bodily soundness) by his female relatives. Ib. 75 b חזקה אין … אא"כ בּוֹדְקוֹ the presumption is that nobody will drink out of a cup, unless he has examined it (will not marry a woman before ascertaining her physical condition). Kidd. IV, 4 צריך לבְדוֹק אחריה וכ' must investigate her family records up to four mothers &c. Ib. 5 אין בודקין מן וכ' no family records are searched beyond the altar, i.e. the ascertained fact of a person’s admission to priestly services is sufficient evidence of unblemished descent for marriage purposes. Nidd. 30 b ובדקן ומצאן (read ובדקו ומצאו) they (the scholars) examined (made a post mortem examination); Tosef. ib. IV, 17; Bekh. 45 a; a. fr.

sense.definition: to tend, cure (plants), esp. to cover with earth or manure.
sense.notes: Tosef. Shebi. I, 12; Y. ib. IV, 35 b bot.

sense.definition: to be examined &c. Y. Gitt. I, 43 b; IX, end, 50 d נ' השם the report was traced.
sense.notes: Nidd. V, 6 נדריה נִבְדָּקִין her vows are subject to examination (to find out whether she knows the import of a vow); a. fr.
Ḥull. 105 a חזא צינורא דבדקא וכ' (Ar. דבידקא) he saw that a sewer had burst into his field (inundating it); v. בִּדְקָא.
Targ. Judg. XVIII, 2; a. fr.—Yeb. 65 a אִיבְדוֹק נפשאי I will test myself (as to my virility). Y. Ned. II, 37 b bot. בעי חיפה מִיבְדְּקוּנֵיה Ḥefa wanted to sound his knowledge. Taan. 21 b; a. fr.

sense.definition: to cure the body by means of a purgative.
sense.notes: Ned. 50 b הוה בָּדִיק נפשיה וכ' purged himself with &c.; a. e.—Part. pass. בְּדִיק tested, sure, known. Y. Sot. V, 20 c bot. לא הוות בדיקה לי was unknown to me (I had not experienced). Taan. 23 b לא בדיקתו לי (not בדקיתו) ye are unknown to me (as to your honesty).—בְּדִיקְנָא I am sure, I know. Pes. 111 b בדיקנא ביה במר דלא וכ' I am sure you do not know (Ms. M. ב' ליה וכ', Ms. 2 Oxf. בקינא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note). *Ḥull. 32 a לא הוה בדיקנא ביה וכ' Ar. Var. (ed. בדיחנא) I was not so familiar with my uncle that I should have asked him.

sense.definition: to discover (by sorcery), to find out secrets.
sense.notes: Targ. O. Gen. XLIV, 5; 15. Cmp. בְּדִיקְנָאָה.

ב' הבית (II Kings XII, 8) keeping the Temple in repair. Y. Pes. VIII, 36 a top. Tem. I, 6 קדשי ב' הב' (Mish. קרבנות) offerings for the Temple repair, opp. to קדשי מזבח objects dedicated for sacrifices. Ibid. VII, 1; a. fr.— Pl. בְּדָקִים, constr. בִּדְקֵי. Sabb. 32 a ב' מיתה breaches through which death enters, i.e. sins for which one is visited with death; v. דֶּבֶק.
Targ. Y. II Num. V, 19 these waters searching לב' האילין the defect. [Probably a corrupt reading.]

B. Mets. 66 b אתא ב' וכ' a freshet came and overflooded &c. B. Bath. 41 a שקל בי' וכ' a freshet swept his field (taking away the fence). Ḥull. 105 a צינורא דב' Ar. a channel caused by a freshet, v. בְּדַק. Snh. 7 a strife is likened לצינורא דבי' (דמיא) וכ' to an inroad made by a burst (of water), once entering it widens more and more; a. fr.— Pl. בִּדְקֵי, בִּידְקֵי. Erub. 21 a דשכיחי בי' where freshets are of frequent occurrence.
Targ. O. Gen. XLII, 9 (h. ערוה). Targ. II Kings XII, 6 sq.— Pl. Targ. Lam. I, 8 בִּדְקָהָא her shortcomings (h. עֶרְוָתָהּ). [B. Bath. 61 a בדקא, v. בַּרְקָא III.]
, Pi. בִּידֵּר as following. Ruth R. to II, 15 היה מְבַדֵּר וכ' scattered coins. [Prob. to be read מבקר or מבקיר.]

— Pa. בַּדֵּר same, also, to distribute freely. Targ. Ps. LXVIII, 31; a. fr.—Ḥull. 54 a אי בַּדְּרֵי לה סמא וכ' if a powder is strewn upon its wound, it may recover; [Rashb. to B. Bath. 74 b quotes דעבד ליה סמתרי]. Gitt. 56 b ובַדְּרוּ לקיטמיה וכ' and scatter ye his (my) ashes over seven waters. Y. Ber. IX, end, 14 d בשעה דמכנשין בַּדַּר וכ' when people gather (are willing to listen to instruction), distribute (teach); when people scatter (throw religion away in neglect), gather in (live in retired study). Cant. R. to VIII, 9 בדרו גרמיכון disperse ye (do not stand in crowds).—Part. pass. מְבַדַּר scattered. Y. M. Kat. III, 81 d top אית סגין מנהון מְבַדְּרַן וכ' there are more than those (twenty four cases) scattered in Mishnah and Boraitha. Sabb. 20 a, v. infra.
Targ. Amos IX, 9. [Ibid. מחזרין, prob. מבדרין.] Cmp. בַּזֵּיל.
Targ. Mic. VI, 15 (perh. בדד?).

Targ. Is. XXXIII, 3; a. fr.—Sabb. 20 a קנים מִיבַּדְּרִין (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 300, ed. מבדרן) loose staves in the stove will fall apart (and may require stirring). Lev. R. s. 6 and the denars began מִתְבַּדְּרִין to be scattered. Gitt. 33 b ליבַּרְּרוּ אִיבַּדּוּרֵי (not איבדורו) let them disperse (so as not to be found together). Snh. 8 a bot. ואיבדור and they (the judges) dispersed.—Denom. בִּדּוּר, בִּדּוּרָא.
, v. בִּרְדְּסִין
, v. בהי
, v. הַד־
Gen. R. s. 2; a. fr.
= אַבָּהוּ. Ber. 45 a; a. fr. (Ms. M.).
Pes. 72 b; a. fr.; v. הוּ.
, v. בֵּיהוּלְתָּא
, v. בָּהִיר
Targ. Prov. XXVI, 21 ed. Wil. (Ms. בְּהַוְתָא; oth. ed. כהותא).

sense.definition: , to be broken into; to gasp; to burst forth, v. בהק, בהר; v. Ges. Hebr. Dict.
sense.notes: s. v.) to be stirred up, confounded, in disorder.—Gen. R. s. 2, beg. תוהא ובוֹהִא; ib. fem. תוהא ובוֹהָא bewildered and confounded.
Y. Sabb. VII, 10 a top המברה בחרשים (read המַבְהֶה). Y. Shebi. IV, 35 b ומבדין (read ומַבְהִין or ומַבְהֶה) you may clear thickets (in the Sabbath year); v. בָּרַךְ Pi.
Part. בָּהֵי, fem. בַּהֲיָא chaotic. Targ. Y. II, Ex. XII, 42. Targ. Y. Gen. I, 2.
, Targ. Prov. II, 7, read סברא (as in Pesh.) or סַבְהוֹר = ed. Wil. שבהור.
Ezra IV, 23. Targ. Ex. XII, 11; a. e.
Targ. Cant. VII, 3; a. e.

sense.definition:
(בהר; b. h.
בהיר) white, white spot (cloud).
sense.notes: — Pl. בְּהִירִין, בְּהוֹ'. Taan. 7 b (ref. to Job XXXVII, 2
אפי' בשעה שהעננים עומדין בהי' בהי' וכ' Ms. M., even when the clouds stand in white spots, there comes a wind &c.; edit. שרקיע נעשה בהו' בהו' the sky is made (to appear) full of white clouds.
same. Targ. Job XXXVII, 21 ב' מן וכ' white clouds without giving rain &c.
, v. בְּהַת

sense.definition: , v. בהי) to hurry, be excited, anxious.
sense.notes: Part. pass. בָּהוּל excited, pressed. Pes. 11 a sq. אדם ב' הוא וכ' man is excited when his property is at stake. Ib. 72 b זמנו ב' his time (for doing the thing) is pressed (it cannot be postponed). Yoma 85 a, a. e. ב' על מתו anxious to save his dead relative from the fire.
Y. Yoma VI, 43 c bot. למה אתה מְבַהֲלֵינוּ why dost thou agitate us.

Num. R. s. 14 (ref. to tibbahel, Koh. VIII, 3) אל תִּתְבָּהֵל וכ' be not intimidated by his wrath, Ib. לא נ' מן מעשיה he was not carried away by her (tempting) actions. Ib. לא נ' מפנאי וכ' he was not confounded on account of his being alone in the house. Pesik. R. s. 36 מתרעשים ומִתְבַּהֲלִים were in commotion and alarm.—

sense.definition: , or Pual מְבוֹהָל confounded, hard to pronounce or remember.
sense.notes: Gitt. 14 b שמותיהן מוב' וכ' Ar. (ed. מבו') their names are bewildering, beginning with Arda, Arta, Phile.—[Deut. R. s. 9 דעתו מובלגת, read מוּבְהֶלֶת his mind is confused, he cannot collect himself for prayer.]
— Pa. בּהֵיל
. Targ. Koh. V, 1; a. e.
. Targ. Esth. II, 9.
Targ. I Sam. XXVIII, 21; a. fr.—Y. Keth. I, 25 a is it possible that the whole town מִתְבַּהֲלָה וכ' was excited on account of Naomi?

Y. Bicc. II, 64 d top; S’maḥ. III, 9 לשנים מיתה של ב' death after two days’ sickness is a shocking death.—Y. B. Mets. II, end, 8 d a rending of garments שאינו של ב' וכ' which is not done under the influence of the first shock (after the sad news) is considered as if not performed at all.— Pl. בֶּהָלוֹת. Num. R. s. 11; Tanḥ. Naso, 10 באנגריא ובב' as a forced duty and in a hurried manner; a. fr.

sense.definition: (denom. of next w.) cattle-driver, cattle-raiser, driver.
sense.notes: Deut. R. s. 3 והבהם עמו and the driver (leader of the ass) was with him. *[Y. Ned. XI, end, 42 d הבַּיאָם שלי פיתני (= בַהָם) my stable-man (a gentile) has seduced me. Ib. אין הביאם אוסר (not אסור) (do you believe) the stable-man’s connection with thee has no restrictive consequences? [V. Noda Bihudah, 2 nd ed., Eb. Haëz. Nr. 12.] Gen. R. s. 86 בהמי (Yalk. Gen. 145 אדם, prob. בהם).— Pl. בַּהָמִים, בַּהָמִין. Y. Pes. I, 27 b (in gen. servants). Cant. R. to IV, 4 (play on ובבהמתך Deut. VII, 14) there shall be none barren (of knowledge) among thee, אפי' בב' שבכם even among your cattle drivers; Deut. R. s. 3; a. e.; Gen. R. s. 32 בבהמות (corr. acc.)—Y. Maasr. II, 50 a bot. התריגו לבהמין (not התריגי) give the drivers (field laborers) oranges to eat; [Erub. 53 b אתריגו לפחמין in diff. connection].

sense.definition: , Æthiop. to be dumb; √בה, v. בהי) cattle, quadruped domestic animal (mostly of the horned race); in gen. dumb beast, opp. to man.
sense.notes: Gen. R. s. 20 ב' חיה ועופות domestic animals, wild beasts, and birds; a. fr.—ב' גסה large cattle (of the bovine race); ב' דקה small cattle (sheep, goats &c.). Bekh. 8 a; a. fr.—בֶּהֱמַת מלוג, ב' ארנונא &c., v. מְלוּג, אַרְנוֹנָא &c.— Pl. בְּהֵמוֹת Gen. R. s. 86; a. fr.

sense.definition: Coptic p-ehe-mau, water-ox, Ges.) in Rabbin.
sense.notes: lit. B’hemoth, a legendary animal reserved for the righteous in the hereafter; cmp. לִוְיָתָן. Lev. R. s. 22 in place of the forbidden animals from which you here abstain, ב' בהררי אלף (I shall give you in the hereafter) ‘the b’hemoth on the thousand mountains’ (Ps. L, 10). Ib. s. 13 ב' ולויתן וכ' b’hemoth a. leviathan are the game of the righteous &c. Ib. ב' נותץ וכ' b’hemoth shall attack the leviathan with his horns &c.

sense.definition: , v. בהי) to shine with a pale light, be white, glisten.
sense.notes: Bekh. 45 b בּוֹהֵק one glistening (with unsteady eyes, albino), diff. fr. לבן white-complected.

Y. Pes. I, beg. 27 b top בשעה שהיו מבהיקים when the candles burned brightly. Ib. מַבְהִיקוֹת; Gen. R. s. 31 מַבְהֶקֶת (of glistening jewels). Ib. s. 40 הבהיקה כל וכ' the whole land of Egypt was brightened by her (Sarah’s) beauty; a. fr.

Snh. 100 a.—Part. Hof. מוּבְהָק distinguished, prominent. Kidd. 33 a ברבו המ' when his teacher is a distinguished scholar. Gitt. 11 a שמות מוּבְהָקִין names of a distinctly gentile character (which Jews do not assume). [Sifra Thazr. ch. I שאת מובהקת, read with R. S. to Neg. I, 1 מוגבהת, v. גָּבַהּ.]
Af. אַבְהִיק to shine. Targ. II Sam. XXII, 13.
, v. בֹּוהַק
(pl. בַּהֲקֵי), בַּהֲקִי, בַּהֲקִיתָא f. = h. בַּהֶרֶת. Targ. Y. I, II Lev. XIII, 2; XIV, 56; a. e.

sense.definition: (בהק) one afflicted with bohak (Lev. XIII, 39), one having an eruption resembling leprosy, v. בּוֹהַק.
sense.notes: Gen. R. s. 98 מי שהוא ב' וכ' one who is a bahakan is hot-tempered. Pl. בָּהֲקָנִין. Ib. (ed. בּוֹהֲ') ריבה בהן ב' (ref. to Gen. XLIX, 7) he let rise among them a large number of bohakanin (hot-tempered men). V. next w.

sense.definition: same, one full of whitish pustules.
sense.notes: Ber. 58 b Ms. M. (ed. בהקנים plur.). Fem. בֹּהֲקָנִית, בּוֹהֲ', fem. בֹּהֲקָנִיּוֹת, בּוֹ'. Meg. 24 b ידיו ב' one whose hands are &c.

בִּיהֵר or Hif. הִבְהִיר to shine brightly, be glossy; trnsf. to make one’s self conspicuous, to boast. Lev. R. s. 15; Tanḥ. Thazr. 11 bahereth (Lev. XIII, 2) that is Yavan (Græco-Syria) שהיתה מְבָהֶרֶת על וכ' (or מַבְהֶרֶת) that lorded it over Israel by her decrees; v. קֶרֶן.—[ Pi. בִּיהֵר to make clear. Pesik. R. s. 33, v. בָּחַר.]
ch., Shaf. שַׁבְהַר q. v.
, v. בַּהַרְתָּא
, v. חֲרִיקָא

sense.definition: bright white spot on the skin, eventually one of the symptoms of leprosy.
sense.notes: Neg. I, 1 ב' עזה כשלג bahereth means an intensively bright spot (sparkling) like snow. Ib. II, 1 ב' עזה וכ' an intensely bright spot appears faint on the skin of a Germanus (Teuton), and the faint spot appears bright on a Cushite; (Sifra Thazr., Neg. ch. I, ed. Weiss כג', ככ'; Yalk. Lev. 551 גרדמ', corr. בגרמ', בכושי); a. fr.— Pl. בֶּהָרוֹת. Neg. VII, 1. Ib. VIII, 6; Tosef. ib. III, 12.
Targ. O. Lev. XIII, 2; a. e.— Pl. בַּהְרָן. Ib. 38; 39. V. בַּהֲקָא.

sense.definition: (= h. בּוּשׁ, cmp. רוּץ a. רְהַט) to be confounded, abashed, ashamed.
sense.notes: Targ. O. Gen. XLIX, 8; a. fr.—Y. Shek. I, beg. 45 d (in Hebr. phraseol.) הן נקרא ולא נבהית (Bab. ed. הנקרא … נבעית) can we read this and not feel ashamed? Y. Keth. XII, 35 a top; Y. Kil. IX, 32 b top, if I rise among the righteous, לא נבהת I may not feel ashamed. Ib. ומה אנא בהית בעבדאי (read בעובדיי) why should I be ashamed of my doings? Y. Kidd. IV, 65 c top בָּהֲתִין וכ' they are ashamed of one another. Y. Orl. I, 61 b top בהית מסתכל ביה is ashamed to look at him. Lev. R. s. 31 לא בהתין yet are not ashamed (to worship them).
Keth. 62 a (prov.) a woman used to abortion (or loss of children through death) לא בהתה is no longer besides herself (when it reoccurs; Ar.: is not ashamed).

Targ. Ps. XIV, 6. Ib. CXIX, 116; a. e.—Y. Shebi. IV, 35 b bot.; Y. Maas. Sh. V, beg. 55 d ומבהתין ליה דיעבד and bend the tree down as if in shame, in order that it may bear fruits (cmp. Sabb. 67 a ‘that people may pray for it’). Y. Kil.; Y. Keth. l. c. if I rise among the wicked לא נַבְהִית (or נְבָהֵת) I may not put (them) to shame.
—Y. R. Hash. II, 58 a bot. לא תבהית וכ' confound not thy Master’s children (the Israelites).

sense.definition: , contr. אִבְּהִית to be put to shame.
sense.notes: Cant. R. to II, 5 והוא מתב' וכ' and he felt ashamed and went away. Y. Sabb. VI, 8 c top מִבַּהֲתָא she is ashamed.

Targ. Job VIII, 22; a. fr.—Snh. 102 b; Gen. R. s. 49 סבי דב' elders of disgrace, v. אַשְׁמָה. Ḥull. 56 b איגלאי בהתייהו their shame (diseased condition) has been revealed. Targ. II Chr. XXXII, 21 בֵּיהוּת.

entry.language-reference: √בא, בה, v. בהי, to enter into, split, insert; v. בבא, בון; to be vacant, clear, v. באר, בור; to be disordered, v. באש, בוש)

sense.notes: R. Hash. I, 2 בָּאֵי העולם those come into the world, i.e. mortals. Ḥull. 54 b בּוֹאֲכֶם בשלום be welcome!—Tanḥ. Vaëra 14; Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVIII, 47, a. e. (play on ב̇ח̇נ̇מ̇ל̇ ibid.) [ב̇א נ̇ח̇ מ̇ל̇] ב̇א ח̇ן̇ מ̇ל̇ it (the locust) comes, encamps [rests], and plucks. Y. Shebu. VIII, 38 c top, a. e. במקום שבאת, v. גְּזֵרָה.—Y. Peah I, 15 c top, a. fr. יָבֹא עלי אם וכ' may (evil) befall me, if—; cmp. אֲתָא; Koh. R. to X, 8 אם לא יבא וכ' (corr. acc.).

sense.definition:
with על (b. h.
with אל) to have sexual connection.
sense.notes: Kerith. I, 1; a. fr.

sense.definition: with לְיַד or לִידֵי to fall into the power of.
sense.notes: —Aboth II, 1 ואין אתה בא לידי עבירה and sin will have no power over thee. Yoma 86 b בא לידו דבר וכ' (not באת) he had the power (the chance) to commit a sin &c.; Kidd. 39 b; a. fr.—בּוֹא וראה come and see (I will prove). Yoma l. c.; a. fr.
Gitt. I, 1 המֵבִיא וכ' he who brings (as a messenger) a letter of divorce from abroad; a. fr.
. Bicc. I, 1; a. fr.

sense.definition: to draw an object toward’s one’s self, opp. הוֹלִיךְ, v. הָלַךְ.
sense.notes: Ḥull. II, 3 הוליך ולא ה' he put the knife out (in slaughtering) but did not draw it backward; ה' ולא וכ' or drew it toward himself but did not then move forward; a. fr.
Aboth I, 17 מביא חטא begets sin; a. fr.
Ab. Zar. 20 b Torah מביאה לידי וכ' (v. supra) leads to careful conduct &c. Ib. 18 a אתה מְבִיאֵנִי וכ' wilt thou procure me (promise me) admittance into the world to come?; a. fr.
, v. כְּוָאנָא
, v. בָּאוַת

sense.definition: (Syr. bubia sartago, P. Sm.; prob. = בי אפיא, פ softened through assimilation, cmp. תפייא a. בי תפי) a frying pan, sometimes used as a coal pan containing the coal over which things are roasted.
sense.notes: Pes. 30 b האי בוב' (Ms. M. 2, Ms. Oxf. Ar. and old ed., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 10); Zeb. 95 b (Ms. R. 1 מביא, corr. בו'; Ms. K. בוכיא). Sabb. 29 a he threw the date stones לבוביא Ms. M. a. Ar. (Y. Bets, IV, 62 c לתפייה, v. Rashi to Sabb. l. c.) into the pan. [Editions vary betw. כוביא a. בוכיא.]
, Lam. R. to II, 2, v. בִּיבָא
, v. בּוּכְיָאר
, v. בּוּבְיָא
, v. בָּבִיתָא
Sabb. 104 a

sense.definition: , Targ. II Esth. VI, 1 ב' נוגמי אינון, Var. פוגני נ' א', פוגני נעימי א', read פִּיטַגְמָטִין(אֶ) or דִּיטַגְמָטִין (ἐπιτάγματα, διατάγματα) commands, ordinances; v. דִּיטַגְמָא.

sense.notes: , v. בֶּגֶר.—בּוֹגֶרֶת, pl. בּוֹגְרוֹת, v. בָּגַר.

sense.definition: c. (denom. of בַּד V) a mat of reeds.
sense.notes: [The best versions, however, read בּוּרְיָא q. v.]
, v. בְּדִידָה
, v. בְּדוֹחָא
, v. בֹּהוּ
Pes. 57 a (Ms. M. בוהין); Tosef. ib. II (III), 20 (Var. נבו היו, בן נבו היין).
Neg. I, 5. Sifra Thazr., Neg., ch. X.
Targ. O. Lev. XIII, 38 (ed. Berl. בּוּהְקָא).
, v. בַּתְוָא
Aboth IV, 3 אל תהי בָז despise not &c.
Targ. Gen. XXXIV, 27; a. fr.—Esth. R. to I, 10 (play on בזתא ibid.) בוז ביתיה plunder his house.
Ib. (play on בגתא ואבגתא ibid. as if from בג, cmp. בגד) בוז ובזבז tread and shatter (v. Targ. Esth. a. l.; cmp. בָּזוֹזָא). [Most of the forms may be derived fr. בזז.]
Targ. Job XXXII, 2; 6.
Pl. בּוֹזָנַיָּא. Yalk. Jer. 281 (Lam. R. introd. R. Yits. 1 בָּזוֹזַיָּא).
Targ. Ps. CXIX, 22.—V. בִּיזָּא II.

sense.definition: (בחל I) prop. aversion, sickness, hence (cmp. באש) a certain stage in the growth of the fig (intermediate between פגה and צמל), when its head becomes white; trnsf. the stage of female puberty intermediate between childhood (ילדות) and full womanhood (בגרות).
sense.notes: Nidd. V, 7 the Scholars have introduced figurative terms for the stages of womanhood: paggah, boḥal &c.; ב' אלו ימי נעוריה boḥal means the days of maidenhood. V. בָּחַל.

sense.definition: Buta, father of Baba, v. בָּבָא II.

sense.notes: Targ. Job XXXVII, 21 (Ms. בּוֹטֵשׁ).

sense.definition: (v. preced.), ב' דנורא spark (blossom of light, cmp. h. נִיצוֹץ).
sense.notes: — Pl. בּוֹטְטֵי, בּוֹטִיטֵי. B. Mets. 85 b בוטטי דנ' מחיוה וכ' … Ms. M. (ed. בוטי' … ומחייה, corr. acc.) two sparks came forth and struck the eyes of &c. Ber. 58 a מילתא אמר ר' ששת ונפקו ב' דנ' וכבינהו לעיניה Ar. ed. Koh. (Ms. M. הב ביה מילתא ונפק בוטיתא דנ', omitted in ed., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) R. Sh. spoke a word, and there came forth sparks and blinded him.
Gitt. 37 a; v. בּוּלְבּוּטֵיס.
, v. בּוֹטְטָא
, v. בְּטִיטָא

sense.definition: (בטט; cmp. בּוֹטְטָא) flower-bud of the caper tree, capers.
sense.notes: Ber. 36 b ושקליה לניצא דפרחא וחייא בו' Ar. (ed. לפרחא דבי' ואיקיים … Ms. M. … לניצא דפרחא והויא בי') the blossom of the caper was cut off, but the bud survived. [Ib. 58 a בו' דנורא Ms. M. read בּוֹטִיטָא, v. בּוֹטְטָא.]— Pl. בּוּטְיָתָא, בִּיטְיָתָא. Ḥull. 59 a שב ב' וכ' seven blossoming capers (Rashi: stones of the caper fruit). Y. Maasr. IV, end, 51 c מרימין … בי' to remove the buds. [Y. Pes. I, beg. 27 a באילין בוטיתא, v. בְּטִיטָא.]
. Targ. O. Ex. XXI, 18 (being incapacitated).
Ib. v. 19. V. בְּטֵילָא.

sense.definition: terebinth ( fruit and tree), pistacia terebinthus (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Tereb.).
sense.notes: Targ. O. Gen. XXXV, 4; a. e.— Pl. (Hebr., fr. בּוּטְמָה) בּוּטְמִין. Y. Kil. I, 27 a bot. הלוזין והב' וכ' nuts and terebinths combined produce pistachio.—Chald. בּוּטְמֵי. R. Hash. 23 a אלונים ב' ed. (Ar. אלמונים ב'; Gen. R. s. 15 אלונים בְּלוּטֵי, B. Bath. 80 b בּוּטְנֵי, Ms. M. בוטמי), v. אַלּוֹן, אַלְמוֹן I.
Shebi. VII, 5 Ar. s. v. אלה (ed. בָּטְנֶה); v. next w.— Pl. בּוּטְמִין. Targ. O. Gen. XLIII, 11 ed. Berl. (oth. ed. a. Y. בוטנין).

sense.definition: , √בט to be hollow, swell, v. Ges. H. Dict. s. v. בטן) pistachio ( nut or tree).
sense.notes: Shebi. VII, 5 Ms. M. a. Y. ed. (Bab. ed. בטנה), v. preced.; Tosef. ib. V, 11 בּוֹטְנֶה;— Pl. בּוּטְנִין, בּוּטְנֵי. Targ. Y. (a. O. some ed.) Gen. XLIII, 11; v. preced. B. Bath. 80 b; v. preced.
Lev. R. s. 18, end; Num. R. s. 7.
, v. בּוּטְנָא I

sense.definition: Batanæa, town and district east of the Jordan, reputed for large commercial fairs (יָרִיד).
sense.notes: Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39 d; Gen. R. s. 47 בָּטְנָן. Cmp. בָּשָׁן (b. h.) a. בּוּתְנַן.
Pesik. R. s. 10, read טֶטְרָגוֹנִין; v. אִסְטְרוֹנְגִּילוֹן
, v. בִּיטְשָׁא
, v. בַּיְישָׁן

sense.definition: (b. h.; √בו or בה, v. בהי, בהל) to run to and fro, be agitated.
sense.notes: Part. בָּיֵיךְ, f. בָּיְיכָא. Gen. R. s. 87, beg. (expl. הומיה וכ' Prov. VII, 1

בייכא היא וטעיא Ar. (ed. שגשיא; Yalk. Prov. 940 בוכה, corr. acc.) she runs about (revelling) &c. Y. Taan. II, 65 b (ref. to Mic. VII, 4) (read:) מן גו דא אנן בָּיְיכִין ובכון וכ' therefore we are now in trouble. And they wept &c. Ruth. R. s. 3 (before I, 18) קל ברייתא בייבין (read בייכין) the sound of people runing in excitement (on business).
, v. בּוּכְנָא
; v. P. Sm. I 526 sq.)
Succ. 52 a; Snh. 99 b חוט של ב' the thread of the shuttle [or spider-web]. [Snh. l. c. כוביא, Mss. vary betw. כוביא a. כוכיא q. v.]—[
]—Cmp. בִּיכַי.

sense.definition: (v. preced.; ר formative, cmp. חליטר) the weaver’s clue.
sense.notes: Sabb. 96 b ed. a. Ar. (Ms. M. בוב', Ms. Oxf. בּוּכְיָיאר, Ar. Var. בּוּכְיָאן).
, Y. Shek. VII, beg. 50 c, v. כּוֹכְלְיָיס

sense.definition: (Syr. בוקלא; בכן, בקל √בך, בק to split; cmp. Ges. H. Dict. s. v. בכא)
a club, a stripped smooth pole, bar.
sense.notes: Erub. 102 a ב' קאמרת (Ar. ed. Koh. בכנא) you speak of a club (with a handle used as a door-bar).— Pl. בּוּכָאנֵי. B. Kam. 93 b it says (in the Mish.), ‘If one robbed pieces of wood and made utensils out of them’ בב' דהיינו וכ' Ar. (ed. ב' with one ב, Ms. H. בביכאני) it means that he made them into clubs, that is ‘he polished them’.

sense.definition:
esp. a club (with handles) used as a pestle for crushing olives &c. Sabb. 77 b (playful etymology) בוכנא ב̇ו̇א ואכ̇נה (Ar.
ed. Koh. בוכאנא) it is called bukhana, ‘come and I shall strike’.
sense.notes: Y. Bets. I, 60 c bot. ובוכנה דו כתת ביה and concerning a club, for he pounds with it; Y. Sabb. XVII, 16 b top במכונה (read בבוכנה). Nidd. 36 b I am ב' דפרזלא וכ' an iron pestle which breaks the copper mortar. Bets. 14 a בו' (Ar. ed. Koh. בכ').—Trnsf. the rib resting in the pelvis, hip-joint. Ḥull. 52 a, v. אֲסיתָא.

sense.definition: (preced.) the peduncle (or upper stem) deeply seated in the Ethrog (like the rib in the pelvis).
sense.notes: Succ. 35 b בּוּכְנָתוֹ, expl. פִּיטֵּם.

Targ. Ex. XII, 29; a. fr.—Ḥull. 44 b; a. fr.—B. Bath. 126 b ב' סכלא (h. בכור שוטה) foolish (wild) first-born, i.e. a first-born by his mother but not by his father (having no privileges).— Pl. בּוּכְרַיָּא, בּוּכְרִין. Targ. Ps. CXXXV, 8; a. e.—Fem. בּוּכְרְתָא. Ber. 6 a ב' בת ב' a first-born cat whose mother is a first-born.—[
Pl. בּוּכְרֵי first fruits. Targ. Y. I Deut. XXXIII, 14. (Targ. Y. II. בִּכְרָא).]

sense.definition: (v. preced.) the first, i.e. lowest layer in the clay dam; v. אַרְכַּבְתָּא.
sense.notes: B. Mets. 103 b

sense.definition: ( m. pl.?) f. (baccar, baccaris; βάκχαρις = ἄσαρον; v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Asaron, Löw Pfl. p. 370) baccar, an aromatic plant supposed to be hazelwort or spike-nard.
sense.notes: Shebi. VII, 2 (Ms. M. כובריא). Tosef. Kil. III, 12 בורכייר ed. Zuck. (oth. ed. ברכוייר, ברכוייד).
[Y. Snh. X, 27 d קום ב' read כּוּל.]

sense.definition: something kneaded together, a handful, ball, lump.
sense.notes: Sabb. 67 b; 128 b ב' של מלח a lump of salt. B. Mets. 90 a ב' מאותו המין a handful (fodder) of the same species; v. infra.— Pl. בּוּלוֹת, בּוּלִים, בּוּלִין clods, v. next w.—Gen. R. s. 13 ב' ב' של אדמה clods of moist ground. Num. R. s. 2 sand is thrown into the fire ומוציאו בולים and he brings it out as lumps (of glass); v. בּוּלָס.
Lev. R. s. 22 (expl. בול הרים Job XL, 20); Tanḥ. Pinḥ. 12.

sense.definition: (prob. fr. נבל) Bul, the biblical name for the eighth month (Marḥeshvan); v. מַרְחֶשְׁוַן.
sense.notes: R. Hash. I, 56 d bot. (etym. of בול) שהעלה נובלת וכ' the leaves decay and the ground is cloddy; v. preced.—Tanḥ. Noaḥ 11, the month is named bul, ירח שבוללין לבהמות וכ' the month when cattle is given mixed fodder from what is in the house; Pesik. R. s. 7.
, v. בּוּלִי

Y. Taan. IV, 69 a ארכינטס וב' (corr. acc.) archont or senator; v. בּוּלֶבְטֵס.— Pl. בּוּלְבּוּטֵי. Gitt. 36 b sq. (explain. פרוסבול) פרוס בולי ובוטי (prob. a Babyl. corruption of בולי בולבוטי πρὸς βουλῇ βουλευτῶν) before the council of senators. Ib. 37 a (as if two words) בולי ובו' וכ' bulé are the rich, bute (as if fr. בטט, play on עבט) the poor (broken ones).

sense.definition: (βολβός, bulbus) in gen. bulbous root, esp. bulbus, a delicious kind of onion, or musk-hyacinth.
sense.notes: — Pl. (בולפ') בּוּלְבְּסִין. Y. Dem. II, 22 c bot. (ed. כולכסין, corr. acc.). Ukts. III, 2 בולבסין Var. in Ar. s. v. בלפסין (ed. בלוסין, כלוסין; Maim: ענב אלדיב = Solanum nigrum, v. Löw Pfl. p. 296 a. 393). [Gen. R. s. 41 בולבוס some ed., read: בולמוס.]

sense.definition: (incorr. … טוס) m. (βουλευτής, v. בולבוטס) senator, councilman.
sense.notes: Gen. R. s. 76 this one is rich נעבדיניה בל' (Yalk. Dan. 1064 בולטוס, corr. acc.) let us make him a senator (to ruin him, v. ארכונטוס). Koh. R. beg. בלווטוס (corr. acc.); Cant. R. beg. בוליוטוס.—Sifré Deut. 309 בליוסטוס, בלאיוסטוס; Yalk. ib. 942 בליוסטוס, corr. acc.— Pl. בּוּלֶוְוטִין, בּוּלֶבְטֵי, טַיָּיא …, טַיָּיה … Y. Ḥag. II, 77 d bot. Lam. R. to II, 2. Ibid, לאיבדא (לע') בוליוטין, read לאיעבדא בוליוטיס; v. אַרְכוֹנְטוֹס. Y. Peah I, 16 a בולווטיה דציפורין the council of Sepphoris. Lev. R. s. 11 אלו הבוליותוס (read … טין). Y. Sabb. XII, 13 c bot.; Y. Hor. III, end, 48 c בולווטייא family heads entitled to seats in the Bulé of Sepphoris.
, v. בּוּלְבּוֹס
, v. בַּלְדָּר
, v. בּוּלֶבְטֵס
, v. בּוּלָס

sense.definition: (בלט, v. בלל; P. Sm. 533) crumbling, corrosion, being worm-eaten.
sense.notes: Targ. Job XLI, 19 קיסא ב' (read דב') worm-eaten wood. Targ. Prov. XXV, 20; XII, 4 Ms. (ed. מַלְטִיתָא, Pesh. בל').

sense.definition: Buli (prob. the assembly building of the Senate in Sepphoris, cmp. בּוּלֶבְטֵס end).
sense.notes: Y. Shek. VII, 50 c bot. (Bab. ed. כולי, oth. כולית', קוליתא, ed. Just. ב'; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. p. 62, note 30); Y. Taan. I, 64 a bot. כנישתא דב' assembly (or synagogue) of B.—Y. Ab. Zar. III, 43 b bot. צלמא דב' (ed. Krot. דכ') a statue (idol) in front of the Bulé(?).

sense.definition: (βουλή) council, assembly, esp. senate, city council.
sense.notes: Y. Peah I, 15 c top בפני כל ב' שלו in the presence of the whole council over which he presided; Y. Kidd. I, 61 b top. Ib. פטר ב', v. פַּטְרוֹבּוּלֹוס. Y. Yoma I, 39 a top כולי (corr. acc.). Y. M. Kat. II, 81 b אם הזכירוך לב' וכ' if they have mentioned (nominated) thee for the bulé, let the Jordan be thy neighbor, i.e. hide thyself in the bushes near the Jordan. Ib. להפטר מב' to be exempt from serving in the bulé; Y. Snh. VIII, 26 b top. Gen. R. s. 6 ב' ודימוס senate and people (senatus populusque). Ex. R. s. 15 וכן דימוס וכן כולם (read בולי) and so did the people and so the senate. Gitt. 37 a, v. בּוּלְבּוּטֵס.— Pl. בּוֹלִייּוֹת, בּוֹלָאוֹת. Y. Ned. III, 38 a top; Y. Shebu. III, 34 d bot. כ"ד ב' twenty four city councils, i.e. cities or districts having their own councilmen; [Tanḥ. Vayikra 7; Matt. 1 ב' אלפים עיירות]; Pesik. R. s. 22 אלות (read בולאות). Gitt. 37 a
, v. בּוּלֶבְטֵיס
, v. בּוּרְגִּין
, v. בּוּלָס

sense.definition: (βούλιμος, bulimus) ravenous hunger, bulimy, esp. faintness from fasting.
sense.notes: Yoma VIII, 6 (83 a). Koh. R. to VII, 11 (some ed. incorr. … ות); a. fr.—Trnsf. ב' של עריות morbid carnal appetite, sexual passion. Gen. R. s. 51; s. 41; a. e.

sense.definition: (בלס; cmp. ὕαλος, ὕελος) a shapeless mass, a glass-ball.
sense.notes: Num. R. s. 2 ומוציאו בולים (v. בּוּל II, some ed. בוליס). Y. Ber. I, 2 d top נוסך כלים (corr. acc.); Gen. R. s. 12 מוצק כלים read: נוסך ב', v. Ar.) casts a lense; v. אֲנַנְקֵי.—Pesik. Par. p. 39 b גלויים לכם כהדין ב'; Pesik. R. s. 14; Yalk. Num. 759 צפים כהדין ב' perspicuous (clear) as crystal; cmp. Num. R. s. 19 כהדין סמיא a. Mat. Keh. a. l.

sense.definition: , esp. glass-lump, unshaped and prepared for casting into vessels.
sense.notes: Sabb. 154 b בבלוסא Ar. (ed. בכולסא, read as Rashi a. Ms. בבולסא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note

sense.definition: what is meant here are glass lumps (which may be broken without loss).— Pl. בּוּלְסַיָּיא, בּוּלְסִין crystals or glass vessels.
sense.notes: Y. Kidd. I, 60 c top אילין ב' those glass vessels (what is the law concerning their division among heirs)? Ib. חכים … בולסיין סגין (corr. acc.) thou art known to have plenty of glass vessels.
, v. בּוֹרְסִיף
, Tosef. Kil. III, 12, v. בּוּלְבּוֹס
, Y. Taan. II, 66 a, v. כַּלְקִיס

sense.definition: (follis, follera; v. next w. a. Sm. Ant. s. v. Senatus) follera, name of a Roman land-tax, adopted by the Persians.
sense.notes: B. Kam. 113 b בב' וכרגא וכ' Ar. (ed. דברלא ארעא וכרגא, read בב' ארנונא וכ', Ms. M. בכולארא וכ', Ms. R. בכלודא וארנונא ואכרגא, corr. acc.) with reference to follera, annona and charga of the ensuing year.
Cant. R. to I, 1 if one drops סלע או ב' (Ar. ed. Koh. בלורין, ed. כילרין) a Sela or (even) a folleron. V. פּוֹלָר.
Gen. R. s. 8, v. בלורין
, v. בֵּלְשָׁפָט

sense.definition: Bun, abbrev. of אַבּוּן; name of several Amoraim.
sense.notes: Y. Shek. IV, end, 48 c ר' אבון ור' ב'. Y. Ber. III, 6 c בין some ed. (corr. acc.); a. fr.—Y. R. Hash. I, 56 c top, a. fr. R. B. bar Ḥiya.—Y. Ter. VIII, 45 c, a. fr. R. B. bar Kahana; v. Fr. M’bo p. 67 b sq.

sense.definition: pl. בּוּנֵי a handful, v. כּוּנָא.
sense.notes: —Sabb. 67 a ב' כמוניא, v. also בִּינְתָא I.
of אַבּוּנָה. Y. Gitt. II, 44 b ב' בר שילא (ed. Krot. בינה שילוח, v. marginal note a. l.).

sense.definition: Buni or Bunai; 1) name of one of the alleged disciples of Jesus of Nazareth.

sense.notes: name of one of the alleged disciples of Jesus of Nazareth. Snh. 43 a Ms. M. a. ed. Ven. (omitted in later ed., v. Graetz Gesch. d. Jud. III (2 d ed.) p. 243; Rœsch Jesusmythen p. 99).
name of a pious and liberal man, otherwise named Nakdimon. Taan. 20 a
Ḥull. 62 b ed. (Ar. כַּנְיָא).
, v. בָּסַס
, v. בַּסְיָא
Snh. 108 a מקום הב' (Var. מבושם) place for spices, opp. מקום הטנופת.—[Tosef. Kidd. II, 4 נעשה בוסם, ed. Zuck., read בַּסָּם.]
Targ. Ex. XXX, 25; a. fr.— Pl. בּוּסְמִין, בּוּסְמַיָּא, בּוּשְׂ', בֻּסְ', בֻּשְׂ'. Ib. 27; 34; a. fr.
— Pl. בּוּסְמָנִין, constr. בּוּסְמָנֵי. Num. R. s. 13 ב' ג"ע (some ed. בִּי') the aromas of paradise (carried by winds).
. Targ. II, Esth. I, 2. V. בּוּסְמָנַיָּא.

sense.definition: (preced.) art of making perfumes, Targ. O. Ex. XXX, 25; a. e.
(preced. ws.) aromas, ointments &c. Targ. I Kings X, 10.
sense.notes: Targ. Ruth. III, 3; a. e.

Shebi IV, 8 הב' משהביא וכ' the boser from the time it contains liquid. Gitt. III, 8 (31 a) בשעת כניסת המים בב' when the liquid is beginning to gather in the boser; (oth. opin. when it can be put in water for making vinegar; v. Rashi a. l.). Pes. 53 a הוא ב' וכ' boser indicates the same stage of ripening as gerua, v. גָּרַע Hif. Y. Maasr. I, 49 a top; Succ. 36 a אתרוג הב' a half-ripe Ethrog. Y. B. Kam. VI, 5 b bot.; a. fr.
Targ. Ps. LVIII, 10 (h. text חַי); a. e.
Targ. Ezek. VII, 19.
Sabb. 30 b. Erub. 25 b.— Pl. בּוּסְתָּנֵי. B. Bath. 61 b.—Targ. II Esth. III, 8 בּוּסְתְּנָנָא our orchards (collect.).
, v. בִּסְתְּקָא

sense.definition: (√בע, cmp. נבע, בץ, בט) to swell, burst forth, whence (of sound) to shout, rejoice.
sense.notes: Targ. Is. XIV, 7 (h. text פצח). Ib. LXV, 19; a. fr.—Part. f. בְּיָעָא. Ib. 18 (Var. בִּיעָא).

sense.definition: (v. preced.) swelling, abscess, mostly applied to tubercles of the lungs.
sense.notes: Ḥull. 46 b sq.; a. fr. V. בּוּעֲתָא I.
, v. next w.
Targ. Is. XXX, 17 (Var. בועדא, v. also בּוּעֲתָא III). Targ. Job XII, 5 (Var. בעו'). V. בָּעוּר.
Snh. 84 b למיפתח בוע' Ar. (Var. Ar. בותא, ed. כוותא) to cut open an abscess. [Targ. Prov. XXIII, 29 (Var. פודעתא).— Pl. בּוּעֲתָתָא. Ib. XX, 30 (Var. פודעתא).]
Targ. Job XX, 5. Targ. Ps. XLIII, 4 בָּעוּתִי (prob. בּוּעָ').
Targ. Is. XXX, 17 Ar. ed. pr. (h. תֹּרֶן, taken fr. רנן; oth. ed. Ar. בועדא, Targ. ed. בֹּועֲרָא q. v.).

sense.definition: (cmp. בּוּעַ) to swell, bubble, burst forth, shine.
sense.notes: Pilp. בִּצְבֵּץ.
Yoma VII, 1 (68 b sq.), v. בַּד IV; a. e.
ch.

sense.definition: same. Targ. Esth. VIII, 15. Targ. Gen. XLI, 42; a. e.— Pl. בּוּצִין.
sense.notes: Targ. Job XVIII, 13 Ms. Var. (ed. בּוּצְנִין) linen garments (h. text בַּדֵּי).
Targ. Is. XLII, 3; XLIII, 17 (Var. בוצין; h. text פשתה).
, Tosef. Sabb. VII (VIII), 1 a word in a charm formula; v. יממיא
, v. בִּיצִיתָא
a plur. of בּוּצָא)

—In gen. candle, lamp, light. Targ. I Sam. III, 3; a. e.—Cant. R. to III, 4 (expl. Is. XXI, 5) אקימת מנרתא אדליקת ב' thou hast put up the lamp, lighted the wicks. Sabb. 30 a לכבות ב' דנורא to put out a lamp (Ms. M. omits דנורא).—Snh. 14 a ב' דנהורא bright light (wise man). Gen. R. s. 85 (play on שוע, Gen. XXXVIII, 2, v. שַׁעֲוָה) ב' דאתרא the light of the town (leader); a. fr.— Pl. בֹּוצִינַיָּא. Targ. Ex. XXX, 7 sq.; a. e.

sense.definition: (in Bab. dialect; cmp. בטי) a young pumpkin, contrad. to קרא the full-grown one.
sense.notes: Ber. 48 a (prov.) ב' ב' מקיניה ידיע Ar. a. Rashi (ed. מקטפיה; Ms. M. בוצינא מקיטפיה ידע, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the young pumpkin is known by its shaft [by what oozes out of it, מקיטפיה], i.e. the future scholar is recognized by his utterings in childhood. Succ. 56 b a young pumpkin (now) is better than a large one (later); (differ. in Tosaf. a. l.); a. e.— Pl. בֹּוצִינַיָּא, בֹּוצִינֵי. Targ. O. Num. XI, 5.—Ned. 66 b (a misunderstanding of בוציני betw. a Babylonian husband and a Palestinean wife). Yoma 78 a מצטנן בב' Ms. M. (ed. בינוקא) cooled his hands with young pumpkins.—Meg. 12 a sq. (prov.) איהו בקרי וכ' (Var. בי וכו'; Sot. 10 a בי קארי וכ') the husband between the old pumpkins, his wife between the young ones, i.e. a faithless husband makes a faithless wife.—
Pes. 94 b (Var. סדנא).
, v. בִּיצּ'

— Pl. בּוּצְלַיָּא, בּוּצְלֵי, בָּצְ'. Targ. Num. XI, 5.—Kidd. 62 a; a. e.—Y. Shebi. II, 34 a bot. ב' כופריא וכ' country onions which mature no seeds; Gen. R. s. 82, v. בָּצֵל. *Ib. s. 95, end וקלף ב' peel the onions (i.e. take all we have); [the passage seems to be corrupt; the explanation beginning with פי' is a glossator’s note].—Kidd. 62 b; v. next w.
Kidd. 62 b; v. אֲגַם II.

sense.definition: linen garment; pl. בּוּצְנִין, v. בּוּצָא.

sense.notes: , v. יממיא
, v. next ws.

sense.definition: , v. בצר) Bozrah (Fortress), an Idumean town, the home of several scholars.
sense.notes: Y. Naz. VII, 56 a bot.—Denomin.
Y. Ned. VI, beg. 39 c. Cant. R. to VII, 1. Lam. R. to IV, 20 בָּצְרָאָה.—Fem. h. בֹּוצְרִית. Y. Bicc. III, beg. 65 c a Bozrah fig.
, v. בַּצֹּורְתָּא

sense.definition: (cmp. אָבִיק, b. h. בַּקְבּוּק for which LXX, βύκος, βίκος; cmp. בועא, בוצין)

sense.notes: — Pl. בּוּקֵי. Ab. Zar. 37 b, a. e. לא תתלו ביה ב' וכ' hang not empty pitchers on R. N., i.e. do not pronounce him the author of such an absurdity; a. fr.
Ḥull. 42 b; 54 ab; v. אַטְמָא. [Ar. s. v. פטם quotes בוכנא.]
Yeb. 84 a

sense.definition: (βουκκίων, bucco; v. Sachs Beitr. II, 121; Sm. Ant. s. v. Atellanæ Fabulæ) bucco, the clown in the Atellanæ Fabulæ of the Romans.
sense.notes: Ab. Zar. 18 b; Tosef. ib. II, 6 ב' ומוקיון; Y. ib. I, 40 a מוקיון מופיון (corr. acc.) Bucco and Macchus.

sense.definition: (bucina, βυκάνη) bucinæ, horns used in the Roman camps to proclaim the watches of the day and the night.
sense.notes: Cant. R. to I, 12 he appointed over them (read:) קלאנין בב' ושופר (v. Yalk. Cant. 983) criers with bucinæ and Shofar. Lev. R. s. 29; Pesik. Baḥod. p. 152 a; Yalk. Lev. 645; Num. 782; Ps. 840 (corr. acc.). [Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXXI, 4 ספק ידים, read קרנות ב' וסלפינגין.]
, v. בַּקְלָסָא
, v. בֹּקֶר
, v. בִּקְתָא end.

sense.definition: (√בה, v. בהה) to be empty, waste, uncultivated.
sense.notes: Y. Dem. VI, 25 b top שלא תָבוּר א"י in order that Palestine should not lie waste. Ib. יובירו ואל וכ'; (read as) Y. Ab. Zar. I, end, 40 b יָבוּרוּ let them rather lie waste than rent them to a gentile.—Part. בָּר, בָּרָה a. בֹּורָה. B. Mets. 101 a שתהא ברה בידו in order that the field may rather lie waste in his own possession; cmp. Y. l. c. [Rashi fr. ברר to be clear and firm in his possession, by buying it back from the gentile. R. Ḥan., in Tosaf. a. l., בֹּורָה, lying waste in the gentile’s possession; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90.] B. Bath. 168 a לא צריכא [דאפי'] בבורה (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) it means to say that even in the case of an unbroken field being rented, the tenant has to pay the scribe’s fees; Rashi: even if the field will have to lie fallow for some time to come yet. [Cmp. part. fem. חֹולָה fr. חוּל.]

sense.definition: a. הֹובִיר (fr. יבר, or אבר) to let lie waste; to neglect.
sense.notes: Arakh. IX, 1 (29 b) הֵבִירָהּ (הֹו') if he let it untilled. Ex. R. s. 27, end הֹובִירָהּ. B. Mets. IX, 3 הו' (Y. ed. הב'). Gen. R. s. 82 מֵבִירָן (מוֹבִירָן; Koh. R. to IV, 6 מְבַיְּירָן Pi.).

sense.definition: same. Koh. R. l. c., v. supra. Ex. R. s. 32 (play on same.
sense.notes: Koh. R. l. c., v. supra. Ex. R. s. 32 (play on שית in אשיתך Jer. III, 19) בִּיַּירְתֶּם עצמיכם ye neglected yourselves (mentally).—

sense.definition: (denom. of בּוֹר II or בִּיר) to prepare a pitfall, to entrap.
sense.notes: Lev. R. s. 19; v. בִּירָנִית 2).

ch. as preced. Kal. Targ. O. Gen. XLVII, 19.—Part. בָּיִיר. Taan. 6 b לא בָּיְירֵי וכ' the halls (academies) are not empty (oth. expl.: the gardens do not lie waste). Lev. R. s. 1, beg. he sees חקליה בָּיְירָה וכ' (Var. ביירא) his field waste (in the Sabbath year) &c.
as preced. Hif.—B. Mets. IX, 3; Ib. 104 b אי מֹובַרְנָא לה if I should let it lie waste.
Targ. Jer. X, 14 (h. text נבער).

sense.definition: something waste, wild-growing, whence weed, brier.
sense.notes: Targ. Is. VII, 23; a. e. (always with הֹובַאי q. v.; h. text שמיר ושית).
Pl. בּוּרִין. Koh. R. to I, 18 the one ate מלין ב' coarse food.

sense.definition: (v. בּוּר I) uncultivated, an uncultured person, mannerless, ruffian.
sense.notes: Aboth. II, 5; a. fr.—Mikv. IX, 6 של בור, v. בַּנָּאִים.— Pl. בֹּורִים. Num. R. s. 3, beg.

sense.definition:
(rarely fem.) (b. h.; v. בּוּר I a.
בְּאֵר)

sense.notes: Erub. II, 4 contrad. to בְּאֵר, v. ib. 18 a ב' מכונסין … באר מים חיים.—B. Bath. 64 a ב' בחפירה bor means a pit or well gained by mere digging (without masonry), v. דּוּת. B. Kam. V, 5 (50 b), a. fr. ב' שיח ומערה a narrow pit (about ten hand-breadths deep), a lengthy ditch, and a spacious cavity. Y. Sot. II, 18 a, v. בְּאֵר. B. Kam. 6 a ב' תוכיח the word bor proves. Taan. 8 a, v. חוּלְדָּה.—Trnsf. obstacle, danger (v. Ex. XXI, 33 sq.). B. Kam. 6 a ב' המתגלגל a moving danger (e.g. a rolling stone).—ב' וסירה, v. סִירָה.—ב' הגדול the Large Well, ב' הגולה the Pilgrims’ Well, names of cisterns in the Temple premises. Erub. X, 14; Midd. V, 4.—ב' ספינה אלכסנדרית the tank of sweet water in Alexandrian merchantmen. Ohol. VIII, 1; Sabb. 35 a; a. e.—[Ib. 77 b ב' זינקא, v. בּוּרְזִינְקָא.]

sense.definition: a receptacle for oil or wine in the press.
sense.notes: Maasr. IV, 1 כב' קטן like an oil tank on a small scale. Ab. Zar. IV, 8 עד שירד לב' until the wine comes into the tank.— Pl. בּוֹרוֹת. B. Bath. 17 b; a. fr.—Erub. 104 b ב' הקרות, v. הָקֵר.—[Y. Snh. I, 19 a bot. אני ובורך = ובוראך I and thy Creator.]
Ab. IV, 22; a. fr. Y. Snh. I, 19 a bot., v. preced.
Targ. Prov. XII, 1; XXX, 2 (h. text בַּעַר).— Pl. [בּוּרֵי. Ib. XXII, 3 Ms. a. ed. Ven. prob. a gloss for ושברי.] בּוּרַיָּא. Lev. R. s. 18, beg. (opp. חבריא).
Sabb. 103 a לב' דקרא Ar. (ed. Koh. לבֵירָא, ed. בִּיזְרָא q. v.).
Ib. 140 b Rashi, Var. (prob. cler. error; ed. כורא), v. בִּזְרָא.
, v. כּוֹרַבְלִין

sense.definition: (πυργίον, πύργος) burgus) little turret, isolated place of residence, often used as a station for travellers ( castellum; v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Mansio).
sense.notes: Lev. R. s. 7 הגיע לב' וכ' he arrived at the first station &c.; Pesik. Eth. Korb. p. 61 a Ar. (ed. בורגנין, Yalk. Lev. 479, end כור דגן, corr. acc.). Midr. Till. to Ps. X, 1.— Pl. בּוּרְגְּנִים, בּוּרְגְּנִין. Y. Meg. IV, 75 c bot. הדר בב' he who takes lodging in &c. (contrad. to פונדקי).—Y. Erub. V, 22 b bot. ע"י מערות וב' on account of a connected Sabbath line by means of underground walks and of turrets; (Tosef. ib. VI (V), 8 מגדלות). Erub. 21 a אין ב' בבבל the law as to stations in the neighborhood of towns eventually counted as outskirts for measuring Sabbath limits, cannot be applied to Babylon &c. Ib. 55 b והב' שבתוכן Ms. M. (ed. שבתוכה) and the station houses in the fields (containing provision and lodging rooms). Maasr. III, 7, v. אִלְקָטִית. Mekh. Yith. Baḥod. 1 הרי … את הבּוּרְגְּסִין ואת הבורגמין וכ' (read ואת הבּוּרְגִּינִין) ye are now forced to keep in repair the large and small stations for those going to the royal vineyards (prob. to be read כרכים fortresses).—Lev. R. s. 37; Erub. 64 b; Y. Ab. Zar. I, 40 a bot. (בורנין, corr. acc.); Tosef. Pes. I (II), 27 מעיירות (הללו) של ב' אני I am one of those station guards. Lam. R. to I, 4 it does not read (the roads are in mourning) מבלי ב' מבלי בוליטין (Ar. בליוטין, read בַּלִּיסְטִין) because they are not guarded with turrets and catapults. [Midr. Till. l. c. הבורגן, v. בּוּרְגָּנִי.]
, v. preced.
, v. בּוּרְגִּין a. next art.
, v. next w.

sense.definition: (denom. of בורגין) keeper or resident of a station house.
sense.notes: Midr. Till. to Ps. X, 1 when it grew dark, בא לו הבורגן (read … ני) the burgani came to him. Ib. חזר … אצל הב' he turned back and came to the burgani. Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 43 d אתא גביה בורגנה ed. Krot. (oth. ed. בורגנרה, read בורגני or בורגרי) a station guardsman (burgarius) came to him.
, v. preced.
Gen. R. s. 36; v. next w.—V. preced.
Gen. R. s. 36 Noah is called ‘a man of the ground’ (Gen. IX, 20) בורגר לשם ב' as the burgarius is called by the name of the castle; (Yalk. Gen. 61 בורגרתֵיה, Ar. תֵה … his station).

sense.definition: Burgatha, Barkatha, a Galilean place north of Samaria; v. Neub. Géogr. p. 173.
sense.notes: Y. Ab. Zar. V, 44 d; Bab. ib. 31 a ברק'.

sense.definition: (Parthicus, Πάρθικος) scarlet-colored (sub. pellis, δέρμα) leather, scarlet-dyed dress.
sense.notes: Y. Keth. XII, 35 a top אלבישוני ב' וכ' dress me in scarlet (which is) neither white nor dark; Y. Kil. IX, 32 b top ביריריקא; Gen. R. s. 96 צבועים דבריקא; ib. s. 100 מאנין דבריקה. Yalk. Job 924 בורקיא (for which Sabb. 114 a בגדי האולרין). Cmp. אוֹלָרִין a. חִימּוּצָתָא.
Pes. 40 b, v. אַכְוַנְגַּר

sense.definition: (a corrupt. of flagellum, cmp. פַּרְגַּל; late Lat. burdillus; cmp. late Greek βουρδουλίζειν, Sachs Beitr. II, 88 note) club, whip.
sense.notes: — Pl. בּוּרְדְּלִין blows, lashes. Pesik. B’shall. p. 81 b; Yalk. Ex. 225 בורלודין (corr. acc.; Mekh. B’shall. 1 מכות).—בַּרְדִּילַיָּא. Num. R. s. 13 חמית שוטיא וב' she beheld the rods and whips.

sense.definition: (comp. of בּוֹר a. דָּם) [ well of blood,] dysentery, bloody flux.
sense.notes: Ned. 41 b ב' אין מבקרין ואין מזכירין שמו (Ar. ברדס … אותו) we must not visit (one afflicted with) burdam, nor mention its (real) name. [Rashi quotes a vers. בורדס.]
, v. preced.
, v. בִּרְדְּסִין
Pes. 40 b, v. אַכְוַנְגַּר
—דברי ב' unmeaning things, nonsense. Nidd. 69 b; 70 b

sense.definition: (a comp. of בור a. זינקא, v. זנק) a leaping well, i.e. a well which springs forth periodically to disappear again (v. Is. LVIII, 11).
sense.notes: Sabb. 77 b ed. in two words (corr. acc.; cmp. בּוּרְדָּם; Ms. M. בור זיקנא, corr. acc.), phonetic etymol. בור זה נקי this well is empty. [Syr. בר זנקא ocrea, בור זינקא tiara, P. Sm. 586 sq., Nöld. Mand. Gr. p. 20 (cmp. בֵּירִית, בּוּרְכַּיָּיר) have nothing to do with our w.]

sense.definition: (a corrupt. of verutum, βηρύττα, S.) spit.
sense.notes: Sabb. 146 a למיברז … בב' to break open a barrel (of dates) by jamming a spit between the splices (Ms. M. קורבוי', Alf. ed. Cost. בּרְזִיתָא). Snh. 27 b top קתא דב' the handle of a burtya.

sense.definition: , pl. בּוֹרָאוֹת, בּוֹרָייוֹת (בּוּר I) trees which fail to thrive after transplantation.
sense.notes: B. Bath. 95 a מקבל עליו עשר ב' למאה Ms. H. a. Ar. (ed. בורייות, בוריות, Ms. M. טראות לסאה corr. acc.) the owner must be prepared for ten failures out of one hundred trees planted (and has no claim on the contractor).

Y. Gitt. VII, 48 c bot. נשתתק מתוך בּוֹרְיוֹ lost his speech while in his normal health (suddenly), opp. מתון חוליו. Y. Nidd. I, 49 b; Y. Keth. V, 30 a bot. פירש מתוך (בָּרְיוֹ) בוריו the child ceased to suck while in normal health. Mekh. Mishp. N’zikin. 6; Y. Keth. IV, 28 c top (expl. על משענתו Ex. XXI, 19 ‘on his own support’) על בוריו restored to his former health. Mekh. l. c. 13 על בריו.
Y. Sot. I, 16 d עמדי על בורייך stand by thy assertion (be not intimidated). Gen. R. s. 70 מעמידין אותו על בוריו they establish it (the law) on its strength, i.e. arrive at a final decision.
Targ. O. Ex. XXI, 19 על בּוּרְיֵיה, v. preced.

sense.definition: (v. בַּר I; = h. חוֹצֶלֶת, מַחֲצֶלֶת) reed-matting used for partitions, coverings &c. [Var.
sense.notes: בּוּדְיָא, against Syr. בוריא a. best Mss., v. בַּד III.] Succ. 20 b מסככין בב' Ms. M. 2 (ed. a. Ar. with ד, Ms. M. 1 בכ') you may cover the festive booth with matting. Bekh. 8 b. B. Mets. 67 b תמרי דאבודיא ed. (Ms. M. דעל בורי', v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) dates spread on mattings. Erub. 8 a an alley כריך ב' (with ד, ed., Ms. M. with ר) surrounded by a partition of matting.—Ib. 102 a זיל כרוך ב' וכ' go and fold the matting up (for the night), but leave a handbreadth of it spread.— Pl. בּוּרְיָתָא. Succ. l. c. Ms. M. בוריתא a. ביריתא (Ms. M. 2 בריתא).
, v. בָּרַק

sense.definition: a sort of soap, lixivium, Nidd. IX, 6.
sense.notes: Sabb. IX, 5. Ib. 90 a; Nidd. 62 a, v. אֳהָל, אַהֲלָא, זֵיתָא II a. כַּבְרִיתָא. Kerith. 6 a ב' כרשינה a borith won out of a leek.

sense.notes: Keth. 63 b; Ḥull. 88 b; Shebu. 12 b הא ב' this is entirely unfounded (or absurd). מאי בורכתיה (… תא) wherein does its absurdity (or hollowness) consist?—[בּוּרְכָּא knee, shoot, v. בִּרְכָּא.].

sense.definition: (ברם = פרם, cmp. P. Sm. I, 616) a wedge.
sense.notes: Lam. R. to III, 12, v. אִסְפְּרִיסָא.

sense.definition: (ברני) f. (Λιβυρνίς, sub. ναῦς) Liburnian ( ship), a light fast-sailing vessel.
sense.notes: Targ. Is. XXXIII, 21; Yoma 77 b (citation of Targ. l. c.). R. Hash. 23 a. B. Mets. 80 b ג' כורין לב' וכ' an addition of three khor is a culpable overload for a large liburna. [Y. Kidd. I, 61 a bot. בורניות, v. בִּרְיוֹן.] [Targ. Y. Gen. XXXVI, 2 בורנייתא some ed., v. כּוּדְנָא.]
Snh. 32 b
, v. בִּירַנְתָּא. [Y. Ab. Zar. I, 40 a bot., v. בּוּרְגִּין.]
M. Kat. 4 b ed. (Ms. M. בורנינין or בורניניץ; oth. var., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).

Keth. 77 a ב' גדול a tanner on a large scale, ב' קטון on a small scale (who collects the excrements himself). Tosef. Kidd. II, 2; 4 בורסקי ed. Zuck. (Var. בורסי). Pes. 65 a; Kidd. 82 b; a. fr.— Pl. בּוּרְסִיִּים. Succ. 51 b Ms. M. (ed. טַרְסִיִּים).
pl. Bursi, prob. identical with בּוֹרְסִיף q. v. Kidd. 72 a
Y. Sabb. V, 7 b bot. עור מכורסינין (corr. acc.) hide from the tannery.
