XXIII, 14 אנת ביר וכ' Ms. (missing in ed.), read: גיר (as in Peshito) thou, therefore, &c.]

sense.definition: or גור to boil, effervesce, v. H.
sense.notes: , v. H. Dict. s. v.)

Sabb. 80 b ביצת הג' Ar. (ed. הסיד), v. בֵּיצָה.—Denom. גִּיֵּיר to plaster. Lam. R. to IV, 11 Ar. (ed. סייד).—Ḥull. 88 b bot. הג' והזרניך quot. in Rashi to Ex. XVI, 14 (ed. only הז') powdered lime and orpiment.

sense.definition: ink-stone, or sulphate of iron ( sory).
sense.notes: Bets. 15 a ביצת הג' a lump of ink-stone (for blackening leather).—In gen. powder, in compounds גִּירְגִּבְסִין powder of gypsum ; גִּירְקְרָרִין wax dust, v. אַגֵּין. Y. Sabb. VII, 10 b bot. (perh. to be read in two words: lime, gypsum &c.).
Men. VIII, 7 (87 a) זרק הג' (Mish. ז' את הגיד, corr. acc.) if the froth (of the fermenting wine) burst forth; Tosef. ib. IX, 11 ג' של שמרים.

Dan. V, 5.—Targ. O. Ex. XVI, 14 דעדק כג' thin and brittle like a coat of lime (h. text מחספס). Targ. Y. Deut. XXVII, 2 (h. text סיד); a. e.—2) froth, foam. Pl. גִּירִין Targ. Y. Ex. XV, 10 ג' דימא the foaming billows. [Targ. Jer. IX, 14, read כגידין, v. גִּידָּא II.]—3) name of a disease, a sort of fever ( ?). Gitt. 69 b, v. next w.

Targ. Is. XXXVII, 33. Targ. Job XLI, 20; a. fr.—Gitt. 56 a שדא ג' וכ' he shot an arrow eastward. B. Kam. 26 b בעידנא דשדייה פסוקי מפסקי גִירֵיה (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) at the time he let his arrow off, its force was broken, i.e. when he threw the vessel down, polsters were there to prevent its breaking. Succ. 38 a דין ג' בעיניה וכ' this is an arrow in the tempter’s eyes, i.e. this enables us to defy him. Kidd. 30 a I should say to Satan ג' בעיניך I defy thee; ib. 81 a.—Taan. 25 a אגרי בך גִירַי I shall let my arrow loose against thee (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note; oth. vers. v. גּוּר I ch.). Pes. 28 a, v. גִּירָאָה; a. fr.—ג' דלילתא (Ar. דלוליתא) the arrow of Lilith, supposed to be a wedge-shaped meteoric stone. Gitt. 69 b לגירא ליתי ג' דל' as a remedy for gira (v. preced.) let one get a gira of &c.— Pl. גִּירִין, גִּירֵי, גִּירַיָּא; גִּירְרִין, גִּירְרַיָּא. Targ. II Sam. I, 22. Targ. Y. I, II Gen. XLIX, 23 (not גיד'). Targ. Ps. CXX, 4; a. fr.—Snh. 108 b גילי והוו ג' he threw chaff and it turned into arrows. B. Bath. 73 a; v. בְּזַק. Y. ib. II, 13 b bot. מן קל גורי וכ' (corr. acc.) from the hissing sound of the arrows; a. fr.
Pl. גִּירֵי. Sabb. 109 b ג' דרוביא shoots of fenugreek; (oth. opin. in Ar. flax-seeds, Ms. O. גידא, v. גִּידָּא I).

sense.definition: (גרר; cmp. גְּרָרָא) direct consequence of an act.
sense.notes: . B. Bath. 22 b בגירי דידיה (Rashi דיליה); ib. 25 b sq. בגִירֵיה דיליה (Ms. M. only בגיריה, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); B. Mets. 117 a בגירי דיליה when the damage is a direct result of his act. Ib. 44 a גירי דידיה וכ' it is his act that helped it (to get sour). [Rashi: his arrows in a metaphorical sense, v. preced.]
pr. n. f., v. גִּילָא
. Taan. 25 a, v. גּוּר I ch.
Pes. 28 a (prov.) ג' בגִירֵיה מקטיל וכ' (ed. גירא, corr. acc., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) when the shooter (arrow-maker) is killed by his own arrow, he is paid from the spinnings of his own hand.
, v. גֵּיר II, 2).
, v. גָּרַר

Sabb. 109 b גי' דאסניתא (ed. גו' דאסינתא) the paring of &c., v. אַסְנִיתָא. Keth. 77 b, v. אַשְׁפָּא. Ab. Zar. 28 a גְּרָדָא דיבלא וגי' דאסנא (Ms. M. גררא … וגוררא, early ed. וגורדא) scraped root of cynodon and the paring of the bramble. Sot. 10 b; Num. R. s. 9 (prov.) קמי דשתי חמרא חמרא קמי רפוקא גי' דיבלא before wine drinkers, place wine; before a ploughman—a dish of scraped roots &c. V. גַּרְדָּא.
Pes. 111 b top גי' דדיקלא (Var. גידא, גודא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 30) the stem of a palm tree (Ar.: rind, v. preced.). B. Mets. 86 a (Ms. M. גידרא, Ms. R. 2 גיררא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).
Ned. 41 a
, v. גֵּרָה
, Pi. of גרי.
Sifré Deut. 87, v. הַסָּתָה; Yalk. ib. 886. Tanḥ. Balak. 2 (ref. to Deut. II, 19) כל מיני ג' any sort of provocation (is forbidden); Num. R. s. 20, beg. גירור (corr. acc.); Yalk. ib. 765.

sense.definition: (גרם) that which goes along, customary addition to weight or measure at sales.
sense.notes: B. Bath. VI, 11 נותן לו גֵּירוּמָיו (Bab. ed. 88 b מין …, Y. ed. … מים) he must give him the due surplus. Sifra K’doshim Par. 9, ch. VIII.
, v. גרמסין
, Targ. II Chr. XX, 25, some ed., read ריגונין.

sense.definition: (גָּרַע) I) deduction from the price of redemption according to the years of possession (Lev. XXVII, 18).
sense.notes: Arakh. 24 a ליגאל בג' to be redeemed with due deduction. B. Mets. 106 a the Sabbath year לא תעלה לו בג' Ar. (ed. מן הג', v. Rabb. D. S. s. l. note 90) ought not to be counted in for deduction.— Pl. גֵּירוּעִין. Y. Shebu. VI, beg. 36 d סוף גֵּירוּעֶיהָ the final redemption of the Hebrew hand-maid.

sense.definition: (גָּרַע II) the formation of globules or kernels in the grape.
sense.notes: Ber. 36 b; Pes. 53 a הוא בוסר הוא ג', v. בּוֹסֶר.
, v. גֵּירוּי
, v. גֵּרוּשִין
, v. גֵּרוּת

sense.definition: girutha, name of an unclean bird, supposed to be moor-hen.
sense.notes: Ḥull. 62 b; Nidd. 50 b expl. the hen of the marshes. Ḥull. 109 b we are forbidden ג' to eat girutha. [Ar. גּוּרִיתָא, v. Koh. Ar. Compl. II, 378 a.]

sense.definition: (denom. of גֵּר) belonging to a convert family, descendant of proselytes.
sense.notes: Kidd. IV, 1 (collectively); v. Tos’foth Yom Tob a. l. s. v. כהני.
, v. גַּרְמָא

sense.definition: (גְּרַס II) acquired learning, tradition, study by heart.
sense.notes: Targ. Cant. I, 2 בג' for study by heart (oral tradition).—Meg. 6 b לאוקומי ג' וכ' to preserve (remember) what one has learned, requires divine assistance. Sabb. 21 b ג' דינקותא acquired in early youth (which is better remembered). Ib. 30 b לא … פומיה מג' did not cease studying by heart; B. Mets. 86 a מגִּרְסֵיה.— Pl. גִּירְסַיָּיא. B. Bath. 22 a they may be disturbed. מגִּירְסַייְהוּ in their studies. [In later literature גִּירְסָא version.]
v. גִּירְצָא

sense.definition:
(גְּרַס II; b. h.
גֶּרֶשׁ, גְּרֻשָׁה Ezek.
sense.notes: XLV, 9) acquisition, saving. Yeb. 117 a. Ib. גִּירְסָנִי (Rashi גִּירְסְנָאִי) what is accumulated for me.

Arakh. 25 b בת ג' subject to the law of deduction. Ib. IX, 7 (33 a) ובג' כסף … יוצאים go back to their owners in the year of Jubilee or with a deduction from the purchasing price (Lev. XXV, 27). Kidd. I, 2 (of the Hebrew slave); a. e.

sense.definition: (גרץ, v. גְּרִיצָה) putting layers of dough on each other.
sense.notes: Pes. 37 a נפישא בג' Ar. (ed. Koh. בלישא בגירסא, ed. בלִישָׁה) because it grows thick by combination.
, v. גִּיר II, 2).

sense.definition: , Koh. R. to IV, 14 מבית ג' של פרעה, read: גְּדֵירָתֹו (v. גְּדֵירָה) from Pharaoh’s fortress (where he was in prison).

sense.notes: Yeb. 117 b דג' לה וכ' Ar. (ed. דרגיש) annoyance of family quarrels is familiar to her.
Yoma 32 b. Zeb. 19 b; a. fr.
, v. גִּשְׁרָא

sense.definition: (reduplic. of גשם) door-sill, door-stop ; v. גַּשְׁמָה.
(גאה, cmp. גֵּו, גֹּוי) [ growth, accrued property,] herd, flock (corresp. to h. מִקְנֶה).
sense.notes: Targ. I Chr. XXVIII, 1.— Pl. גֵּיתִין, גֵּיתֵי. Targ. Am. I, 1. Targ. Gen. XLVI, 34; a. fr.—Ned. 38 a (quot. fr. Targ. Am. l. c.).

B. Kam. 114 a דדייני בג' (Rashi בגֵיוְתָא, Ms. H. בגֵּיוְתָה, Ms. R. בגֵוְתֵי, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 2 for Var. lect.) whom they (the gentile judges) convict tyrannically (not listening to arguments), opp. to Jewish judges who go by argument, points of law &c. [Rashi a. v. מגיזתא, B. Mets. 30 b, quotes our w. גִּיזְתַּיָּא; Ms. F. has גִּיזְתֵּי, fr. גזז with, anomalous pl. arbitrary decisions, v. מְגִיזְתָּא.]

sense.definition: heap of stones, bones &c., esp. rubbish, ruins.
sense.notes: Sot. IX, 2 if the body of a murdered person was found טמון בג' buried in a heap. Keth. 15 b לפקח עליו את הג' as to removing debris for saving one’s life (on the Sabbath). Sabb. 34 a עשהו ג' של עצמות changed him into a heap of bones; a. fr.— Pl. גַּלִּים, גַּלִּין. Nidd. IX, 5. Kil. I, 2, v. חֲזֶרֶת. Cmp. גִּילָּא.
Mikv. V, 6 ג' שנתלש a wave thrown on shore. Yeb. 121 a; a. fr.— Pl. as above. Ex. R. s. 19 הגיעוה ג' waves overcame her, i.e. she encountered storms; a. e.

sense.definition: revolving door, turning on hinges or pivots.
sense.notes: Sabb. 81 a של ג' the pivot of a revolving door. V. גִּלָּה.—4) (v. LXX Hos. XII, 1
Pl. as above. Sifra Sh’mini, ch. IV, Par. 3.
Pl. גַּלִּין. Targ. Is. XXV, 2.

Koh. R. to XI, 1.— Pl. גַּלִּין, גַּלַּיָּא, גַּלֵּי, גְּלָלַיָּא, גַּלְלַ'. Targ. Zech. X, 11. Targ. Ps. XLII, 8 (some ed. גְּלִילַ'); a. e. Targ. Y. I Ex. XV, 18 [read:] בֵּנֵי גְּלָלַיָּיא between the waves.—Yeb. 121 a גלי אשפלו the waves may have cast him out (alive).
B. Kam. 112 a. Snh. 113 a bot. דטרקיה לגַלֵּיה וכ' who locked his door and lost the key.— Pl. גַּלֵּי. Ber. 28 a טרוקו ג' close ye the (college doors); Ab. Zar. 58 a. B. Mets. 108 a, v. אִגְלָא.
Targ. Ezek. IV, 12; 15 (incorr. גְּלֵי).

sense.definition: (v. גִּלּוּל) Gallaya, cacophemism for similarly sounding idolatrous names.
sense.notes: Y. Ab. Zar. III, 43 a bot.; Tosef. ib. VI (VII), 4, v. גַּדָּא (Ab. Zar. 46 a; Tem. 28 b; v. גַּלְיָא II). Meg. 6 a בית גליא שלהן their house of idolatry. [גלין, Sabb. 138 a, v. גִּלָּה.] [Targ. II Kings XXIII, 6; Jer. XXVI, 23, v. גְּלֵי.]
, v. גְּלֵי
, v. גַּלְאַקְסִינֹון
, v. גְּלַי
, Yalk. Zech. 578, v. גְּלָלָא

sense.definition: (ed. גלא ק') (γαλῆ Ἀξεινῶν) [ fur of] the weasel imported by the Axeinoi (living around the Pontus Axenus or Euxenus); ermine (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Pellis).
sense.notes: Gen. R. s. 20, end (גלא) גלי ק'. Y. Sabb. II, 4 d bot. (rendition of תַּחַשׁ) גלקטינון; Koh. R. to I, 9 גלטינון (corr. acc.). Ib. והכלב גלבטינון (read גלכסינון) and the dog shall wear ermine fur.
Targ. Y. Lev. XIX, 27.—V. גְּלִיבָא.
Targ. Y. Num. VI, 5; VIII, 7 (גְּלַב).— Pl. גְּלָבִין. Gen. R. s. 31 (transl. חרבת צרים Josh. V, 2) ג' דטינרי flint knives.—[Targ. Ezek. XXVII, 24, v. גְּלַף.]
— Pl. גַּלָּבַיָּא. Targ. Ezek. V, 1.
, v. אַנְטְבִילָא
Targ. I Sam. XVII, 5 שריין ג' (Var. גלכין; h. text קשקשים). V., however, גִּלְדָּא.

sense.definition: (γλαύκιον, glaucion) juice of glaucion, a plant like the horned poppy.
sense.notes: Sifra Vayikra, Hòoba, Par. 12, ch. XXII המערב … ג' בשמן Ar. (ed. גלוביא, Var. בלבקיא &c., v. ed. Weiss p. 28 a note) he who adulterates oil with the juice of glaucium (selling it for poppy-oil); Koh. R. to IX, 13 בלבקי; ib. to VI, 1 בלקיא; Tosef. B. Bath. V, 6 מי כגלקיא ed. Zuck. (Var. בלקיא); Yalk. Lev. 479 בלנקי (corruptions of כְּלַוְקְיָא or כְּלַבְקְיָא; cmp. Löw Pfl. p. 205 a. 257). [Ar. a. Mus. seem to think of Lycium.]

sense.definition: , Pa. גַּלֵּיג (reduplic. of גל, v. גלה) to reveal (v. P. Sm. 723), to announce.
sense.notes: Gen. R. s. 36 זיל גַּלֵּיג וכ' Ar. (ed. זיל גְּלוֹג, not זילא) go, tell thy mother the good news; Lev. R. s. 5.—Ib. s. 25; Koh. R. to II, 20 איזילי גליג לאימיך (not גליגי) I will go and tell thy mother. Pesik. Aniya, p. 137 a [read:] כל מה דאת יכיל למיגלג גלג למישבח שבח as much as thou canst tell, tell; as much as thou canst praise, praise; Yalk. Is. 339 (corr. acc.); (Pesik. R. s. 32 דרוש וכ').
Lev. R. s. 10 is it these דאת מִגַּלֵּיג עליהון of whom thou art so boastful?
Y. Sot. I, 17 b; Lev. R. s. 26 [read:] מאי את בעי מן גַּלְגּוֹי דהדין do not mind this man’s boastful talk.
, v. גלוגדקא

Y. Sot. I, 16 c bot. כדי ג' ביצה as much time as is required for roasting an egg in the ashes; Num. R. s. 9.—Y. Pes. III, 30 a לאחר גִּילְגּוּלָהּ after the dough has been rolled (formed).—Keth. 111 a ע"י ג' by rolling under the ground (for resurrection in the Holy Land).

sense.definition: (with or without שבועה) the rule permitting the court to insert in an oath an affirmation to which the person concerned could not have been compelled directly; an oath by implication.
sense.notes: Kidd. 27 b. Y. ib. I, 60 d. Yeb. 58 b; Kidd. l. c. ע"י ג' by implication (the woman including in her oath the time of her betrothal); a. fr.—4) (cmp. גַּל) בית ג' a field full of hills and depressions. Toh. VI, 6; Erub. 22 b (Var. in Ar. גדגד, ref. to גִּידּוּד). [Tosef. B. Bath. II, 16 בית גילגל, v. גַּלְגַּל.]
ch., v. גַּלְגַּלָּא
, v. גַּלְגֵּל
, v. גַּרְגִּירָא
, v. גִלְגְּלִין

Pirkeì d’R. El. ch. XXXVI לגַלְגֵּל וכ' to roll (move) the stone.—Y. Sabb. III, 6 a top מְגַלְגְּלִין ביצה וכ' you may roll an egg (for roasting) on &c. Ḥall. III, 1 גִּלְגְּלָה (בחטים) when she has formed the dough (of wheat) by rolling; a. fr.— Part. pass. מְגוּלְגָּל, f. מְגוּלְגֶּלֶת; pl. מְגוּלְגָּלִים, מְגוּלְגָּלִין; מְגוּלְגָּלוֹת. 1) rolled. Pes. 7 a עיסה מג' a formed dough. Y. Sot. I, 16 c bot. ביצים מג' roasted eggs; a. fr.

B. Bath. 16 b מה עדשה זו מְגוּלְגֶּלֶת אף אבילות מִגַּלְגֶּלֶת וכ' as the lentil is rounded, so does mourning roll and go around (different version in Ms., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note, a. in Yalk. Gen. 110, v. גַּלְגַּל). [Men. 86 a, v. גִּרְגֵּר.].—2) (with על) to roll upon, to put on one’s shoulders, to burden, tax, assess. Keth. VIII, 1 (78 a) אתם מגלגלים עלינו וכ' you burden us with old restrictive laws. Y. Shebi. IV, 35 b אתם מג' וכ' ye impose upon us taxes &c. Y. B. Bath. I, beg. 12 d מג' עליו וכ' you make him bear the expenses for &c.
Sabb. 32 a; Tosef. Yoma V (IV), 12 מגלגלין זכות ע"י וכ' good things are brought about through the agency of good men &c.; a. fr.

sense.definition: (v. גָּלַל Nif.) to overcome (one’s own feelings), to put up with, bear with.
sense.notes: Keth. 67 b רצונך שתְּגַלְגֵּל עמי בעדשים will you bear with me when I offer you only lentils? ג' עמו וכ' he tried to live with him on lentils, and died. Ib. 111 a ג' בעצמו he conquered his love and remained single. Y. ib. VII, beg. 31 b מגלגלת עמו וכ' she has to bear with him thirty days longer. Y. Yeb. VIII, 8 d top גַּלְגֵּל עמהן וכ' bear with them twelve months (give them time for reconsideration).
נִתְגַּלְגֵּל

Erub. X, 3 נ' הספר מידו the scroll rolled out of his hands (down the roof). Ḥall. III, 1 עד שתִּתְגַּלְגֵּל בחטים in the case of wheat flour, until it (the dough) is rolled, v. supra. Y. Kil. IX, 32 c top; Y. Keth. XII, 35 b top מִתְגַּלְגְּלִין their bodies are rolled underground, v. גִּלְגּוּל. B. Kam. 17 b ונתג' למקום אחר but the barrel rolled to another place. Pesik. R. s. 6 מא"י נִתְגַּלְגְלָה וכ' from Palestine it (the stone) rolled and arrived just for this momentary use; a. fr.

sense.definition: to be turned, changed, transferred, caused.
sense.notes: Pirké d’R. El. ch. XLIX נתגלגלה המלכות על וכ' the royal dignity was transferred on Esther. Shebu. VII, 8 נ' לו שבועה וכ' if by chance an oath is imposed upon him in another law-suit (with the same persons), the court makes him swear by implication &c.; v. גִּלְגּוּל.
. Pirké d’R. El. ch. V; ch. XXIII.

sense.definition: (with רחמים) to prevail (over hatred &c.), be moved.
sense.notes: Pesik. R. s. 20 נִתְגַּלְגְּלוּ רחמיו וכ' the Lord’s compassion was moved. Tanḥ. Vayigg. 4; a. e.

sense.definition: to throw one’s self upon, to attack.
sense.notes: Yalk. Is. 350 (ib. 288 נתגאה).

Targ. Y. I Gen. XXVIII, 10 (II גלל). Ib. XXIX, 8 (O. גנדר); a. e.—Y. Shebu. VI, 37 a wait עד דִּיגַלְגֵּל עלן וכ' until he heaps upon thee all his claims, and then swear concerning all of them. Ib. VII, end, 38 a או אישתבע ליה כל דמְגַלְגֵּל עלך or thou must swear to him concerning all that he asks thee to swear to by implication.— Part. pass. Ber. 44 b ביעתא מְגוּלְגַּלְתָּא an egg roasted in ashes, v. preced.

sense.definition: ; אִתְגְּלַל (fr. גְּלַל), אִתְגּוֹלַל (Ithpolel of גּוּל) 1) as preced. Hithpalp. 3.
as preced. Hithpalp. 3. Targ. Job XXX, 14.—2) (with רחמין) as preced. Hithpalp. 4.
sense.notes: Targ. I Kings III, 26 איתגלגלו ed. Lag. (ed. אִיתְגְּלָלוּ). Targ. O. Gen. XLIII, 30 אִתְגּוֹלָלוּ). Targ. Hos. XI, 8 מתגללא ed. Lag. ed. אִתְגּוֹלָלוּ). Targ. Jer. XXXI, 20 אִתְגּוֹ'. Targ. II Chr. XXXIII, 13. Targ. Y. Num. XXVI, 1; a. e.—3) to come about, to happen. B. Mets. 40 a, a. e. איגלגל מילתא it so happened in the course of time.—4) (denom. of גולגלתא) to crown, adorn one’s self. Esth. R. to I, 4 whether with its own or with strange (feathers) מִתְגַּלְגְּלַת בת קבריא the raven will adorn itself; ib. 9.

sense.definition: wheel, esp. the wheel-work at wells, crane &c. Midd. V, 4.
sense.notes: Tosef. B. Bath. II, 16 בית גולגל לרבים ed. Zuck. (Var. גילגל) a public well. B. Bath. IV, 5 את הג' the crane of the wine or oil press, v. חוּמַרְתָּא. Erub. X, 14; a. fr.

sense.definition: globe, celestial sphere, esp. the sphere of the zodiac.
sense.notes: Yoma 20 b, a. e. ג' חמה the revolution of the Sun. Pes. 94 b ג' קבוע ומזלות וכ' the sphere of the zodiac is stationary, and the planets make the circuit; ג' חוזר וכ' the sphere (wheel) turns around and the planets are stationary; a. fr.—B. Bath. 16 b Ms. M. מה עדש זה דומה לג' וכ' as the lentil resembles a sphere, so is mourning a sphere making a circuit in the world; (diff. in ed., v. גִּלְגֵּל); Yalk. Gen. 110 מה עדשים האלו ג' וכ'.

Gen. R. s. 42; Lev. R. s. 11; Ruth R. introd. 6 (ref. to עין משפט Gen. XIV, 7) ג' עינו של עולם the eye-ball of the world (Abraham). Snh. 108 a בשביל ג' העין וכ' on account of (the covetousness of) the eye-ball (v. next w.); a. e.— Pl. גַּלְגִּלִּים. Makhsh. III, 8 wheel works. B. Bath. 58 a שני גַּלְגִּלִּי חמה two Sun-globes.—Y. Nidd. III, 50 c bot. ג' אדם וכ' the apples of man’s eyes are round.—Trnsf. the rotation of fortune, changes (v. B. Bath. 16 b quot. above). Sabb. 151 b (ref. to בִּגְלַל Deut. XV, 10) ג' הוא וכ' a wheel rotates in this world, i.e. changes of fortune take place constantly; Ex. R. s. 31, a. e.—3) (= גַּרְגַּר) globule, grain. Sabb. 64 b; 65 a, v. גַּרְגַּר.— Pl. as above. Y. Maasr. V, end, 52 a; Tosef. ib. III, 14 Egyptian beans are those שגַּלְגִּלֵּיהֶן חדין (ed. Zuck. גלוגל', Var. גלגל הן, corr. acc.) whose globules are pointed.
Targ. Ezek. I, 15 sq. גִּילְ' ed. Lag. Targ. Ps. LXXXIII, 14; a. e.—Erub. 104 a למימלא בגי' to fill (draw water) with the wheel. Lev. R. s. 34, v. אַנְטְלַיָּא.
Targ. Ps. LXXVII, 19. Targ. Job XXXVIII, 33.—B. Bath. 74 a ג' דרקיע וכ' the sphere of the zodiac which turns around.

Targ. Ps. XVII, 8 גִּילְגוּל ed. Lag. (oth. ed. גִּלְגּוּל; Ms. גִּיגַּל).—Tam. 32 b they handed him ג' דעינא Ar. (ed. גולגלתא incorr.) an eye-ball. Ib. גולגלתא דעינא וכ' (read גילגלא) the eye-ball of a mortal which is never satisfied. B. Bath. 73 b

Targ. Is. XVII, 13.— Pl. גִּלְגְּלַיָּא, גִּילְ'. Targ. Ezek. I, 16 sq.—Targ. Ex. XIV, 25 גִּלְגְּלֵי ed. Berl. (ed. a. Y. גַּלְגַּלֵי). Targ. Y. II ib. גֶּלְגְּלַיָּא; a. e.—Koh. R. to XII, 6; Lev. R. s. 18; a. e.—4) (v. next w.) a sort of girdle. Pl. גַּלְגְּלַיָּיה. Y. Sabb. VI, 8 b bot. (transl. of גליונים, Is. III, 22), v. גִּלְיוֹן 3.
m., v. next w.

sense.definition: (used as sing.; גלל) girdle of net-work, bandage, wrap.
sense.notes: Eduy. III, 4 (Ms. M. גנגלון, v. infra). Neg. XI, 11 גלגלון.—Y. Naz. VII, 56 b bot. נקבר אפי' ג' קטן וכ' if there is buried with the corpse even a small wrap (or belt), the law concerning decayed corpses (v. רָקָב) finds no application. Ib. if two corpses are buried beside each other נעשה ג' לזה וכ' each acts as gilg’lin to the other (suspending the law of rakab); Bab. ib. 51 a; Nidd. 27 b גנגילון. Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. V, 9 גנגלין. Sifra Sh’mini ch. XI, Par. 10 גנגלים וגנגיליון (a fusion of two versions); ib. Aḥãré Par. 8, ch. XII גינגליון; a. e. [Var. lect.: גנגילון, גנגלון, גנגלים, influenced by the Latin cingulum to which our w. nearly corresponds.]
, v. גּוּלְגּוֹלֶת
Gitt. 47 a חייתא וג' a bag and a stone (in it).

sense.definition: to form a coating; to congeal, become solid.
sense.notes: Y. Ber. I, 2 c bot. יִגְלֹד הרקיע let the (liquid mass of the) firmament solidify; Gen. R. s. 4, beg. גָּלְדָה טיפה וכ' the intermediate layer of water solidified.— Part. pass. גָּלוּד, f. גְּלוּדָה (denom. of גֶּלֶד) skinned, flayed in consequence of bruises, scabs &c. Hòull. III, 2; Tosef. ib. III, 7; a. e.
Tosef. Par. IX (VIII), 8 הִגְלִידוּ froze. Nidd. 56 b; Tosef. ib. VI, 13 מַגְלִיד forms a clodded surface, opp. מקדיר penetrates.

sense.definition: to form a rind, scab ; v. infra.
to be covered with a scab (of a wound).
sense.notes: Hòull. 51 a הו' פי המכה Rashi a. Ar. (ed. הִגְלִיד) if the top of the wound is covered with a crust; Keth. 76 b; Tosef. Ḥull. III, 11 הגליד.
— Part. pass. גְּלִיד hoar-covered. Sabb. 152 a טור תלג סחרנוהי גְלִידִין (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the mountain (my head) is snow-covered, its sides (beard) hoary. [Lev. R. s. 7, v. next w.]
Ḥull. 46 b, v. אֲהִינָא; Succ. 35 b

Y. B. Bath. III, 13 c top עד מקום שעושה ג' the fifty cubits of legal distance from the inhabited place are counted from the end of the town to the place where he flays the carcass. Yoma 44 b [read:] בכל יום היה גִּלְדָּהּ עב והיום דק (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) all the year around the pan was of a thick size, and this day (Day of Atonem.) it was thin. Num. R. s. 13 קערה גִּילְדָּהּ … גִּילְדּוֹ דק the charger was of a heavy size, the bowl &c. R. Hash. 27 b if he scraped the Shofar והעמידו על גִּלְדּוֹ and reduced it to its due size. Lev. R. s. 7 וא"ת דהוה ג' (Ar. גָּלִיד) but you may think the bronze on top of the altar was a solid mass, v. גּוֹרְדְּיָינִי.

Mikv. IX, 2 ג' שחוץ למכה (Maim. גָּלִיד שעל גבי וכ') the scab surrounding the wound (Maim.: on the wound).— Pl. גְּלָדִים, constr. גִּלְדֵּי, גִּילְדֵּי. Ib. ג' צואה וכ' the scabby, dirty spots on one’s body.
Targ. Y. I Num. VII, 13 גי' סמיך (= גֶּלֶד עב, v. preced.).— Pl. גִּי' גִּלְדִּין Targ. Ezek. XXVII, 24 חפן ג' (gold, or silver) plated.

Pl. גִּלְדֵּי, גִּי'. Hòull. 46 b lungs full ג' ג' of scabs.—8) skin, leather. Targ. I Sam. XVII, 5 (v. Lag. I, p. XVI) שריין דגלד נוני ימא (ed. שרין גלבין) a coat of mail made of the skin of sea-fishes (h. text קשקשים).—Snh. 110 a; Pes. 119 a אקלידי וקלפי דג' (Ms. M. קופלי, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the keys and the locks (the stiff rims of the bags usually of metal) were of leather (so as to be of light weight). Ber. 43 b בגי' on the leather of the shoe, opp. פנתא, v. אַפַּנְתָּא (Rashi: heel).

sense.definition: (preced.) worker or dealer in leather, harness-maker &c.— Pl. גִּלְדָּאֵי, גִּילְ'.
sense.notes: B. Mets. 24 b; Ḥull. 48 a sq. שוקא דג' harness-makers’ place.

sense.definition: (גלד) gildana, name of a certain fish with a thick fatty skin.
sense.notes: Snh. 100 b לא תנטוש גיל' וכ' (Ms. M. תפשוט) do not begin to strip the gildana from its gill, lest its skin go to ruin (a citation from Ben Sira). B. Bath. 73 b ההוא ג' וכ' that was a sea gildana (a small fish among the sea monsters). Hor. 12 a; Ker. 6 a.— Pl. גִּלְדָּנֵי, גִּילְ'. Tam. 32 b ג' דמלחא Rashi (ed. גולדנא) salted g. Ber. 44 b; Keth. 105 b, v. גִּילָא II.
Y. Sabb. XII, beg. 13 c מטה של ג' folding couch.— Pl. גִּלִּין. Bab. ib. 138 a כסא ג' camp chair.

sense.definition: (popular corruption of lectica ; for the prefixed guttural cmp. laena and χλαῖνα, lectum and κλίνη; v. Liddell & Scott’s Greek Dict.

Bets. 25 b Ar. (ed. גלודקי, Ms. M. גלנדקי). Cant. R. to V, 5; Koh. R. to IX, 11 אפי' בגלק' לא וכ' could not even be carried in a lectica. Cant. R. to IV, 8 בכל קדיקה; Yalk. Ps. 838 כל קרקיא (read בִּכְלֶקְדִּיקָא). Ib. Lev. 666 שלא יטייל אחריך בגלטק'; Sifra B’har Par. 5, ch. VII … יטול … בלנטיא) he (the Hebrew servant) shall not walk behind thee when thou art carried in the lectica, v. לֶקְטִיקָא. Sifré Deut. 37 גלגוטיקא; Yalk. Kings 238 גלוגיקא.—
Targ. Job XV, 24 איטימוס לגלוגדיקא Ar. ed. Koh. (ed. לגלוגדק) ready for the bier (for death, cmp. LXX).
Targ. Y. Ex. XXIV, 10 אתקניה גְּלוּגְדַּק וכ' (גִּיל' some ed.) made the sapphire brick a foot-stool in place of the hypopodion &c.—Targ. Lam. II, 1 גלוגדקא דרגלוהי (h. text הדום רגליו).

Gen. R. s. 45 אין סיתרה כגְלוּיָהּ her private conduct is not like her public appearance (she is insincere); ib. s. 71.—בַּגָּ' in public, visible to all, opp. בסתר. Ab. IV, 4 he will be punished בג' in an ostensible way. Sot. 3 a; a. fr.
, v. גִּילּוּי, גִילּוּיָא.
Pl. גָּלוֹיֵי. Lev. R. s. 5 גלויא בר גלויי Ar. (ed. גלויי בר ג', corr. acc.) thou stranger, son of strangers. Lam. R. introd. beg. גלוואי, read גְּלוֹיָיאֵי (Ar. גְּלוֹלָאֵי).
, v. גלי ch.

sense.definition:
, pl. גִּלּוּלִים, גִּי' (b. h.;
גלל) filth (v. גָּלָל), idols.
sense.notes: Meg. 13 a to clean herself מִגִּלּוּלֵי בית אביה from the contamination of her paternal idolatry. Ib. מרדה בגילולי וכ' she rejected &c.—עובד ג', עבודת ג' (abbr. ע"ג) idolator, idolatry. In some ed. for עכ"ום, ע"ז &c.; v. זָר a. כּוֹכָב.
Pl. גְּלוֹלָאֵי, גְּלוֹלַיָּא. Lam. R. introd., beg. Ar., v. גָּלוֹיָא; Pesik. Dibré, p. 110 b גליליא (Var. גְּלוֹ', v. Bub. note a. l.). V. גְּלִילָה.
, v. גּוֹלֶם
, v. גְּרִיסָא

Erub. X, 10 נגר שיש בראשו ג' a door bolt which has on its top a (movable) fastening contrivance (which may occasionally be used as a pestle). Sabb. 123 b ג' (Ar. ק', Ms. M. repeatedly גלוסקר') the law about claustra, ref. to Kel. XI, 4 ק'. Sabb. 124 a ג'.
Ber. 22 a R. Yehudah גלוסטרא (corr. acc., Ms. M. קלסתראה, Yoḥãsin Completum p. 148 b קְלוּסְטְרָאָה).

sense.definition: c. (a contraction of גלוסביקא or גלופסיקא, Lesbiacus, Lesbiaca, v. כְּלוּפְסִין, לִבְסִים, קְלוּפְ', גְּלוּפְ'; as to guttural before ל, v. גְּלוּגְדְּקָא) relating to Lesbos (an island of the Aegean Sea, noted for its fertility and luxuries), Lesbian, whence
[in Syriac] name of a brand of white flour (P. Sm. 726), a white and delicate bread (cmp. Athenæus Deipnosophistæ III, 11.
sense.notes: Tosef. Ber. IV, 15 שלמה של גלוסקין an unbroken loaf of g’luskin, opp. של בע"הב home-made. Dem. VI, 12 buy for me גְּלוּסְקָן אחד ed. (accus.; Ms. M. גלוסקא אחת, Ar. קין אחת …, R. S. קלוסקן) one loaf &c. Y. Ab. Zar. I, 40 a bot. קלוסקין אחת; Erub. 64 b גלוסקין pl.—Pes. 6 b he may find ג' יפה ודעתו עליה Rashi (ed. ודעתיה עילויה, Ms. M. יפיפיה) a fine gl. which he may have the intention of eating (in place of burning). Lam. R. to I, 16 גלוסקאן; a. e.— Pl. גְּלוּסְקָאוֹת, גְּלוּסְקִין, קְלוּ'. Sabb. 30 b. Gen. R. s. 88, beg. Lam. R. to II, 12 גלו' (Ar. ed. Koh. קלסקין); a. e.

sense.definition: a superior sort of olives already pressed when appearing in the market (θλασταί, σταφυλίδες, v. Athenæus l. c. II, 56; cmp. כְּלוּפְסִין).
sense.notes: Ab. Zar. II, 7 זיתי קלוסקא המגולגלין Y. ed. II, 10 (Mish. זתים גלוסקאות, Bab. ed. 39 b זיתי ג', Mish. Nap. קלוסטא, Ar. ed. Koh. s. v. גלגל: קלוסטא, קלוסטרא). Bab. ib. 40 b (ed. Pes. a. oth. קלוסקא, Alf. early ed. גלוסטא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 4). Y. ib. II, 42 a bot. הן זיתי ק' וכ' zethé k’luska is the same as rolled olives. [Ex. R. s. 30 גלוסקאות, v. גְּלֹוסְקְמָא.]
, v. preced.

XXIV, 8; as to ד for ג', v. Liddell & Scott s. lit. Δ) case, chest, coffin. Y. Sot. VII, 22 d כמין גלוסקום a kind of casing; Y. Shek. VI, 49 d bot. גלוסקוים (corr. acc.).—Gitt. III, 3 if he found the document בג' … Ar. (ed. בד') in a case; expl. ib. 28 a טליקא דסבי a box for elders (for keeping documents &c.); B. Mets. I, 8 Y. ed. ג' (Bab. 20 a, b a. Mish. ד'). Meïl. VI, 1 ג' (Bab. ed. 21 a ד'). M. Kat. 24 b (ד') ג' הניטלת באגפיים a coffin carried by its handles.— Pl. גְּלוֹסְקְמִין, גְּלוֹסְקְמָאוֹת, דְּ'. Meg. 26 b דְּלֹוסְקְמֵי ספרים (Alf. Ms. קְמָאוֹת …, ed. סקאות …) cases for books &c.—Ex. R. s. 30, end פותח הגלוסקאות (corr. acc.) he opens the cases (containing his goods).
