sense.definition: , only in בַּר ה' Bar-Hemag, a subspecies of abratha (hyssop).
sense.notes: Sabb. 109 b (defining h. אֵזוֹב), v. אַבְרָתָא.
Kil. VI, 4 (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).
, v. הַמְדָּן
Yoma 87 b (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 8). Sabb. 107 b; 125 a (מר)בר המדורי ed. (Ms. … די, … דא). Yeb. 83 b רי … Men. 38 b (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 40).
, v. preced.
, v. הַרְמֵיךְ

sense.definition: Hamdan ( Hamadân, v. Schr. KAT 2 p. 378), Ekbatana, capital of Media, v. אַחְמְתָא.
sense.notes: Kidd. 72 a (ed. חַמְדָּן).—[Targ. I Chr. I, 5 Var. in ed. Rahmer המדן (ed. הַמְדַּאי, חַ', not … דָּאֵי); Targ. Y. Gen. X, 2 הַמְדַּיי (not … דִּיִי).]
, v. המי

Yoma 20 b קול הֲמוֹנָהּ של רומי Ms. M. (ed. העיר); Lam. R. to V, 18; Macc. 24 a קול ה' של רומי Ms. Ms. (ed. בבל); Yalk. Is. 278 המוני של כרך גדול (read: הֲמוֹנוֹ), the din of the city of Rome, v. פּוֹטְיוֹלִין. Macc. 10 a (ref. to Koh. V, 9) ללמד בה' to teach before large crowds; (Yalk. Koh. 971 ללמוד בה' to study among a crowd of students).— Pl. הֲמוֹנִים. Ex. R. s. 11 אתם עשיתם ה' ה' וכ' you arranged troops against my children &c.—Cant. R. to VIII, 11 (play on המון, ib. באו עליהן המונות (read: המונים) hordes came against them. Ib. שהמו אחריהם הֲמוֹנֵי מלאכים (not מלכים) troops of angels rushed for them (to prevent them from receiving the Law, v. דָּדָה). Ib. שהמו אחר המוני המוניות, read: שהמו אחריהם המוניות, v. הְמוֹנוּת.
Targ. Is. XIII, 4. Targ. II Kings XXV, 11; a. e.

Cant. R. to VIII, 11 (v. הָמוֹן, end) שהמו אחריהם ה' דמלכוותא the hosts of kingdoms were greedy for them (to have a foothold in their country). Lam. R. to I, 17 formerly I used to go up to the Temple ה' ה' של חגיגה in (singing) troops of pilgrimage. Lev. R. s. 33 הייתם נעשים הומניות הו' לע"ז (corr. המו') ye used to form troops (noisy processions) for idolatry; v. דִּיאוֹנִיסִין.
, Cant. R. to V, 14, read: חֲמוּנֵיה (v. חמי); v. Pesik. B’shall. p. 90 b

sense.definition: (a popular corrupt. of ἡπατόριον, v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Eupatorium) liver-wort, in gen. herbs used for cooling the blood (cmp. חוּמְצָן).
sense.notes: Y. Ned. VII, beg. 40 b במיני אפומליא וכ' (read: אפוטליא or אימט') the various kinds of hepatoria, e.g. Napu, Melissophylon and Colocasia.—Tosef. Maasr. III, 7 אמיטל' נהגו בה וכ' (Var. המטל') for hepatoria the scholars allowed no exemption &c. Tosef. Ab. Zar. IV (V), 11 המיטליא וכ' (Var. המוט') hep. &c. prepared by gentiles; Y. ib. II, 41 d, Y. Sabb. I, 3 c bot. הרי מוט' (read: ההֵימ'); Ab. Zar. 38 b החמטליא Ms. M. (ed. המט'). Ib. היא ה' וכ' ed. (Ms. M. ח') hemtalia is (legally) the same as &c., v. פְּסִילְיָא. Cmp. חוּמְטַרְיָא.

sense.definition: to be noisy, excited, with אחר to rush after, be greedy, envious &c.—Cant.
sense.notes: R. to VIII, 11 הָמוּ, v. הָמוֹן a. הֲמוֹנוּת. Part. הוֹמֶה, v. infra; fem. הוֹמִיָּה. Y. M. Kat. III, beg. 81 c (in a riddle) ה' בירכתי ביתה she (the soul?) is restless in the corners of her house. Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVII הוֹמִים are in commotion.

Lev. R. s. 22 (ref. to אוהב בהמון, Koh. V, 9) כל מי שהומה ומְהַמֶּה אחר הממון whosoever is greedy and covetous for money; ib. הומה ומה' אחר תורה ambitious to accumulate learning; a. e.— Part. pass. f. מְהוּמָּת anxious. Nidd. 5 a, v. בַּיִת.—Denom. מָמוֹן.

sense.definition: , to be excited, to roar, rumble.
sense.notes: Targ. Jer. IV, 19. Ib. V, 22; a. e.—[Targ. Prov. XXVIII, 27 מהמי Ar., v. חֲמָא.]

sense.definition: preced.) = הָמוֹן, din of a large city.
sense.notes: Sifré Deut. 43 [read:] קול ה' של רומי מפוטיולין, v. הָמוֹן a. פּוּטְיוֹלִין.

sense.definition: (corr. הֵמְיוֹנוֹס) m. (ἡμίονος) mule whose sire is an ass. Gen. R. s. 82, end; Y. Ber. VIII, 12 b top (expl. יִמִם, Gen. XXXVI, 24); v. הֵמְיִיפּוֹס.

sense.notes: , v. הֶמְיָה

sense.definition: (Pers. hemyân, Fl. in Levy Targ. Dict.
sense.notes: s. v. הֶמְיָנָא) belt, girdle. Erub. X, 15 (104 b).— Pl. הֶמְיָינִין. Succ. V, 3 (51 a) ומהֶמְיָינֵיהֶן היו מפקיעין ed. Y. a. Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) out of their (old) belts they made wicks.

Targ. O. Ex. XXXIX, 29 (ed. Berl.; oth. ed. הֶמְ'); a. fr.—Erub. 94 a שקילו הִמְיָינֵיה וכ' Ms. M. (ed. הימני', corr. acc.) take his belt and tie &c. Meg. 27 b משבנתיה להִמְיָינָאִי I pawned my belt. Zeb. 19 a הוה מִדְּלֵי לי המיינאי וכ' (Ms. M. הִימְיָנָאִי) my belt had slipped upward and he himself pulled it down.—Sabb. 59 b הִימְיָינָא.— Pl. הִמְיָינִין, הִמְיָ', הִמְיָינֵי, הִי'. Targ. O. Ex. XXVIII, 4 (ed. Berl.; oth. ed. הֶ').—Sabb. l. c., v. קַמְרָא.
, Y. Sabb. VII, 10 c top, v. אַמְיַינְטֹון

sense.definition: (ἡμίιππος, S.) half-horse, a mule whose sire is a horse.
sense.notes: Gen. R. s. 82, end (expl. יֵמִם, Gen. XXXVI, 24) המיסו (corr. acc., in oppos. to המיונס); Y. Ber. VIII, 12 b top ורבנן אמרין היימים (corr. acc.).
Y. Gitt. VII, beg. 48 c, expl. קורדייקוס.
, v. הֵימ'
, v. הִמְיָינָא

sense.definition: (ἡμίνα, hemina) hemina, a liquid measure, half a sextarius (nearly half a pint English).
sense.notes: — Pl. הֵמִינִין. Targ. II Esth. I, 8 (ed. Lag. המינון, corr. acc.).
, v. הֵמְיִיפּוֹס
, v. חִימוּצָתָא
, v. next. w.

sense.definition: (prob.) pr. n. m. Hãmiram, a person from whom certain secular books are named: ספרי ה' (cmp. בן סִירָא, בן לַעֲנָה, בן תַּגְלָא).
sense.notes: Yad. IV, 6 (comment. מִירָס, מִירָם); Y. Snh. X, 28 a top ספרי ה' (contrad. to ספרים החיצונים). Ḥull. 60 b worth to be burnt כספרי מירון Ar. ed. Koh. s. v. מרום (Var. מרון, המירוס, missing in ed.). [Conjectures: Homeros (Homer); Ἡμερησία (βίβλια) diaries; symbolical name = ‘the Lord remove them’. V. Koh. Ar. Compl. s. v. מרום.]
, v. preced.
, v. הִימְלְכָא
, v. הִימַלְתָּא

Tanḥ. Vayera 22 הֲמָמוֹ והלך וכ' He confounded him (took him by surprise), and thus he (Abraham) went to sacrifice his son; Gen. R. s. 55.—Mekh. B’shall. s. 5 (ref. to Ex. XIV, 24) הֲמָמָן ערבבן He confounded them, He brought confusion into their ranks; ib. s. 2; a. e.

sense.definition: to stir up, sweep (v. next w.).
sense.notes: Lam. R. introd. (R. Abbahu 2) (expl. הכביד, Is. VIII, 23, and ref. to Targ. Is. XIV, 2
הֲמָמָם כבמכביד he swept them as with a broom (Num. R. s. 23, end, a. e. הכבידן, v. כָּבַד); Yalk. Is. 282 ה' במכבד. [הוּמָם, denom. of מוּם q. v.]
הַמֵּם, or Af. אַהֲמֵם to sweep. Targ. Is. XIV, 23 (h. text טאטא).

sense.definition: Ithpa. אִתְהָמַם (denom. of מוּם) to mutilate one’s self (h. הִתְגּוֹדֵד).
sense.notes: Targ. O. Deut. XIV, 1 (ed. Berl. תתח', v. Berl. Massor. p. 90). Targ. I Kings XVIII, 28 Kimḥi (some ed. אתח'); a. e.—Part. מִתְהָמַם mutilated. Targ. Jer. XLI, 5; XLVIII, 37 (some ed. מתח').
הַמְמַת (הֲמַם I) sweepings, refuse. Targ. Amos VIII, 6 הממת ed. Lag. (ed. Wil. מֵהַ', h. text מַפַּל).
Mekh. B’shall. s. 5 אין ה' אלא מגפה the word hamam (Ex. XIV, 24) means pestilence.
Snh. 61 a נעבד כה' worshipped as H. wanted to be. Ḥull. 139 b ה' מן התורה מנין where is Haman alluded to in the Pentateuch?—Meg. 10 b ה' הרשע; a. fr.
, v. הִימְנוֹן
, v. הַמְנִיכָא
Y. Taan. IV, 68 a רב ה' דבבל R. H. of Babylonia.—Y. Hor. III, 47 c top. Shebu. 34 b; a. fr.—Y. B. Bath. VI, end, 15 c רב ה' ספרא R. H., the scribe.

ך, cmp. בָּזִיךְ) [ emblem of appointment to office,] necklace. Dan. V, 7, a. e. (Kethib: המנוכא, המינכא).—Targ. Prov. I, 9 (some ed. המניכה).— Pl. הַמְנִיכִין. Targ. Esth. II, 9.—V. מְנִיכָא. [Greek transformation μανιάκης, fr. which מוּנְיָיק.]

sense.definition: a sort of spoon or fork, with one end pointed and the other broad (similar to the cochlear, v. כּוֹכְלִיאָר).
sense.notes: B. Mets. 25 b סכיני וה' (Ms. R. המנק) knives and fork (which may have been cast on the dunghill inadvertently). Succ. 32 a דעביד כהימנק (Ms. M. והוא דעביד לה כי הימניק) when the palm-branch is formed like a himnek (Rashi: like the top of the stylus).
אִתְהַמְסִי, v. מְסִי.
, v. הֶמְסֵסָא

sense.definition: (מִסְמֵס) melting, softening of the brain or spinal column.
sense.notes: Ḥull. 45 b איזוהי … ואיזוהי ה' which (of the defects) is hamrakhah, and which hãmas-masah? Answ. מַסְמָסָה כל שאינו יכול לעמוד וכ' when the column does not remain upright (when held in the hand). Ib. 53 b המ' decayed flesh

sense.definition: (מָסַס) [ the dissolving ( digesting) receptacle,] the first stomach of ruminants, cmp. הַבְלִילָא.
sense.notes: Ḥull. III, 1 המסס (= הַהֶ', or הַמָּסָס). Lev. R. s. 4; Midr. Till. to Ps. CIII, beg. המ' לטחון the first stomach has the function of grinding (the food). Lev. R. s. 18; Koh. R. to XII, 3 ‘the grinders’ (ib.) זו ה' that is the stomach. [From later usage, e.g. Tur Yoré Deah 49, and from its Chald. equivalent it would seem that our w. is הֶמְסֵס, and the definite article fused with the ה of the noun.]
Lev. R. s. 3; Koh. R. to VII, 19 המסי'; Yalk. Koh. 976 המסס'.
, v. מְעִיסָה
(מור) substitute. Ḥull. 112 a Ar., ed. חמר, v. חַמְרָא I.

sense.definition: (מרי I) stuffing food down the throat of an animal.
sense.notes: Sabb. 155 b, v. הַלְעָטָה.

sense.definition: (מרי II) rebelliousness, rebellion; contempt of court, v. מַמְרֵא II. Snh. 16 a מהַמְרָאָתוֹ from the Scriptural text treating of his (the elder’s) rebellion.
sense.notes: Ib. 14 b המראתו ה' his rebellion is legally punishable; a. fr.— Pl. הַמְרָיוֹת. Midr. Till. to Ps. CVI, 7; Yalk. ib. 864 שתי ה' המרו וכ' they rebelled twice.

sense.definition: (מור) change, הֲמָרַת הַדָּת, change of religion, apostasy.
sense.notes: Pes. 96 a (Ms. M. משומדות); Yeb. 71 a top.
, v. הַמְרָאָה II

sense.definition: (מָיַךְ) softening of the brain or the spinal column into a liquid state, contrad. to הֲמַסְמָסָה, into a cohesive, pulpy substance.
sense.notes: Ḥull. 45 b
Tem. 12 b
Targ. O. a. Y. I Gen. XIV, 5 (h. text הָם).
, Koh. R. to III, 14, read: חֲמַת גֶּדֶר.
הִינָּם, הִינָּן behold, they are. Ned. V, 6 (48 a) והי' לפניך אלא וכ' Bab. ed. (Mish. ואינן; Y. ed. והן בפניך עד) and behold they are before thee (thine), but only in order that my father &c.

sense.definition: (introducing a question or exclamation) how?, indeed!
sense.notes: Y. Shek. I, 45 d bot. הן נקרא ולא וכ' can we, indeed, read this and not feel ashamed? (Bab. ed. הניקרא, marginal correct. Ms. M. הן נק').
Dan. II, 5, sq.; a. fr.—הן—הן whether— or. Ezra VII, 26.—B. Bath. VII, 2 הן חסר הן יתר whether it be less (than a Beth Kor) or more. Ib. 3; a. e.

B. Mets. 49 a, v. הִין II Mekh. Yithro s. 4 answer על לאו לאו ועל הן הן no to a prohibition and yes to a positive command. Ib. s. 5 ה' וה' yes, indeed; a fr.—Ned. 11 a, a. fr. מכלל לאו אתה שומע הן from the negative we derive the affirmative by implication; Y. ib. I, end, 37 a, a. e. ממשמע לאו וכ'. Men. X, 3 (65 a).
Targ. Prov. XIX, 1, a. fr. in Ms., ed. Lag. הֲוֹו q. v.—Pesik. Aḥaré, p. 169 b, v. דְּחוּכָא; a. e.

Y. Meg. I, 72 a היך … להן וכ' (Y. Succ. III, 54 a top לדין), v. הֵיךְ. Y. Kil. IX, 32 c top [read:] מה הן שאל להן וכ'; Y. Keth. XII, 35 b top מה הין דשאיל להון (corr. acc.) from all that this one asked that one &c.; a. fr.

sense.definition: what? Y. B. Mets. II, 8 c לְהָן, v. אֲהָן.
where (relat.), where? Esth. R. to I, 12 [read:] הן דליסטאה מקפח וכ' where the robber waylays, there he is executed.
sense.notes: Y. Snh. I, 19 a top; Y. Ned. VI, 40 a bot. הן דמטא מטא where he came to, he came to (and his order was obeyed). Y. Kil. IX, 32 c bot. [read:] להן דאשתלחית מינסבינן to the place whither I was sent to take them; Y. Keth. XII, 35 b להון דשלחית (read דאשתלחית). Gen. R. s. 78, v. בְּרָא. Y. Ber. II, 5 c bot. להן ייזיל whither shall he go? Ib. II, 5 a top מן הן הוא where is he from?; a. fr.— Pl. הַנְהוּ, הַנֵּי, הַנָּךְ those, these. Targ. Esth. I, 10; a. e.—Tam. 32 b. B. Mets. 117 a, v. הַהוּא.—Gitt. 6 a הנך … דהני והני בדהנך וכ' those (the inhabitants of Ctesiphon) know the signatures of these (of Ardshir), but the latter do not know &c. Bets. 10 b; a. v. fr.—* Fem. pl. הַנָּן. Y. Bets. V, 63 b top רבנין … מפרשין לה' the Rabbis of Cæsarea report these (controversies) more explicitly (stating the opinion of each by name; Y. Pes. VIII, 36 a top מפרשין להון).—הני מילי (abbrev. הנ"מ) these words (have been said), i.e. this is the case only &c. Ber. 21 a bot. (הוה אמינא) הנ"מ יחיד ויחיד I might have thought this refers only to &c.—Ib. 15 a והנ"מ לק"ש but this applies only to &c.; a. v. fr.—מנא הני מילי, v. מְנָא II.—Emphatic. הַנָּא, הַנָּה. Gen. R. s. 87 הנה טבא וכ' is this (slave) good? Is the omen favorable?; Yalk. ib. 145 הא טב וכ' (corr. acc.).
, v. הֲנִי
Sifré Num. 153 (ref. to הניא, Num. XXX, 6) ה' זו מה היא what this ‘objection’ means; v. הֲפָרָה.

sense.definition: (cmp. הֵמַג) Bar-Henag, surname of a species of abrathah (אַבְרָתָה).
sense.notes: Sabb. 109 b (defin. h. אזוב יון).—[ Pl. הִנְגִּין, הִינְ', v. הֵיגְתָא.]
, v. הִינְדְּוָאָה
, v. אַנְטוּבִּין
, v. הִינְ'
Ḥull. 43 a זימנין דמִיהַנְּדְּזִין וכ' at times (when the animal stretches its neck) the perforations in the two skins of the oesophagus may just exactly cover each other.
B. Bath. 89 b, v. preced. Gitt. 60 b ואשקי בה' and use the water in proportion (as much as is due to thy share). [Later Hebr. הַנְדָּסָה geometry.]
, Midr. Till. to Ps. XVII; Yalk. Ps. 670, read: קיּרְיוֹסִין; v. אַפּוֹפְסִין
, v. הִנְדְּקָא
, v. הִינְדִּיקִי
Midr. Till. to Ps. VI חרב ה' an Indian sword.
נהמא דה' Indian bread, a dough roasted on the spit and poured over with oil, or eggs and oil. Ber. 37 b (Asheri דהנדוקא).
, v. הִינְ'

sense.definition: (דקק, with prefixed ה a. נ inserted; corresp. to h. גַּדְגַּדְנִיּוֹת) melilot, a kind of clover used as a relish.
sense.notes: —Erub. 28 a ה' מדאי Median Melilot. Y. ib. III, 20 d top; Y. Peah VIII, 21 a top.
, v. הָן

Koh. R. to V, 6 ה' של בו"ד the ‘here is’ of a human being (Esth. VIII, 7), ה' של הק"בה the ‘here is’ of the Lord (Zech. XIV, 1).—הִנֵּנִי here am I. Gen. R. s. 55 ה' לכהונה I am ready for priesthood; a. fr.
, v. הני

sense.definition: (נָהַג) driving an animal, a form of taking possession.
sense.notes: B. Mets. 9 a, v. מְשִׁיכָה.
, v. הָן

Gen. R. s. 87, beg. (ref. to Ps. CXXV, 3) אין לו ה' וכ' finds no ease in the company of &c.—הֲנָחַת רוח peace of mind, appeasement. Y. Dem. VII, beg. 26 a (interch. with נחת רוח). Y. Peah I, 15 c bot.; Y. Kidd. I, 61 a bot. בעושה ה' רותו וכ' when he gives his father ease of mind (by obeying his wishes).

sense.definition: (נוּחַ Hif.) putting down, depositing, laying down (v. הֵינוּחַ).
sense.notes: Sabb. 22 b, sq. ה' עושה מצוה the real religious ceremony consists in putting the lights in their appropriate place. Ib. 4 a, a. e. עקירה וה' the lifting up (of a burden on the Sabbath) and the putting down.—Kel. VIII, 8 מקום הַנָּחַת העצים the place (in the oven) where the wood is placed. Ib. XXII, 1 מקום הנחת וכ' enough (left of the side board) to set down the cups; enough … to set down portions of meat; Y. Ab. Zar. II, end, 42 a היא מקים ה' הכוסות וכ' (not תחת) both terms mean the same. Taan. 2 b; 4 a משעת הַנָּחָתוֹ from the time it (the Lulab) is stored away (the seventh day of Succoth).
, v. הָן
נֶהֱנֶה (= נֵאוֹת, v. אוֹת I)

sense.definition: to be pleased, to enjoy, to profit.
sense.notes: B. Kam. 20 a, a. fr. זה נה' the one is benefitted &c., opp. חָסֵר. Ib. II, 2 משלם מה שנֶהֱנֵית he must pay for what the animal has enjoyed (eaten or drunk), contrad. to מה שהזיקה what she has damaged. Ber. 10 b הרוצה לֵהָנוֹת יהָנֶה וכ' (Rashi לֵיהָ') he who desires to make use (of people’s hospitalities), may do so following the example of Elisha. R. Hash. 28 a, a. fr. מצות לא ליהנות ניתנו religious ceremonies are not considered an enjoyment (as regards the use of sacred property &c.); a. v. fr.
Ber. 35 a דבר שנ' something which is enjoyable (can be eaten &c.).

sense.definition: to benefit, to entertain, to cause to share.
sense.notes: Snh. 92 a אינו מְהַנֶּה ת"ח וכ' allows no scholar to share his wealth. Ber. 63 b bot. ומְהַנֵּהוּ וכ' and invites him to partake of his wealth. Yad. IV, 3 הרי אתה כמְהַנָּן וכ' you appear to benefit them pecuniarily, but &c. Ab. Zar. 16 b sq. שמא דבר מינית … והִנָּאֲךָ (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 20) perhaps a heretical idea was communicated to thee and it pleased thee; Yalk. Prov. 937; a. fr. [Snh. 102 b הֶהֱנָה Hif., marginal note היה מְהַנֶּה; v. Yalk. Kings 207.]

Targ. Jer. XXXI, 25 הֲנַתְנִי ed. Lag. (oth. ed. הֲנָאַתְנִי). Targ. Is. XLIV, 10 לַהֲנָאָה (h. text הוֹעִיל); a. e.— Part. הָנֵי. Gen. R. s. 8 עביד מה דה' לך do what pleases thee.— Pl. הַנְיָין. Gen. R. s. 3; s. 9 דין ה' לי יתהון לא ה' לי these (worlds) please me, those did not &c.; Midr. Till. to Ps. XXXIV; Koh. R. to III, 11, v. דֵּן.

Targ. Hab. II, 18; a. fr.—Snh. 99 b bot. מאי אַהֲנוּ לן רבנן (not אהני) what good have the Rabbis done us? Ab. Zar. 14 b אַהֲנָאִי לכון וכ' I did you good inasmuch &c. Y. Ber. I, 4 b bot. ומה מְהַנְיָא ליה (ed. Krot. ומה missing) what good will it do him?; Y. M. Kat. III, 83 c bot. ומה אנים ליה (corr. acc.); a. fr.

Tem. 4 b אי עביד מַהֲנֵי if (what the law forbids) has been done, the act has its legal effect. Ber. 43 a מְהַנְיָא ליה הסבה the lying down of a company for a meal has an influence (in that one says the benediction in behalf of all); a. fr.

Targ. Y. Deut. I, 6 א' לכון it benefitted you (v. Sifré Deut. 5). Targ. O. Gen. XXXVII, 26.—Targ. II Sam. XVII, 16 דלמא יִתְהֲנִי וכ' (ed. Wil. יִתַּהֲנִי) perhaps it will please the king (h. text יְבֻלַּע). Targ. Ez. XVI, 31; a. e.—Ned. 50 a דאִיתְהֲנִי וכ' that I should enjoy this world’s goods. Ḥag. 15 a לִיתְהֲנֵי וכ' let him (myself) enjoy the world. Yeb. 103 a מִתְהַנְיָא מעבירה she derived gratification from a sinful act. Y. Snh. X, 29 b top ובר נש לא מִתְהֲנֵי כלום (not מתהנים) and none were benefitted; a. fr.
, v. הֲנָיָיה ch.

sense.definition: (denom. of נֵאוֹת, v. אוֹת I; cmp. נָאֶה) enjoyment, pleasure, benefit.
sense.notes: Taan. 8 a מאי ה' יש לך what does it profit thee (to bite)?—Sifré Deut. 5 (ref. to רב, Deut. I, 6) ה' גדולה וכ' your dwelling &c. was of great benefit to you; a. v. fr.—Snh. 26 b, a. fr. בעל ה' a worldling.—נדר ה' מן to vow refusal of any benefit or favor from a person. Ned. IV, 1, sq.; a. fr.—Kidd. 41 a דור ה' ממנו vow that you will have no favor at his hands. [Sifra B’har ch. III, Par. 3 הניית, v. הוֹנָיָיה.]

Targ. Jer. XVI, 19. Targ. Koh. II, 2; 12.—Targ. Y. Lev. V, 16 הַנְיַית קודשא enjoyment of sacred property. Targ. Y. Gen. XXXVII, 26; a. fr.—Ex. R. s. 6, end; Tanḥ. Vaëra 2 (prov.) מן שטייא לית הנייא וכ' of acacias there is no profit except you cut them down, i.e. a wicked man can be converted by suffering only.—Taan. 23 b מקרבא הַנְיָיתָהּ Rashi (ed. הנייתא) what good she does is a direct one (by giving bread); ואנא … ולא מקרבא הנייתיה (read: הַנְיָיתִי) but I give money, and what good I do is indirect; Keth. 67 b ומקרבן אהנייתי (read: ומקרבא הַנְיָיתִי, or ומקרבן הֲנָיָיתַי, pl.).—Y. B. Bath. V, 16 b bot. בנוי דה' (cmp. מַעֲלֵי) good, worthy children.—2) loveliness, beauty (cmp. נָאֶה). Targ. Ps. XXIII, 2 הַנְיַית דיתאין loveliness of plants (h. text נְאוֹת!).
, v. preced.
, v. הֲנָפָה
, v. הַנֵּץ
, v. הֲנָיָיה ch.
, v. הָן

Y. Ber. IX, 14 b bot.; Y. Sot. V, 20 c bot. [read:] פרוש מן הנ' מן מאי דאית לי אנא מנכי עביד מצוה a Pharisee ‘from deduction’ (who says), I take from what is mine (I stint myself) in order to do a good deed.

sense.definition: (homiletically = חִנָּם; v. ה"א) gratuitous, purposeless act, vanity.
sense.notes: Erub. 19 a (play on גיהנם) גיא … שהכל יורדין בה על עסקי ה' (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 50) the valley which all enter for affairs of vanity (worldly lusts).
, v. הָן

sense.definition: (Inf. Hif. of נוּף) waving ceremony in the Temple.
sense.notes: —יום ה' (Lev. XXIII, 10—12) the second day of Passover. R. Hash. IV, 3; Succ. III, 12; Y. Ḥall. I, 57 c top; a. e.—Tosef. Arakh. I, 11 ביום ה' on the same week-day as the second day of Passover; Arakh. 9 b; v. עִיבּוּר.

Pesik. R. s. 41 (ref. to יפה נוף Ps. XLVIII, 3) היפה בהֲנָפַת העומר שלה who is beautiful when she waves the Omer; Yalk. Ps. 755; Yalk. Ex. 417 בהֲנִיפָתָהּ.—Y. Maasr. II, 50 a top הֲנָפַת מגל the swinging of the sickle.

sense.definition: (נפק) producing before court, esp. the legal endorsement of a note, stating that it has been produced in court and found valid.
sense.notes: B. Mets. 7 b; 16 b; a. e.

sense.definition: [ the blossom,] name of a coin; pl. (through false analogy, v. דָּרוֹסָה) הִנְצִין, הִינְצִין.
sense.notes: Tosef. B. Bath. V, 12 a; Kidd. 12 a, v. נֵץ.

sense.definition: (Inf. Hif. of נָצַץ) sparkling, ה' החמה the first sparklings of the rising sun.
sense.notes: Taan. III, 9. Ber. I, 2; a. fr.

Men. 69 a שתי … ה' שריין וכ' (Rashi) does the offering of the two loaves cause the permission to use plants which had sprouted forth at the time of the offering, or is a distinct formation of fruits required?, v. חֲנָטָה. Ib. ה' דפירא the coming forth of the fruit, ה' דעלה of the foliage.

sense.definition: (תוך, תכך, with prefix הנ; cmp. הנדקוקא) pannelled ceiling.
sense.notes: Targ. I Kings VI, 9 (h. text גֵּבִים).

sense.definition: (סבב, Hif.) placing the divans around the table; in.
sense.notes: gen. banquet, meal in company (v. מֵסֵב). Y. Maasr. IV, 51 b top עשה הי' בשדה if one arranges a meal in company in the field. Y. B. Bath. IX, 16 d bot. ועשה לו ה' וכ' and he made the wedding meal for him in the triclinium. Y. Taan. IV, 68 a bot. סדר ה' the position of couches at a banquet. Ib. the patriarchs lie in the grave דרך ה' in the same position to one another as at meals (distinction between seniors and juniors; v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Triclinium).

sense.definition: same; lying down for a meal in company.
sense.notes: Ber. 43 a, v. הֲנִי. Ib. היסבה (Ms. M. הֶסֵּב), v. preced. Ib. 52 b הֶסֵּבַּת גוים Ms. M. (ed. מְסִבַּת) a banqueting of gentiles. Pes. 108 a הֶסּיבַּת ימין lying on the right side at the Passover meal; a. fr.

sense.definition: (סבב; v. Num. XXXVI, 7) the transfer of landed property from one tribe to another.
sense.notes: B. Bath. 111 b הֶסֵּבַּת הבעל ed. (Ms. H. a. Rashb. סִבַּת, סִיבַּת) the transfer which would be caused by the husband’s succeding to his wife’s property. Ib. 112 a ה' הבן Ms. R. (ed. סיבת, סבת) the eventual transfer through the son’s succession.

sense.definition: (סָגַר; v. Lev. XIII, 4, a. e.) locking up the leper for trial; cmp. הֶחֱלֵט.
sense.notes: Y. Meg. I, 71 b מתוך ה' after being locked up. Y. M. Kat. III, 82 c bot.; a. fr.
f. same. Lev. R. s. 17 אין ה' וכ' locking up (סגר, I Sam. XVII, 46) alludes to leprosy.
Num. R. s. 23 והָסוּ כל וכ' and all Israel was silenced before him (to listen to him); Tanḥ. Masé 5 הסבו; ed. Bub. 4 וחסו.
, Y. Snh. VIII, beg. 26 a, read: אכל חסחוסים, v. הַסְחוּס
, v. חַסְחוּס
, v. הֶיסֵּט

Pesik. R. suppl. (p. 197 a ed. Fr.) עושה להם בסאטה בתוך הארץ (read: שולח להם ה' וכ'; corresp. to ירה חצים, Pesik. Vayhi, p. 66 b) he sends (or throws) a spear into their land (as a declaration of war, v. Sm. Ant. a. Luebker Reallex. s. v. Hasta).
, v. הֶסֵּבָּה
, v. הֶיסֵּ'

sense.definition: (נָסַע) = preced. w., (with or sub. הַדַּעַת) discarding, giving up.
sense.notes: Y. Pes. I, 28 b top ה' דבר תורה, v. הֶיסֵּחַ. Y. Shek. VII, beg. 50 c ה' דעת טעון וכ' sacrificial meat whose existence has been forgotten (is unfit and) requires decomposition before it is burnt. Y. Meg. IV, 75 c top מפני ה' ד' because his attention may be diverted (by looking at the priests); Y. Taan. IV, beg. 67 b מסיע (corr. acc.). Y. Pes. X, 37 d bot. מפני ה' הד' because the thought of eating it has been abandonned.
Ar., v. חֲסַם

sense.definition: (סָפַד) funeral ceremonies, manifestations of mourning, funeral address, eulogy &c. M. Kat. III, 8 שלא להרגיל את הה' in order not to invite lamentation.
sense.notes: Tosef. ib. II, 17 ה' על לב hesped means beating on the heart. Y. Ber. III, 6 b top [read:] הסופד וכל העסוקין בה' (v. Tosef. ib. II, 11 ed. Zuck., Var.) the leader of the lamentation and all those engaged in it. Y. Succ. V, 55 b bot. הֶסְפֵּידוֹ של וכ' the mourning for &c. Sabb. 153 a מהספדו של אדם וכ' from the way a person is mourned for you can learn whether he deserves future happiness; a. fr.—קשר ה' to compose and arrange a funeral song. Y. Yeb. XVI, 15 d top מצא ה' קשור וכ' found that lamentations were prepared in his house. Y. Yoma I, 38 b; Y. Sot. I, end, 17 d. Lam. R. introd. (R. Joh. 1).
Targ. Lam. I, 18; a. e.—Ber. 6 b. Succ. 52 a; a. fr.

Yoma 22 b דאוריה ודה' the sin against Uriah and that of counting the people to which he was enticed (II Sam. XXIV, 1). Ḥull. 4 b אין ה' בדברים enticing (the verb הסית) never applies to verbal persuasion (but only to sensual influences). Sifré Deut. 87 אין ה' אלא טעות enticing means leading astray; אין ה' אלא גירוי it means instigation.

sense.definition: (Infin. Hif. of סָתַר) ה' פנים (from Deut. XXXI, 18) hiding of face, divine anger, refusal to answer prayer.
sense.notes: Ḥag. 5 a כל שאינו בה' פ' וכ' he who is not subject to the hiding of face (who does not suffer under general persecution) is none of them (not of Israelitish descent). Ib. b
R. Hash. 27 b, a. e. (ref. to והעברת, Lev. XXV, 9) דרך הַעֲבָרָתוֹ (leave the horn) in the way in which it was borne by the living animal (in its natural shape).

sense.definition: (= הַעֲבָרַת קול) causing the sound to pass over a certain space, proclamation.
sense.notes: Ib. 34 a דיליף ה' ה' ממשה Ms. M. (ed. דגמר עברה ע') we learn the meaning of העביר (Lev. l. c.) from the meaning it has in reference to Moses (Ex. XXXVI, 6). Sabb. 96 b; Yalk. Ex. 413.

sense.definition: leading across, passing; in gen. use of the stem עבר.
sense.notes: Y. Snh. VII, 25 b bot. (interch. with עברה); Sifra K’doshim ch. VIII, Par. 4 מה ה' וכ' as the ‘passing’ there (Deut. XVIII, 10) means through fire, so does the ‘passing’ here (Lev. XVIII, 21). Bekh. 32 a ה' ה' ממעשר analogy between the first-born and the tithes founded on the use of the stem עבר (Ex. XIII, 12, a. Lev. XXVII, 32); (Zeb. 9 a, a. e. עברה).

sense.definition: (from Num. VIII, 7, VI, 5, a. e.) הַעֲבָרַת שיער passing the razor over the hair, shaving.
sense.notes: Naz. 58 b, sq. ה' ש' removing the hair of the body. Y. ib. II, end, 52 b לה' ש' for the purpose of removing the hair, opp. גידול שיער.
B. Mets. 3 a, b הַעֲדָאַת עדים evidence through witnesses; a. e.

sense.definition: (יָעַד) warning given to the owner of a mischievous animal (Ex. XXI, 29); law concerning damages payable after warning, v. מוּעָד.
sense.notes: B. Kam. 18 b יש ה' וכ' the law &c. applies to &c. (and full damages must be paid). Y. ib. II, beg. 2 d; a. fr.

Keth. 43 a לה' concerning the surplus of the value of labor over the cost of sustenance. Ib. 66 a ה' ע"י הדחק a surplus gained through an extraordinary exertion. B. Kam. 87 b. Gitt. 12 a; a. e.—Ib. b לה' for additional support (not included in the sustenance furnished by the master).

sense.definition: (fr. Lev. XIX, 19) throwing over one’s shoulders, wrapping, opp. to לבישה putting on of a dress.
sense.notes: Yeb. 4 b. Yoma 69 a

sense.definition: bringing up, offering on the altar, placing on the table.
sense.notes: Pesik. R. s. 16, end כדי ה' אחת sufficient for one offering; Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 10. Ḥull. 104 a ואנן נגזר ה' and shall we forbid the serving on the table for fear that &c.?

sense.definition: (v. Lev. XVI, 9) taking the lot out of the ballot box.
sense.notes: Y. Yoma IV, 41 c top.

sense.definition: c. (Inf. Nif. of עָלַם) being unknown, esp. (with ref. to Lev. IV to V) unconsciousness, forgetfulness as the cause of a transgression.
sense.notes: Shebu. 26 a ה' שבועה forgetting that he had sworn; ה' חפץ forgetting the subject of the oath. Sabb. 70 b ה' שבת unconsciousness of its being the Sabbath day; ה' מלאכות of the sinful nature of those labors. Ib. אם עשאן … בה' אחד if he did all the forbidden labors in one state of unconsciousness (without being reminded between); Y. ib. III, 9 b top בה' אחת. Ib. I, 2 b בעלם אחד (interch. with בהעלם); B. Bath. 55 b בה' (Ms. H. בעלם); Ker. IV, 2 (17 b) בה' אחת; ib. III, 2 בה' אחד. Sifra Vayikra, Ḥobah, Par. 1, ch. I; a. fr.— Pl. הֵעָלֵימוֹת. Y. Sabb. l. c. בשני ה' in two discontinuous states of forgetfulness. Y. Shebu. I, 32 d top כמה ידיעות וה' many moments of consciousness and intervening forgetfulness. Y. Snh. VII, 24 c top; a. e.—Usu. הַעֲלָמוֹת (fr. הַעֲלָמָה, v. next w.), or הֵעָלֵמוֹת. Sabb. 80 a בשתי ה'; Ker. 17 a; B. Bath. l. c. בשני ה'. Tosef. Ker. III, 2; 7 בשני ה'; a. fr.—[Midr. Till. to Ps. IX, 1 הָעֲלָמוֹת, v. עֶלֶם.]

Shebu. 4 a ה' למלקות מאי עבידתיה how can an act committed through forgetfulness be punished with lashes?—Ib. 14 b ה' היא is this to be considered a sin committed through ignorance (not preceded by knowledge)?— Pl. הַעֲלָמוֹת, v. preced.

B. Kam. 34 a, a. e. כשעת ה' בדין according to the condition of the animal at the time of appearance in court. Bekh. 32 b, a. e. בעי ה' והערכה must be placed (before the priest) and appraised (Lev. XXVII, 11). Ib. בכלל ה' וכ' subject to the law requiring placing &c. Yoma 41 b אה' קאי does it refer to the placing of the sacrifice (to והעמידו, Mish. ib.)?—Y. Maas. III, 54 c top ה' והערכה (interchanging with עמדה).

sense.definition: (Inf. Hif. of עָנַק, with ref. to Deut. XV, 14) the outfitting of the emancipated slave.
sense.notes: Kidd. 17 b לה' (‘and also to thy handmaid shalt thou do likewise’, Deut. XV, 17) refers to the outfit (not to the marking of the ear); Y. ib. I, 59 c bot.; Sifré Deut. 122.
, v. הַעֲרָיָיה

sense.definition: (Inf. Hif. of עָרַב) ה' שמש sunset, required for the unclean person, after purification, to be entirely clean (Lev. XI, 27; a. fr.).
sense.notes: Yoma 6 a והא בעי ה' הש' does he not require the sunset to pass before he may officiate?; a. fr.

sense.definition: going home in the evening from labor (= הַכְנָסָה), opp. to הַשְׁכָּמָה.
sense.notes: Y. B. Mets. VII, beg. 11 b [read:] שתהא השכמה משל בעה"ב וה' משל פועלין that the time needed for going out &c., v. הוֹצָאָה 4). Ib. (not ערבית) ובערבי שבתות בין … ה' וכ' on Sabbath eves both are deducted from the employer’s time.
Lev. R. s. 19; Midr. Sam. ch. V דברי תורה צריכין השחרה וה' הפרנסה מנין the words of the Law require early and late study, whence shall sustenance come?

sense.definition: (עָרָה, v. Lev. XX, 18) sexual contact, the first stage of sexual connection.
sense.notes: Tosef. Sot. I, 2; Y. ib. I, 16 c bot. כדי ה' time long enough for arriving at the intimacy of the first stage. Yeb. 55 b, a. e. ה' זו הכנסת וכ', v. הַכְנָסָה; a. fr.
Bekh. 32 b; a. e., v. הַעֲמָדָה.

sense.definition: (עָרַם) trickery, legal evasion, improper means to avoid a religious duty.
sense.notes: Y. Peah V, 19 b bot.; Y. Ned. IV, end, 38 d לא חשו לה' the Rabbis did not apprehend an evasion. Ib. V, end, 39 b a donation like that of Beth-Horon (v. Mish. ib. 7) שהיתה בה' which was made for the sake of circumventing (a vow). Tosef. B. Mets. IV, 3 הַעֲרָמַת ריבית an evasion of the law of usury; B. Mets. 62 b; Y. ib. V, 10 b top; a. fr.
, v. הֲפַךְ
, Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 12, v. חָפוּת
, v. אִפּוֹתִּיקִי
. Gen. R. s. 69, end.

sense.definition: Haftarah, prophetic lesson read in Synagogue after the reading from the Pentateuch, v. אַפְטַרְתָּא.
sense.notes: Meg. 30 b.— Pl. הַפְטָרוֹת. Ib.; a. e.
Ar., v. חוּפְיָא
, v. הִיפָּטִיקוֹס
, v. הֲפַךְ
adv., v. הֲפַךְ.
Targ. Prov. X, 31 Ms. (ed. דהֲפִיכוּ).— Pl. הֲפִיכָתָא perverse things, perverseness. Ib. XVI, 30.

sense.definition: (הָפַךְ) upturning, displacing, as a symbol of possession.
sense.notes: Y. B. Kam. III, 3 c bot., contrad. to הַגְבָּהָה. [הֲפִיכוֹת, v. הֲפֵכָה.]
Targ. Prov. X, 31, v. הָפִיכָא.
, v. הֲפֶכְתָּא
Gen. R. s. 100 יוסי ה'; v. חֵפָנִי.

sense.definition: (act. verb) to turn; to change; to reverse; to pervert, subvert, destroy.
sense.notes: Ex. R. s. 18 הָפְכָה המדינה שעבודה וכ' a country perverted the rules of forced labor for the captives (treating them inhumanely); ה' עליהם את הדין וכ' he changed the law against them and put them to death by night (against the Jewish law, v. Snh. IV, 1). Ib. ה' סדום He destroyed Sodom. Ber. 55 b כשם שהָפַכְתָּ וכ' as thou didst turn the curse … into blessing, כן הֲפוֹךְ וכ' so do thou turn &c. B. Kam. III, 3 ההוֹפֵךְ את הגלל he who upturns (changes the place of) the dung (taking possession); a. v. fr.— Part. Pass. הָפוּךְ. Pes. 50 a עולם ה' ראיתי וכ' I saw a reversed world, the uppermost below &c. Sabb. 108 b הֲפוּכָה סדום וכ' Sodom is subverted and what is said about it is perverted. Sifra Thazr. Par. 3, ch. III הפוך, הפוכה when its color is changed; a. v. fr.—Y. Naz. V, end, 54 b לשון הפוך, v. הֶפֶךְ.
Sifra ch. IV אי כולי ה' לבן if the whole of it has turned white. Neg. IV, 3; a. fr.

sense.definition: to be upturned, destroyed; to be changed.
sense.notes: Yalk. Esth. 1056 כשנ' סדום when Sodom was subverted. Gen. R. s. 50 ומדינה נֶהְפֶּכֶת, v. אִדְרַבְלָא. Tanḥ. Sh’moth 25 נ' להם מן וכ' the voice turned around, as if coming from &c.; a. fr.

Gen. R. s. 20 שהי' דברים וכ' who spoke perversely of the Creator. Kidd. 59 a עני מְהַפֵּךְ וכ' a poor man turns the cake, and another comes and takes it, i.e. one who buys away what another is negotiating for.
נִתְהַפֵּךְ

sense.definition: to be changed, disguise one’s self.
sense.notes: Gen. R. s. 21 end שהם מִתְהַפְּכִים they (the angels) assume various shapes.

Ib. שהיא מִתְהַפֶּכֶת וכ' for it (the fiery sword) turns around man &c. Yeb. 35 a; Keth. 37 a מתהפכת she turns herself (makes violent motions). Ib. נִתְהַפְּכָה (Keth. l. c. נֶהֶפְכָה).—Tanḥ. Vayetsé 11 היה מ' עליו prevaricated (changing terms).
Ruth R. introd. 3 שהוא מִתְהפֵּךְ ובא וכ' he (Esaw = Rome) schemes and comes against &c.; Yalk. Prov. 959 בא ומְהַפֵּךְ על וכ'. Ib. שהם מִתְהַפְּכִים וכ'; Ruth R. l. c. שמְהַפְּכִין.
Targ. Ps. CV, 29; a. fr.—Y. Sabb. XVI, end, 15 d ה' אפוי he turned his face off.
. Targ. Gen. XIX, 25; a. fr.

Targ. Prov. XXVI, 11; a. e.—Num. R. s. 12 כהדין ברנש … הָפוּךְ לאחוריו like one going down a ladder backwards; Y. R. Hash. II, 58 a כאילין דסלקין בסולמא הֲפִיךְ like those who ascend a ladder backward; Yalk. Job 912 [read:] כהדין דסלקין בסולמא הפוך (v. Lattes Saggio p. 106).

sense.definition: (with ב) to be engaged in, to handle.
sense.notes: Pes. 113 a (prov.) הֲפוֹךְ בנבילתא ולא תֵיפוֹךְ וכ' deal in carcasses, but deal not in words (gossip, sophistry &c.). Y. B. Kam. IV, beg. 4 a אנא הפך ומתהפך בדידי וכ' I turn around my stock of goods (selling and buying again), so that I reach thee in profits. Ab. V, 22 הֲפוֹךְ בה וכ' study it over and again; a. fr.—V. הֲפִיכָא.

sense.definition: l) (= h. הֵשִׁיב) to turn; to bring back, restore; to turn off (wrath), to appease; to give in return, reply.
sense.notes: Targ. Prov. XXV, 13.—Ib. XXIX, 8.—Ib. XXIV, 29 Ms. (ed. אַהֲפֵיךְ Af.).—Ib. 26.—2) to handle, be engaged in, barter, study (v. Pe. 4). Kidd. 59 a דוה מְהַפֵּיךְ בההיא וכ' was negotiating about a field. Sabb. 119 a כמה דלא מְהַפִּיכְנָא בזכותיה before I study what might be said in his favor. Pes. 40 a דמְהַפְּכֵי כיפי who handle sheaves; כי מְהַפְּכִיתוּ הַפִּיכוּ וכ' (Ms. M. הפכיתו) when ye handle (them), handle them with the thought that they will be used for a religious purpose.— Part. pass. מְהַפַּךְ. Y. Maasr. III, end, 51 a היא הפכה והיא מְהַפְּכָה it turns and is turned in all directions (studied over and again), but we can learn nothing from it.
, v. supra.

sense.definition: to be turned, changed; to turn about, deal in &c. Targ. Lev. XIII, 3.
sense.notes: Targ. Job XXX, 21; a. fr.—Y. Maasr. III, end, 51 a, v. supra.
Targ. Jud. VII, 13; a. e.
לְשׁוֹן ה' a phrase which means the reverse (euphemism). Y. Naz. II, 51 d bot. (ed. Krot. הפר, corr. acc.); ib. V, end, 54 b לָשׁוֹן הָפוּךְ.
B. Kam. 29 b כל ה' למטה וכ' the term ‘upturning’ means a movement within three cubits (Var. v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 80).
— Pl. הֲפֵכוֹת, הֲפֵי'. Ber. 55 b שלש ה' three verses in which change (the expression הפך) occurs.
— Pl. הַפְכָנִין. Targ. Y. I Deut. XXXII, 20.
Yalk. Esth. 1056, v. next w.— Pl. הֲפַכְפָּכִין. Ruth R. introd., 3; Yalk. Deut. 945 (Sifré Deut. 320 הֲפַכְפְּכָנִים, v. next w.).
Meg. 15 b (Yalk. Esth. 1056, v. preced.).— Pl., v. preced.
Targ. Gen. XIX, 29. Targ. O. Deut. XXIX, 20 (Ms. מַהֲפֶיכְתָּא); a. e.— Pl. הֲפֵיכָתָא.—Targ. Y. II Gen. XVIII, 2.

sense.definition: distinction, peculiarity, use of the word פלא.
sense.notes: Sabb. 138 b ה' זו וכ' this peculiarity of punishment (Deut. XXVIII, 59) &c.; ה' זו תורה it means the Law (afflictions causing the Law to be forgotten, ref. to Is. XXIX, 14).

sense.definition: distinct and solemn specification of a vow (from Lev. XXVII, 2; Num. VI, 2; v. אִיסְפְּלִיאָה).
sense.notes: Tosef. Naz. III, 19 לא ניתנה נזירות אלא לה' the law of the nazir’s vow applies only to distinct utterance (where there is no doubt); Naz. 34 a; a. e.—Ib. 62 a of the two ki yafli (Lev. l. c. Num. l. c.) אחד ה' לאיסור ואחד ה' וכ' one intimates a distinct binding expression, and one a distinctness which opens the way to absolution (v. הֲָטָה); Ḥag. 10 a אחת ה' וכ'.

Y. B. Kam. II, end, 3 a בה' נגיחות it refers to gorings at intervals (not in three consecutive days). Y. Yoma III, 40 b bot. אם להפליג if the conversation lasted long enough to be considered a discontinuation of the services, opp. לשעה. Ib. עשו אותה כה' they declared it (the going out for easing one’s self, v. מסיכה) to be like a discontinuation.
Y. Ab. Zar. III, 42 d bot. תשובת ה' השיבו he made a reply only to divert his mind (Bab. ib. 44 b תשובה גנובה, v. גָּנַב).
Snh. X, 3; a. fr.
, v. הֶפְלֵג

Pes. 15 b ה' חולין an unnecessary destruction of &c.—Ib., a. fr. ה' מרובה a considerable loss, opp. ה' מועט. Ab. II, 1 ה' מצוה the loss (inconvenience, sacrifice) connected with the performance of a good deed. Ib. V, 11, sq. וצא שכרו בהֶפְסֵדוֹ his advantage is set off by his disadvantage. Lev. R. s. 34 הֶפְסֵדָהּ the disadvantage of (punishment for) neglecting it, opp. שכרה reward for observing it. B. Kam. 115 b מפני ה' כהן because it is an injury to the priest (entitled to it). Sabb. 147 b ה' אוכלין a waste of eatables; a. fr.
B. Kam. 115 b דאיכא ה' (ed. הפסדה, corr. acc., Ms. R. a. F. הפסד). v. פְּסֵידָא

Erub. 54 a און לו ה' וכ' there is no end to it for all eternity. Y. Ber. XI, 10 a bot. ה' ברכה an unlawful interruption between the blessing and the partaking of food. Ib. II, 5 b top ימי ה' intervening days during which menstruation ceased. Ib. IX, 13 c bot.; Midr. Till. to Ps. CIV, 32 ה' מלכות interregnum, anarchy. Y. Yeb. II, 3 d bot. שניות אין להן ה' the secondary degrees of forbidden marriages have no limitation; a. fr.

Gen. R. s. 33 Sivan, the seventh month להַפְסָקַת וכ' counting from the time the rains ceased (Yalk. ib. 59 לירידת). Taan. 4 b לה' with reference to ceasing to insert the mention of rain in the prayers. Lev. R. s. 1, end אין כאן ה' there is nothing intervening (between ויקרא a. וידבר, Lev. I,

Num. R. s. 14, end ה' the intervals in revelations, i.e. passages in the Pentateuch not introduced by vayikra and vaydabber.—Esp. Hafsakah, the Sabbath intervening between the four Sabbaths on which the sections of the Torah, Sh’kalim, Zakhor, Parah and Ha ḥ odesh are severally read, v. פָּרָשָׁה. Meg. 30 a שנייה לה' ‘the second Sabbath’ means that following the Hafsakah.
Ar., v. חַפְצָא
, v. הֶפְקֵרָא

sense.definition: (פָּקַע; cmp. אַפְקַעְתָּא) cancellation, release from debt.
sense.notes: B. Kam. 113 b הַפְקָעַת הלואתו the cancellation of his (the gentile’s) loan.

sense.definition: (Y. dial. הֶבְקֵר) m. (פָּקַר) declaring free, renunciation of ownership in favor of whosoever would take possession of the object renounced; confiscation; public property.
sense.notes: Eduy. IV, 3 הפ' לעניים הפ' Ms. M. (ed. הב', v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) renunciation of ownership (of the standing crop) in favor of the poor is valid (exempting from tithes); (oth. opin.) אינו ה' עד שיפקיר וכ' Ms. M. (ed. שיובקר) it is not valid unless the owner makes it free for the rich, too; Peah IV, 1 (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.); B. Mets. 30 b הפ'. Yeb. 89 b; Gitt. 36 b ה' ב"ד ה' the confiscation by the court (disposing of private property by the process of law) is valid; Y. Shek. I, 46 a bot. הב'. Peah I, 6 ונותן משום ה' or he may set aside a portion of his crop as public property. Y. ib. III, 17 c bot. וה' חייב בפיאה is public property ever subject to the laws of Peah? Ib. V, 19 b אין הֶבְקֵירוֹ ה' his renunciation is ineffectual. Ib. אין ה' יוצא … אלא בזכייה renounced property does not go out of the owner’s possession, until somebody takes possession of it; Y. Ned. IV, 38 d (corr. acc.). Y. Snh. VI, 23 b, beg. ה' טעות הוא it is a confiscation under an erroneous presumption (and invalid); a. fr.—Gen. R. s. 80, end בני אדם של ה' outlaws. Yeb. 66 a מנהג ה' נהגו בה people took liberties with her (because she had neither the legal status of a freed woman nor that of a slave).
Gitt. 13 a עבדא בה' ניחא ליה a slave prefers the dissolute life with a slave (to regular marriage with a free woman); Keth. 11 a

sense.definition: as preced. word. B. Kam. 115 b מה' קא זכינא (in securing the honey from a broken vessel on the road) I took possession of renounced goods.
sense.notes: —Targ. Y. Deut. XXV, 5 הֶפְקֵרָא (הֶפְקְרָא) an unprotected woman

sense.definition: (Inf. Hif. of פָּרַר, פּוּר; fr. Num. XXX, esp. verse 13) the law of ‘hafer’, the husband’s (or father’s) right of declaring void his wife’s (or daughter’s) vow, invalidation.
sense.notes: Ned. X, 7, a. fr. את שבא לכלל הקם בא לכלל ה' whatever comes under the law of hakem (confirmation), comes under the law of hafer (invalidation), i.e. as you cannot confirm a vow before it has been made, so you cannot invalidate a vow in advance. Ib. 69 a; 79 a על הה' in a case where the right of invalidation might have been exercised. Tosef. ib. VII, 5 חומר בהקם שאינו בה' there are restrictions in the law of confirmation which do not apply to the law of invalidation &c. Y. ib. X, 42 a bot. ה' נדרים מעת לעת, v. next w.; a. fr. [In comment. our w. is spelled הפר and הֵיפֵר indiscriminately, which would intimate that it is pronounced הֵפֵר, fr. Num. XXX, 9.]

sense.definition: (preced.) invalidation, declaring void; also absolution for cause (v. הַתָּרָה).
sense.notes: Ned. X, 8 הֲפָרַת נדרים כל היום the right (of the father or the husband) to declare a vow void lasts the whole day on which it came to his notice (to sunset); Y. ib. 42 a bot. הפר נדרים מעת לעת twenty four hours; Tosef. ib. VI, 1; Sabb. 157 a.—Ned. 87 b מה הקמה ממנו אף ה' ממנו as the confirmation may be partial, so may the invalidation &c.; a. fr.—Gitt. 36 a אין לו ה' cannot be absolved from. Shebu. 29 b top כי היכי … ה' in order to make absolution impossible.
— Pl. הִפַּרְכִין, הִפַּרְכֵי, הִי'. Targ. Esth. III, 12.—Ab. Zar. 8 b
Targ. Esth. X, 1 הִפַּרְכֵי ימא (h. text אִיֵי הים); Targ. Y. Gen. XLIX, 13.

Ex. R. s. 18, beg. Yalk. Ps. 875 (to Ps. CXVI, 15) [read:] משל למלך ששלח ה' (v. Midr. Till. to Ps. l. c.); a. e. [Ib. ה' אחרת, read הפרכיא (v. next w.).—Midr. Till. to Ps. XVII בהפרכוס, some ed. בא ה', v. אַפּוֹפְסִין.]— Pl. הִפַּרְכִין, הִי'. Tosef. Gitt. VIII (VI), 3 לשום היפרכון (corr. acc.). V. אִיפַּרְכוֹס.

Sifré Deut. 330; Yalk. ib. 946 [read:] היפטיקוס נכנס לתוך ה' שלו אם יכול ליפרע מכל הוא נפרע ואם לאו וכ' a consul enters his province; if he is able to collect (taxes) from all &c. Yalk. Ps. 875 הפרכוס אחרת (corr. acc.; v. preced.)— Pl. הִפַּרְכִיּוֹת, הִי'. Tosef. Gitt. VIII (VI), 3 ed. Zuck. (v. הורכיינוס).
, v. הַרְפַּנְיָא
Sabb. 155 b ומה ה' בין וכ' and what is the difference between the two? Pes. 27 b אמר להן ה' said he to them, There is a difference; a. fr.
, v. אַפְרָשָׁה
Zeb. V, 4 טעונה ה' ונתוח requires flaying and carving (Lev. I, 6). Ib. 50 b carving שלא בה' without previous flaying. Y. Pes. VI, 33 a bot. הֶפְשֵׁיטוֹ the flaying of it; a. fr.

f. same. Sabb. 116 b קודם הַפְשָׁטַת העור before the hide (up to the chest) is stripped off. Sifra Vayikra, N’dabah, Par. 4, ch. VI (ref. to Lev. I, 6) נתחים שהיו בכלל ה' such pieces as are affected by the order of flaying (to the exclusion of the head which is cut off before flaying); a. e.
, v. הֶפְשֵׁט
Sabb. 40 b הֶפְשֵׁרוֹ זהו בשולו warming is to oil what cooking is to other liquids (a forbidden labor).
, v. הֶפְתֵּק, הֶפְתֵּקָא.
, Yalk. Deut. 942, read: הִיפָּטִיקוֹס.

sense.definition: (פתק to cut, divide off; Var. lect.
sense.notes: v. infra) the store-room in the dwelling house out of which the daily portions of provision and work are distributed; also the retailer’s shelves &c., contrad. to אוצר ware-house. Ab. Zar. II, 7 (39 b) הבאין מן הה' the preserved locusts which the merchant takes from the shelves, contrad. to מן הסלולה, those laid out in baskets in front of the counter. Ib. 40 b מן הה' מן האוצר ומן הספינה (not הסלולה, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 5); Tosef. ib. IV (V), 12 מן הפתק וכ' ed. Zuck. (Var. הפתיק, cmp. הֶמְסֵס for fusion of article) from the shelves, the ware-room or the ship.—Sabb. 50 a; Tosef. ib. III (IV), 19 גיזי צמר של ה' cut wool stored in the pantry (intended for spinning; Rashi: from the merchant’s shelves). [Ar. s. v. אפתק reads: אוּפְתֵּק, noting a Var. ה'. One Ms. Ar., a. Mish. ed. Nap. read אפותיק for אוּפְתֵּיק, induced by phonetic resemblance to ἀποθήκη. V. Ar. ed. Koh. s. v. אפתק, a. Rabb. D. S. to Ab. Zar. 39 b note 8.]
Targ. Y. Gen. XLVII, 14. Ib. Deut. XXIII, 22 (constr.) בהַפְתֵּיק וכ' in the treasury of the Lord (v. Ḥull. 139 a quot. s. v. גִּזָּא).
, read: הִפּוֹתִּיקָאוֹת; הפתקי, read: הִפּוֹתִּיקִי.
, v. הַצָּתָה

sense.definition: (יצב) standing, use of the verb יצב.
sense.notes: Num. R. s. 18, beg.; Tanḥ. Koraḥ 3 (analogy betw. Num. XVI, 27 a. I Sam. XVII, 4, a. 16). Pesik. Zutr. Nitsab. beg. יש ה' לטובה וכ' the word יצב is sometimes used in a good sense (as firmness) and at times in a bad sense (as provocation); v. יְצִיבָה.
, v. הצֶּלְפּוֹנִי

Meg. 16 b הצָּלַת נפשות saving of human lives. Gitt. 56 a (in Chald. diction) אפשר דהוי ה' פורתא may be some little relief (by royal favor) can be had; ib. b וה' פורתא נמי וכ' and even a little favor will not be shown. Ḥull. 52 b הצלת עצמה the animal’s own effort to save itself; ה' אחרים the human efforts to save the animal. Ex. R. s. 1 ה' מים saving from drowning; a. fr.

sense.definition: (b. h.) pr. n. f. Hazzelelponi, alleged name of Samson’s mother.
sense.notes: Num. R. s. 10; B. Bath. 91 a צְלֶלְפּוֹנִית ed. (Ms. R. הצללפונית, Ms. R. צלולפונית).

sense.definition: (cmp. preced.), בני ה' prob. name fo a family settled in Babylonia.
sense.notes: M. Kat. 22 a (Ms. M. הצלבוני).
Pesik. Sos, p. 146 b; Yalk. Job 906; (Yalk. Gen. 93 הַצְנֵיעוּת).

sense.definition: (יָצַע) making a couch, laying out of mattresses, carpets &c. Keth. 4 b, a. e. הַצָּעַת המטה making the bed (for her husband).
sense.notes: Yoma 69 a בה' שרי for spreading under (to sit or lie on), garments of mixed materials (כלאים) are permitted.—V. מַצָּע.—Trnsf. arrangement, structure, construction. Ḥull. 49 b כך היא ה' של משנה וכ' the construction of the Mishnah (Boraitha) is as you stated, but reverse the first clause. Snh. 51 a; a. e.
Y. Sabb. II, beg. 4 c צריכה הצאתה ברוב וכ' (corr. acc.) must be kindled so that the larger portion be on fire, v. דֶּלֶק. Y. Yoma II, 39 c top; Bab. ib. 24 b הַצָּתַת וכ' kindling of &c.
Shebu. 35 b; Sabb. 127 (Ms. M. קַבָּלַת) ה' פני שכינה receiving the Divine Presence.

sense.definition: that which is dedicated to a sacred purpose, esp. sacred or Temple property.
sense.notes: Yeb. 66 b bot., a. fr. ה' וכ' a pledged animal which the debtor dedicates as a sacrifice &c., v. פָּקַע. Gen. R. s. 60 ה' דמים; Arakh. VIII, 7 ה' עילוי dedication of the value of an object; opp. ה' מזבח dedication for the altar (allowing no redemption). Ib. VII, 1 אין מחשבין חדשים לה' months are not counted for redeeming dedicated property, i.e. fractions of a year count for a year in favor of the treasury. Kidd. 2 b דאסר לה אכ"ע כה' because (by betrothing her to himself) he makes her forbidden to all other men like sacred property (v. קָדַשׁ). Taan. 24 a הרי הן ה' עליך וכ' they shall be to thee sacred property (like charity funds); a. v. fr.

Arakh. 2 a; Tem. 2 a תחלת ה' a preliminary act of dedication, סוף ה' the final dedication (laying hands on the animal’s head prior to sacrificing it). Ib. 9 b; B. Mets. 54 b ה' ראשון the original dedication, ה' שני the substitution (for an animal which became defective); a. fr.— Pl. הֶקְדֵּישׁוֹת, הֶקְדֵּשׁ' 1) sacred objects. Lev. R. s. 5; a. fr.—2) laws concerning dedication. Tosef. Erub. XI (VIII), 24; ib. Ḥag. I, 9 (ed. Zuck. והקרקעות, corr. acc.); a. e.

Ker. V, 1 דם ה' שהנפש יוצאה בו the blood of arteries with which life goes out, i.e. the splashing blood; ib. 22 a. Nidd. 19 b.—Gitt. 70 a הַקָּזַת דם blood-letting. Sabb. 29 a סעודת ה' Ms. M. (ed. ה' דם) the meal taken after blood-letting; a. fr.

sense.definition: (קטר) letting rise in smoke, burning on the altar.
sense.notes: Ber. I, 1; a. fr.
Y. Pes. VII, 34 c top. Y. Yoma II, 39 c; a. e.— Pl. הַקְטָרוֹת. Tosef. Dem. II, 7 הה'; Men. 18 b Ms. M. (ed. הק'); Ḥull. 132 b הק' (v. הֶמְסֵס as to fusion of article).
, v. הֶיקֵּ'
, v. הֶיקֵּ'

sense.definition: (Inf. Hif. of קוּם, formed for analogy with הָפֵר q. v.) confirmation, the privilege of confirming a vow.
sense.notes: Ned. X, 7; a. fr. (comment. write indiscriminately הקם a. הֵיקֵם, analogous to הֵיפֵר).

sense.definition: same. Ned. 69 a ה' ראשונה the first confirmation (when he said the first קיים ליכי).
sense.notes: Ib. ולא תיחול ה' but my confirmation shall not take effect; a. e.

R. Hash. 2 b להֲקָמַת המשכן dating from the erection of the Tabernacle. Y. Yoma I, 38 c top; Num. R. s. 12, a. e. ה' הלילה the putting up (of the Tabernacle) by night; a. e.— Pl. הֲקָמוֹת. Ib. הֲקָמוֹתָיו his repeated acts of putting up.
f., v. אַקְנָיָיתָא
, v. הֶיקֵּ'
, v. אַקְפָּדָה
Yoma 59 a ה' ברגל the sprinkling was done in walking around; ה' ביד by circular movements of the hand. Pesik. R. s. 41 הַקָּפַת המזבח going around the altar in procession with the Lulab; a. e.

sense.definition: (ref. to Lev. XIX, 27) shaving the hair of the head all around.
sense.notes: Naz. 29 a ועביד ה' and he (the Nazir) may shave &c. Ib. הַקָּפַת כל הראש shaving the entire head, opp. to ה' פאה shaving the ends, v. פֵּאָה. Y. Sot. II, beg. 17 d ה' נזירות the shaving required by Nazir laws (Num. VI, 18); a. e.

sense.definition: growth of hair around a limb.
sense.notes: Y. Yeb. X, end, 11 c; Snh. 68 b

sense.definition: debts for merchandise payable at certain seasons (cmp. תְּקוּפָה).
sense.notes: Shebi. X, 1; Tosef. ib. VIII, 3 הקפת חנות וכ' shop-debts are not subject to the law of limitation in the Sabbatical year.— Pl. הַקָּפוֹת. Gen. R. s. 41 he came back לפרוע הַקָּפוֹתָיו to pay his debts; Yalk. ib. 69.
Midr. Till. to Ps. XVII, 15 הֲקָצַת המתים resurrection of the dead.

sense.definition: (קוּץ, קָצַץ) cutting, הֲקָצַת שפתים (cmp. Prov. XVI, 30) cutting the lips, i.e. contracting the mouth for a blasphemous expression.
sense.notes: Snh. 65 a Ar. a. Ms. K. (ed. עקימת, v. עֲקִימָה).

sense.definition: (Inf. Hif. of קוּר; cmp. Jer. VI, 7) welling, pouring forth (cmp. מָקוֹר).
sense.notes: (בּוֹר) בְּאֵר ה' well, opp. to cistern; esp. B’er Haker name of a certain well. Erub. X, 14. Ib. 104 b כל הבורות ה' Ms. M. (ed. incorr. הקרות); Y. ib. II, beg. 20 a

sense.definition: offering, use of the verb הִקְרִיב.
sense.notes: Men. 11 a בת ה' היא it is an object which may eventually be offered. B. Kam. 12 b חזי לה' fit for offering (if the Temple existed). Erub. 63 b, a. e. גדול … מהקְרָבַת תמידין study of the Law is more important than the offering of daily sacrifices. Lev. R. s. 2, end נאמר ה' וכ' the term הקריב is used &c. Ib. s. 20 they died על הקריבה ועל ה' (= הַהַ') for coming near (Lev. XVII,
Ex. R. s. 21 הקרבת פרעה (Ex. XIV, 10).
Sifra Num. 159; Yalk. ib. 787 (interpret. הקריתם, Num. XXXV, 11).
, v. הֶיקֵּ'
Snh. 65 a הַקָּשַׁת זרועותיו the clapping of his (the necromancer’s) arms; Ker. 3 b.— Pl. הַקָּשֹׁות. Ib. (Snh. l. c. always sing.).

Midd. II, 1, a. fr. הַר הבית the Temple mount. Yeb. 17 a (play on ה̇ר̇פ̇נ̇יא) ה̇ר̇ שהכל פ̇ונ̇ין בו a hill to which all turn (whose spurious descent prevents them from getting wives elsewhere); a. v. fr.—Ḥull. 39 b (in Chald. diction) רישיך והר here is thy head and here the mountain (a colloquial phrase for compelling one to give up a bargain).—Ex. R. s. 28 (ref. to Ex. XIX, 3) בזכות הה' for the merit of the distinguished one (Abraham), ואין הה' אלא אבות har means the patriarchs (ref. to Mic. VI, 2). Snh. 107 a ה' שבכם the most prominent of you; a. fr.—[For proper nouns composed with הר, v. respective determinants.]— Pl. הָרִים, הֲרָרִים. Tam. 32 a, a. e. הָרֵי חושך, v. חו̇שֶׁךְ.—Snh. 24 a עוקר הרי הרים uprooting the highest mountains (a figure for dialectical ingenuity). Y. Yeb. I, 3 a bot. בין שני הֶהָ' וכ' between the two high mountains (great scholars). Ex. R. s. 15 ואין ה' אלא אבות, v. supra.—Ḥag. I, 8 כה' תלויין בשערה like mountains suspended on a hair (a slender Bible text for numerous Talmudic laws); a. v. fr.
אַהֲרֵי (cmp. חרי, חרר) to heat, irritate. Targ. Prov. XXV, 20 מַהֲרָא (Var. מַהְרָה) ed. Lag. (ed. מחרא, ed. Wil. מחדא, corr. acc.); v. בּרְיוּתָא.—Cmp. הִרְהֵר, חִרְחֵר.

sense.definition: (Inf. Hif. of רָבָה) to increase; the numerical value of the letters ה̇ר̇ב̇ה̇ = 212 (days).
sense.notes: Gen. R. s. 20 (play on הרבה ארבה, Gen. III, 16) כל שהוא ה' ארבה וכ' if an embryo is 212 days old, I shall cause it to grow (it is vital); Y. Nidd. I, 49 b top כל שהוא בה' הרי הוא בארבה; v. אל"ף.

sense.definition: (רָבַע) the ( forbidden) coupling of heterogeneous animals.
sense.notes: Snh. 56 b הַרְבָּעַת בהמה; Sifra Aḥaré Par. 9, ch. XIII. Ḥull. 71 a לה' with reference to forbidden coupling; a. e.

sense.definition: (b. h.) [ to cut, v. הֶרֶג,] to kill, put to death.
sense.notes: Num. R. s. 21, beg. בא לַהֲרָגְךָ השכם להָרְגֹּו if one comes to kill thee, be the first to kill him; Ber. 58 a; Snh. 72 a להֹורְגְּךָ … להֹורְגֹו. Gitt. 56 b כסבור ה' את עצמו he (Titus) thought he had killed himself (euphem. for the Lord); a. v. fr.— Part. pass. הָרוּג. Tosef. Gitt. V (III), 1 הֲרוּגִין שנהרגו לפני מלחמה ובשעת מלחמה (ed. Zuck. בשעת) those executed (by the Roman government) before and during the Vespasian war; Y. Gitt. V, 47 b top [read:] הֲרוּגֵי המלחמה ולפני וכ'. Y. Ber. I, 3 d, v. בִּיתֵּר. Pes. 50 a; B. Bath. 10 b, a. e. הרוגי מלכות martyrs under the Roman government (R. Akiba and his fellow-martyrs), v. לוּד; a. fr.
Taan. 18 b נֶהֶרְגוּ were put to death (by the Roman government). Gitt. 56 a יֵהָרֵג is to be put to death. Snh. 74 a עבור ואל תֵּהָרֵג transgress or thou wilt be killed; a. fr.

sense.definition: (preced.) murderer, highway-man, contrad. to חרם the oppressor who does not threaten to kill.
sense.notes: Y. B. Mets. IV, end, 9 d.— Pl. הָרָגִין. Ned. III, 4, v. נָדַר.

sense.definition: preced. wds.) execution by decapitation with a sword.
sense.notes: Snh. VII, 1; a. fr.

sense.definition: (prob. = אַרְגָּז q. v.) euphem. for buttocks (or testicles).
sense.notes: Bekh. VI, 6 הַרְגִּיזֹו Maim., Ar. Var. הַרְגֹּוזֹו, ed. אָכוּז q. v.

sense.definition: habit; ה' לשון habit of the tongue, fluency acquired by memorizing.
sense.notes: habit of the tongue, fluency acquired by memorizing. Koh. R. to VI, 9.
מפני ה' עבירה because it offers an occasion for sin. Sabb. I, 3; Pes. 30 a; 36 a; a. e.—Ab. Zar. 17 a ה' דבר (euphem.) preliminaries of sexual connection.
, v. חַרְנֹוגָא
, v. חַרְגִּינִּין

Nidd. 43 a נעקרה בה' he felt the effusion coming, ויצתה שלא בה' but the discharge was not perceived. Ib. 57 b הַרְגָּשַׁת מי וכ' the sensation of discharging urin; a. fr. Yalk. Jud. 42 לכל ה' וה' to every sense.— Pl. הַרְגָּשֹׁות senses. Num. R. s. 14 כנגד חמש ה' וחמש מורגשות corresponding to the five senses and the five perceptions.
, v. חַרְגָּא
, v. הִרְדַּוְלִיס
Targ. Ps. CL, 4 Ms. (Regia הרדיב', ed. חֲלִילִין).
m. same. Arakh. 10 b (not … לים); Tosef. ib. I, 13 הרדאולים לא היו וכ' ed. Zuck. (corr. acc.; ed. הִדְרַאוְלִי' לא היה); cmp. אִדְרַבְלִיס.

sense.definition: (transpos. of דרס, v. מִדְּרָא, מִדְּרֹון &c.) the copulation of birds; מעשה ה' unnatural gratification on a woman’s body.
sense.notes: Snh. 66 b Ar. (ed. חידודין; v. הֲרוּרִים). [Ar.: doing of Herod, ref. to B. Bath. 3 b; v. הֹורְדֹּוס.]

sense.definition: (comp. of הר = חר, a. דֹּופָן; v. חַרְחֲבִינָה) wall-ivy, the leaves of which may be used for bitter herbs on the Passover night.
sense.notes: Pes. 39 a (Ms. M. הַרְרְּפַ'). V. הַרְרַּפְנֵי.

sense.definition: , יוני ה' a species of domesticated doves (prob. so named from the manner of their fructification, v. הִרְדּוּס).
sense.notes: Ḥull. XII, 1; Bets. 25 a; Tosef. ib. I, 10; Tosef. Ḥull. X, 9 הרד' ed. Zuck. (Var. הדר'). Ḥull. 139 b חד תני הדר' וחד תני הרד' וכ' one reads hadr., and one reads hard., the one deriving our w. from Herod, the other from the name of a place.

sense.definition: (הדף, with ר inserted; cmp. הִירְדּוּף [ removal, isolation,] imprisonment within a narrow enclosure of reeds or poles, a punishment for contempt of court (v. נִידּוּי).
sense.notes: M. Kat. 16 a (explain. לִשְׁרֹושִׁי, Ezra VII, 26). Ib. (a version of the Gaonim quoted by Asheri a. l., Nr. 53) מאי ה' א"ר פפא נצבי דקני what is hardafah? Said R. P., Poles of reeds (fastened in the ground). [In ed. a. Mss. the answer to מאי ה' is absent.] [Ar. ed. Koh. הִרְדֹּופָה.]
, v. next w.

sense.definition: (Chald. form of הַרְיֹּופַנִּין) a creeper the berries of which were known to be injurious to animals.
sense.notes: Ḥull. III, 5 (58 b); Tosef. ib. III, 19.—Mekh. B’shall., Vayassa 1 (ref. to Ex. XV, 25) זה עץ ה' it was the trunk of an ivy; Ex. R. s. 50; (ib. s. 23 ירדינון); Yalk. ib. 256 הרדפוני (corr. acc.); Tanḥ. B’shall. 24 ה' מר היה; Tanḥ., ed. Bub., ib. 19.—[Var. הירדופני, v. Koh. Ar. s. v.]—Targ. Y. Ex. XV, 25 אַרְדַּפְנֵי.
, v. הַרְדֹּופַ'

sense.definition: (b. h.) to conceive, be with child.
sense.notes: Yalk. Ex. 168, end. Y. B. Kam. V, 5 a top; Bab. ib. 49 a

sense.definition: to be conceived ; *(homilet.) conception, v. הֹורָת.
sense.notes: Gen. R. s. 64; Yalk. Job 894 that she would have said to him, ה' גבר is this a time for conception, man? (‘Rashi’).
v. הִירְ'

sense.definition: urin-soaked dung, v. דָּהוֹן a. דְּהֵין.
thought, meditation, opp. דיבור loud recitation.
sense.notes: Ber. 20 b ה' כדיבור דמי reviewing in mind (a Biblical passage &c.) is as good as loud recitation. Sabb. 150 a (ref. to Is. LVIII, 13) דיבור אסור ה' וכ' talking (business on the Sabbath) is forbidden, thinking (planning) is permitted.

Ber. 12 b ה' עבירה unchaste imagination, ה' ע"ז idolatrous fancy. Nidd. 13 b המביא עצמו לידי ה' who allows sinful fancies to take a hold of him. Zab. II, 2; a. fr.— Pl. הִרְהוּרִים. Yoma 29 a top הִרְהוּרֵי עבירה וכ' sinful (obscene) imaginations are more injurious to health than the sin itself. Esth. R. to III, 1 (play on aḥar) הרהורי דברים היו שם plans (schemes) were there.

Targ. O. Deut. XXIX, 18. Targ. Y. ib. XXIII, 11; a. e.—Snh. 45 a חיישי לה' take into consideration the possibility of creating impure thoughts (among the spectators); Sot. 8 a.— Pl. הַרְהֹורִין, הִרְהוּרִין, הִירְ'. Targ. Y. Lev. VI, 2. Targ. Ez. XXXVIII, 10; a. fr.

sense.definition: (Pilp. of הרר; v. הָרָה, cmp. esp. Is. LIX, 13)
to conceive in mind, to think, meditate, plan.
sense.notes: Ber. III, 4 מְהַרְהֵר בלבו thinks (recites the Sh’ma) in his heart, v. הִרְהוּר. Gitt. 57 b הי' תשובה בדעתיה he conceived the idea of repentance.

sense.definition: to be heated, entertain impure thoughts.
sense.notes: Ḥull. 37 b לא הִרְהַרְתִּי ביום I allowed no impure thoughts to rise in me in day-time; a. fr.

sense.definition: (followed by אחר) to disparage, criticise, detract from.
sense.notes: Snh. 110 a המְהַרְהֵר אחר רבו who speaks evil of his teacher. Num. R. s. 7 אם הִרְהַרְתָּ וכ' if thou criticisest them &c. Ber. 19 a אל תְּהַרְהֵר אחריו ביום do not think evil of him the day after (for he surely repented). Sifré Deut. 307 אין להַרְהֵר אחר מדותיו you must not criticise His dealings with man; a. fr.

sense.definition: to heat, make sick with fever.
sense.notes: Lev. R. s. 17 (play on ח̇ר̇צבות, Ps. LXXIII, 4; v. ה"א) לא הִרְהַרְתִּים בחלאים (Var. חרחר'; Ar. s. v. חרצב: ערער') I did not make them hot with diseases; Yalk. Ps. 808. [Ukts. III, 11, v. חרְחֵר.]
Targ. Y. Gen. VI, 2.—Targ. Job II, 10 הַירְהֵר; a. fr.
, Y. Kil. I, 27 a, v. נֵיוְיָינָא
M. Kat. 2 a
Ex. R. s. 10, end; Tanḥ., ed. Bub., Vaëra 22; Yalk. Ex. 186 (cmp. הֶמְסֵס as to fusion of article). Tanḥ. Mikk. 10, v. בָּסַר I; a. e.

Snh. 21 b לא צריכא לה' the word לֹו is to intimate a liberal appropriation (for the army). Sifré Deut. 306 ואין לשון פתיחה אלא לשון ה' the word ‘opening’ has the meaning of comfort, opp. לשון דוחק. Keth. 43 a אלמנתו לא ניחא ליה בה' וכ' as to his widow he cares not for her living comfortably (from her own earnings besides the legal alimentation) &c.
, Tosef. Toh. VIII, 1, v. חֲדוּיִין

sense.definition: (הרר, v. הִרְהֵר) heating, מעשה ה' unnatural gratification on a woman’s body.
sense.notes: Snh. 66 b, Resp. Gaon. ed. Cassel, p. 110; v. הִרְדּוּס, a. חִידּוּד.

sense.definition: (Rashi) (v. אַרְזַפְתָּא II) name of a bitter herb (not generally used as food).
sense.notes: Pes. 39 a (Ms. M. 2 אַרְזִיפָּא, Ms. O. הדרוף, v. הִירְדּוּף; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 9).

B. Kam. 85 b הַרְזְקֵיה באנדרונא וכ' Ar. (ed. הדק') he kept him locked up in a room and forced him to be idle.— Part. pass. מְהַרְזַק. Ned. 91 b דהוה קא מ' בביתא וכ' Ar. (ed. מִהַרְזֵיק Ithpa.) who was locked up in a room with a woman.

sense.definition: (preced.) בֵּי ה' guard-house, a gate house with one door opening to the court and another leading to the entrance to the inner rooms or buildings; cmp. כְּלָאֵי.
sense.notes: Men. 33 b
, v. הַרְזִיק
Sabb. 134 b הַרְחָצַת כל גופו bathing the child’s entire body; ה' מילה bathing the wound of circumcision. Keth. 96 a

—ה' עדות a) an unlawful space between a deed and the signatures of the witnesses. Y. Gitt. I, 43 c bot. עדים פסולין אינן נעשין כה' ע' the signatures of disqualified witnesses, between qualified ones, are not to be looked upon as if they were a blank creating an unlawful distance; ib. IX, 50 c; ib. VIII, end, 49 d (insert: עדים פסולים אינן).—b) distance of relationship, i.e. testimony not objectionable on account of kinship. Y. Keth. II, 26 d top [read:] ואם אין את מאמינו שהוא בנו יעשה כה' ע' וכ' and if you do not believe him that he is his son, let his statement (that he is a priest) be considered a stranger’s testimony &c.

sense.definition: a precautionary measure, a preventive law.
sense.notes: Y. Maasr. I, 49 b top.
f. as preced. 2. Pes. 2 b. Ab. Zar. 31 b ה' יתירתא an extraordinary precaution.
, v. רְטִיבָה

sense.definition: (= הראי; ראה) aspect, characteristic points, case.
sense.notes: B. Kam. I, 1 (ref. to the four cases of damage Ex. XXI, 28; XXI, 33; XXII, 4; XXII, 5) לא ה' השור כה' וכ' (Y. ed. לא השור כה' וכ') the case of the goring ox is not analogous to that of the eating animal, nor are the cases of both of them which are animated beings, analogous to the case of damage through fire which is inanimate &c. (i.e. the four cases had to be specified in the Biblical text); yet the points common to all are that they are liable to do damage &c. Mekh. Mishp., N’zikin, s. 5 לא ה' הדיין כה' וכ' the case of (cursing) the judge is not analogous to that of (cursing) the prince, yet the point common to both &c. [In G’marah רְאִי, v. B. Kam. 4 a.]

Gen. R. s. 91, end ה' הכסף וכ' here is the silver &c.—Ab. III, 4, a. fr. ה' זה וכ' such a person is &c. Bets. V, 3, a. fr. ה' אלו וכ' in this case they are &c. B. Kam. IX, 2 ה' שלך לפניך here is thy property before thee (take it in the condition in which it is); a. v. fr.—הֲרֵינִי = ה' אני behold, I am, will be &c. Naz. I, 1 ה' נזיר I will be a Nazir. Kidd. 31 b ה' כפרת וכ' may I be the atonement for his rest (a blessing formula for a deceased father); a. fr.

sense.definition: ה' ש'־ here is a case of one, if.

Sabb. 107 b.—Esp. execution of capital punishment, decapitation. Y. Keth. II, 26 d נגמר דינה לה' if she has been sentenced to death. Y. Snh. VII, 24 b ה' decapitation, v. הֶרֶג. Ex. R. s. 1; a. fr.
Targ. II Esth. III, 1 (ed. Lag. הדירוס).
Nidd. 16 b. Gen. R. s. 64. Y. B. Kam. V, 5 a top בעל ה' the natural father (not step-father); a. e.—B. Kam. 49 a בית הה' womb, abdomen.

Sot. 42 b (homiletical play on Harafah, II Sam. XXI, 16, a. Orpah, Ruth I, 4) why was she called Harafah? שהכל דשין אותה כה' because all pounded (used) her like grits, v. דּוּשׁ. [Cmp. Y. Kidd. I, 59 a top a. Kerith. 11 a where חרף is taken as the equivalent of כתש, with reference to הריפות Prov. XXVII, 22. Cmp. הַלְטָאָה for obliteration of radical ה.—Targ. I Chr. XX, 4; 6; 8 reads ערפה for h. text הרפאים, הרפא.]

sense.definition: separating the priest’s gift &c. Bets. I, 6 (12 b) אינו זכאי בהֲרָמָתָהּ (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) nobody obtains a privilege by its being set apart; a. fr.

תחת שהייתי … תלוי ראש נתת לי הֲרָמַת ראש וכ' while I deserved hanging down the head (in the consciousness of guilt), thou hast granted me a lifting up of the head (forgiveness, II Sam. XII, 13); ib. (ref. to תשא Ex. XXX, 12) … תחת שהיינו תלוי ראש … ה' ראש; Pesik. Shek. 10 b, sq. (corr. acc.); Midr. Till. to Ps. l. c.; Yalk. Ex. 365 (corr. acc.). Tanḥ. Emor 16.

sense.definition: Harmine ( Hurmini), prob. a province of Armenia.

הר, cmp. הרפתקי) appointment to office, authority, royal patent. Targ. Job I, 12; II, 7. Targ. Y. Num. XVII, 11.—Ber. 58 a holding court בלא ה' דמלכא without royal appointment. B. Mets. 84 a ה' דמלכא הוא (Ms. R. 2 הור') it is a royal appointment (which I cannot decline). Ḥull. 57 b ה' דמלכא לא ליבעו would they not have asked for royal authority? Ib. ה' דמלכא הוו נקיטי they were in possession &c.; (Ar. ed. Koh. the king was among them ומה' דמלכא עבוד and they did it by royal authority). B. Bath. 46 b, v. next w.— Trnsf. (cmp. רָשׁוּת) office, bureau, esp. Resh Galutha’s office. Erub. 59 a משום דשכיחי רבנן גבי ה' (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 300) because scholars are accustomed to meet at the Resh Galutha’s office (Ar. קהרמנא).

f. same. B. Bath. 46 b ה' בעלמא שויוה they (the owners) considered it (the transmission of the land to subtenants) merely an appointment (agency); (Asheri הרמנא שׁוְיָהּ; Ar. הרמנא; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90).
