Bekh. 52 b ח' והוה שובלי (if on the father’s death) what was available of the products of the ground was classed under ḥ. (vegetable, e. g. green of grains), and now it is shublé (ears); B. Bath. 124 a (Ms. M. חֲפוּרֵי והוו). Yeb. 63 a מאה … מילחא וח' invest a hundred Zuz in land, and you will have salt and common vegetable.

sense.definition: (preced.) fruits belonging to the class of ḥ ãfurah, inferior produces.
sense.notes: Pesik. Asser, p. 100 a; Tanḥ. R’eh 18; Yalk. Deut. 897.
—ח' לבא mine of the heart, seat of deep-laid plans. Targ. Ps. LXXIII, 7, v. חוֹטְבָא.

sense.definition: (חָפַשׁ) a grant of emancipation, pardon, liberty.
sense.notes: Gen. R. s. 53, a gloss expl. דּוֹרִיָּיה (some ed. חפושיה; Yalk. Gen. 92 חָפְשִׁיּוּת).
, v. חִיפּ'

sense.definition: (b. h.) to be in haste, to hurry.

sense.notes: Pirke d’R. El. ch. XXVI נבהל ונֶחְפָּז frightened and excited.
Ber. 9 a (ref. to Ex. XII, 1

sense.definition: עד שעת ח' (which means, you may eat of the Passover lamb) up to the time of leaving in haste.
sense.notes: Ib. על שעת ח' וכ' (they differ) as to the time of ḥ ippazon; R. El. saying ח' דמצרים hipp. refers to the hastening of the Egyptians (ib. 30, sq., at night), while R. Ak. refers it to ח' דישראל the haste of the Israelites (in the morning, Num. XXXIII, 3); Mekh. Bo, s. 7 זה חֶפְזוֹן מצרים this (Ex. XII, 11) refers to &c. Ib. ח' שכינה the haste (anxiety) of the Deity. Sifré Deut. 130 (ref. to Deut. XVI, 3) יכול ח' לישראל ולמצרים you might think, there was anxiety (fear) on the part of Israel and of Egypt. Pes. IX, 5. Ib. 96 a אותו נאכל בח' וכ' this was eaten in haste, but no other &c.—Ex. R. s. 19; a. e.

Ḥull. III, 7 וכנפיו חוֹפִין וכ' and whose wings cover the largest portion of its body. Sot. IX, 15 (49 a) וחָפוּ ראשם and covered their heads (in shame).—Part. pass. חָפוּי. Esth. R. to VI, 12 וחֲפוּי ראש וכ' and his head covered (in shame) over what had happened to him; Meg. 16 a
Yoma 47 a חוֹפֶה שלש וכ' he bends three of his fingers (grasping with them) up to &c.; cmp. חָפַן.

Tosef. Kil. I, 15 המְחַפֶּה who covers up (mixed seeds with earth); M. Kat. 2 b; Macc. 21 b. Ib. החופה ed. (Ms. M. המח'). Y. Kil. VII, 31 b לא במחפה is it not because in plowing over he covers the seeds up? Shebi. IV, 5 לא יְהַפֵּהוּ בעפר he must not cover it (the cut) with loose ground, opp. to (כסה) covering with stones. Y. Taan. II, beg. 65 a אבותינו חִיפּוּ … חִיפִּינוּ וכ' our ancestors covered it (the reader’s desk) with gold, and we with dust. Nidd. 16 a ותְחַפֶּנָּהּ וכ' and semen virile may have covered it up; a. e.

sense.definition: to cover over, to protect from justice, to be partial.
sense.notes: Shebu. 39 a מפני שמְחַפִּין עליו because they (the publican’s or robber’s relations) protect him. Ex. R. s. 30 היו מְחַפִּין אותו tried to protect him; a. e.

sense.definition: (cmp. גָּבַב) [ to heap up words,] to invent fictions (v. II Kings XVII, 9).
sense.notes: Gen. R. s. 94 (play on הפים, ib. XLVI, 21) שחִיפּוּ עליו דברים וכ' about whom they invented a fiction (Gen. XXXVII, 3).

Targ. Ex. XXXVI, 34; a. fr.—Targ. Ez. XXVI, 19 ויִחֲפוּנִיךְ they shall cover thee up (bury).—Targ. Y. Deut. XXXII, 11 וחָפָא וכ' he spread over them the shade etc.—Ab. Zar. 39 a חַפְיֵיה בדיקולא Ms. M. (ed. חפיא, incorr.) he put a basket over it. Sot. 22 b דחֲפוּ, v. גּוּנְדָּא II.
Targ. Is. XL, 19; a. e.—Part. pass. מְחַפָּא, pl. מְחַפִּין, f. מְחַפַּן. Targ. Ex. XXVI, 32.
2. Targ. Y. Lev. XX, 5 (cmp. Shebu. 39 a).
Targ. Ex. XXVI, 29; a. e. (ed. Berl. תִחְפֵּי Pe.).
Targ. I Kings XVIII, 45. Targ. Is. XLII, 22 אִתְחֲ' בהתא were covered with shame (h. text הפח); a. e.
— Pl. חפְיֵי. Targ. Y. Num. XVII, 3, sq.; v. חוֹפָאָה.
Koh. R. to I, 3 לגרמיה ח' הוא (some ed. חַפְיָה) he is concerned about himself (his honor, because he has not been invited.)

sense.definition: (v. חפף II a. חוּף I; cmp. יָחֵף) barefooted (in mourning).
sense.notes: Gen. R. s. 100 נפיק ח' (some ed. חפי) went out barefooted, opp. לביש סנדלוי.
, v. הַפְיָא I

sense.definition: (חָפַן) the priest’s taking handfuls of incense (Lev. XVI, 12).
sense.notes: Yoma 19 a top ללמדו ח' (they took him to the house of Abtinas) to teach him the manipulation of ḥ ãfinah. Ib. וגמר ח' and he learned ḥ ãf. Ib. 49 a בחֲפִינָתוֹ with what the dying highpriest had seized with his hands. Men. 11 a והאיכא ח' is there not ḥ ãfinah among the difficult priestly functions?; a. e.

ḥ afaš, a. ḥ af ṣ) a small leather bag, valise (for documents &c.). B. Mets. I, 8, expl. ib. 20 b חמת קטנה; Gitt. III, 3; ib. 28 a. Yoma 75 b כמו שמונח בח' Ms. M. (ed. בקופסא) as if lying (pressed) in a valise. [Also in Ch.] Y. B. Mets. II, 8 c top מכסי בח' covered up with a bag. Pesik. B’shall. p. 93 a [read:] הדה חֲפִיסְתִּי וכ' my valise here and my cloak.
M. Kat. 12 b

sense.definition: (חָפַף II) cleansing the head with a detergent, comb &c. B. Kam. 82 b top.
sense.notes: תיקן ח' ordained (for women before bathing) cleansing &c. Nidd. 66 b. Y. Maas. Sh. II, 53 c top; Tosef. ib. II, 1 חֲפִיפָתָהּ when she cleanses her hair.
, Cant. R. to III, 10, v. חָף

sense.definition: (חֲפַף I) being bent; חֲפִיפוּת לב humiliation, sorrow.
sense.notes: Targ. Lam. III, 65 Ar. (ed. תבירות, h. text מְגִנַּת).

sense.definition: , Ar.) f. (הפף I) preparation for the ḥ uppah (v. חוּפָּה).
sense.notes: Keth. 17 a מישחא דח' קאמר מר do you speak of oil used at bridal arrangements? Ar.; [oth. opin. (חפף II) oil used for curing sores of the head, v. חֲפָפִית].

sense.definition: (חָפֵץ) use of the root חפץ, finding pleasure.
sense.notes: Gen. R. s. 80; Midr. Till. to Ps. XXII (ref. to Mal. III, 12).

sense.definition: (part. pass. of חֲפַר) one for whom a grave is dug.
sense.notes: Koh. R. to X, 7 ח' טב וכ' a dead man is better off than he; Sabb. 151 b דחפיר וקביר וכ' one who is dead and buried.
, v. חֲפוּרָה
Pes. 31 b כמה חֲפִישַׂת הכלב how far does the dog reach in digging?
, v. חַפְשׁוּשִׁיתָא

sense.definition: (v. חָף) fish remaining on the shore after the water receded, mud-fish.
sense.notes: Cant. R. to I, 4 (ref. to תדוץ דאבה, Job XLI, 14, cmp. דָּאַב) מקרטעא כהדא ח' jumping like raked fish. Y. Ab. Zar. II, 42 a חָפִיתָה; cmp. חִיפּוּשָׁא.

sense.definition: [ to bend the fingers, form a hollow of the hand, denom. חוֹפֶן; whence] to take handfuls.
sense.notes: Maas. Sh. II, 5 אם בלל וח' וכ' if he mixed the coins up and took by handfuls, you go by the proportion of the coins mixed. Y. ib. 53 c כבולל וחוֹפֵן it is as in the case of him who &c.—Esp. (of the priest) to take grabs of incense with both hands (v. חֲפִינָה). Yoma V, 1. Ib. 47 a היה חוֹפֵן וכ' used to grab &c.; a. fr.
Y. Maas. Sh. l. c. הנבללין והנֶחְפָּנִין the coins which were mixed up and then collected by handfuls.
Yoma 47 b (ref. to Lev. XVI, 12) כדחַפְנֵי אינשי as people usually grab. Gen. R. s. 5 ההוא דח' תרי וכ' he who takes a grab takes twice as much as he who fills his fist, v. קמץ; Yalk. Josh. 14.

Gen. R. s. 5 חָפְנוֹ של משה the quantity of a handful of Moses’ hand. Ex. R. s. 11 מלא ח' שלו מלא ח' וכ' his (Moses’) handful and that of Aaron; a. fr.—Du. חָפְנַיִם, חוֹפְנַיִם. Yoma V, 1 מלא הָפְנָיו his two handfuls. Ib. 47 a חוֹפְנָיו. Ex. R. l. c. לקחו … חָפְנֵיהֶם both of them took, each his handfuls; a. fr. [Tosef. B. Mets. IX, 14 חפן ed., read סַפָּן as ed. Zuck.].
Targ. Koh. IV, 6 מלא חפני, read: חָפְנֵיה.— Pl. חָפְנִין, חָפְנֵי, חוּפְ'. Ib. Targ. Ex. IX, 8. Targ. Ez. I, 8; a. e.—Sabb. 62 b מלא ח' by handfuls, liberally.
Keth. 103 a (v. Rashi); Y. ib. XII, 35 a top; Y. Kil. IX, 32 b top חפנים; v. הֵפְיָנוֹס.
Targ. Y. Ex. XXI, 33 (ed. Amst. יַחְפֵּס). Targ. Job III, 20.—Y. B. Mets. II, 8 c bot. וחספתה, read: וחַפְסוּנָהּ and when they were digging it up.
Targ. Y. I. Num. XI, 8 (some ed. חַפְּ' Pa.; h. text שָׁטוּ). Targ. Job III, 21.
same. Ib. XXXIX, 21 מְחַפְּשִׂין ed. Lag. (oth. ed. מחפרין).

sense.definition: to bend over, to cover; trnsf. to be anxious, to care.
sense.notes: Meg. 26 a; Zeb. 53 b sq. והיה … מצטער … שנ' חֹופֵף וכ' Benjamin took pains … to conquer it, as it says (Deut. XXXIII, 12) he (Benjamin) is bent over it &c. [Rashi: rubs his head, v. חָפַף II.]
Targ. Y. I. Deut. XXXII, 11 חָפָא. (Y. II מחסחף, read: מְחַפְחֵף).
same. Targ. O. ib. (h. text ירחף).
, v. supra.

sense.definition: (cmp. חֲפַס) to scrape, rub, esp. to cleanse one’s head, rub, comb.
sense.notes: Sabb. 31 a והיה הלל חוֹפֵף וכ' Ms. M. (ed. והלל חפף) and Hillel was washing his head. Naz. VI, 3 נזיר חופף וכ' a Nazir may wash (rub with his hand) his hair. Ib. לא יָחוֹף באדמה he must not use an earth, v. נָשַׁר. Yalk. Gen. 150 (play on חפים, Gen. XLVI, 2
לא חָפַפְתִּי וכ' I did not wash (my head) or comb. Tosef. Ter. X, 4 שחִיפָּת וכ' ed. Zuck. which a priest’s daughter has used for washing her hair; ib. Maas. Sh. II. 1 שחפה.
Targ. Jer. VI, 26 חפו וכ' rub your heads with ashes (h. text התפלש).—Part. pass. חֲפִיף, pl. חֲפִיפִין. Targ. Ez. XXVII, 30.
Sabb. 77 b; Y. Ber. IX, 13 c bot. Cmp. חִיפּוּפִיתָא.

sense.definition: to bend (v. Job XL, 17); חָפֵץ to be busy with, to be anxious, desire.
sense.notes: —Pesik Haḥod. p. 47 b הוא ח' לגאול אתכם He is anxious to redeem you; ib. ח' בגאולתכם; Pesik. R. s. 15 ה' לגאולתכם; Cant. R. to II, 8; a. e.—[

sense.definition: to hold in one’s hand, cmp. חָפַן; v. next w.]

sense.notes: B. Mets. IV, 10 בכמה ח' זה how much is this worth? Cant. R. to I, 4 כל ח' טוב any good thing; a. fr.

Ib.; Pesik. Sos, p. 147 a אין לי ח' טוב ממך I have nothing more desirable than thyself. Koh. R. to V, 7 נעשה חֶפְצוֹ his desire was fulfilled. Num. R. s. 19 אל תחזירני מן חֶפְצִי וכ' do not turn me off from (refuse) my desire which &c.; a. fr.— Pl. חֲפָצִים. M. Kat. 9 b (ref. to Prov. III, 15, a. VIII, 11) הא חֶפְצֵי שמים but heavenly affairs (religious deeds) are equal to it (the study of the Law). Y. Peah I, 15 d bot. (ref. to Prov. l. c.) חפצים וכ' ‘desirable things’, that means jewels and pearls, ‘thy desirable things’, that means &c. Ib. חֲפָצֶיךָ וחֲפָצַי וכ' thy treasures and my treasures cannot compare to what I sent you; Gen. R. s. 35, end.—Sabb. 113 a (ref. to Is. LVIII, 1
חֲפָצֶיךָ אסורין ח' שמים וכ' thy pursuits are forbidden (on the Sabbath), but heavenly affairs (consultation about public welfare, education &c.) are permitted; ib. 150 a; a. fr.

sense.definition: , esp. a sacred object held in hand at the delivery of an oath.
sense.notes: Shebu. 38 b צריך לאתפושי ח' בידיה the judge must make him hold an object (Torah) in his hand. Ib. האי דיינא דאשבע … ולא תפיס ח' בידיה Ms. F. Margin (v. Rabb. D. S. a l. note 40) a judge that administers an oath by the Lord …, while the affirmant holds no object &c. Ib. דהא לא נקיט ח' (Ms. M. מידעם) for he had nothing in his hand.—B. Kam. 91 a למימד ח' וכ' to give an opinion on the fact whether or not he has caused that injury.
Pl. חַפְצֵי (חִיפְ' Rashi). Ḥull. 52 a (Ar. הַפְצֵי, expl. עפצים).

B. Kam. V, 5 החֹופֵר בור וכ' if one hollows out a pit on private ground, but opens it on public ground; Tosef. ib. VI, 4. B. Mets. 50 a, v. אוּשׁ II. Midr. Sam. ch. XXXII, end לַחְפֹּור to dig graves, v. חֵפֶר; a. fr.
Targ. Ps. VII, 16 (Ms. כרא). Targ. Gen. XXVI, 15; a. fr.— Part. pass. חֲפִיר q. v.
Targ. Prov. XVI, 27. Targ. Job XXXIX, 29.
Targ. Prov. XIII, 5.

Y. Taan. IV, end, 69 c בטל הח' the grave-digging (for the generation of the wilderness) ceased; Lam. R. introd. (R. Z’era). Y. l. c. צאו לח' go out for grave-digging; (Lam. R. l. c.; Midr. Sam. ch. XXXII, end לַחְפּוֹר).

sense.definition: name of a root (?) Y. Shebi. III, 34 c bot.

sense.notes: חִיפֵּשׂ to dig, search. Pes. II, 3 כל … לחַפֵּשׂ אחריו what the dog cannot reach by digging for it. Sabb. 89 a חִיפַּשְׂתִּי וכ' I searched all over the world. Cant. R. to I, 1 אם אתה מחַפֵּשׂ אחר וכ' if thou wilt dig after the words of the Law as for secret treasures; a. fr.

sense.definition: (b. h.) [ to be white, cmp. Arab.
sense.notes: ḥ afaš decorticare, cmp. חֲפַר II,] to be free (cmp. חוֹר II). V. next w.
Pesik. R. s. 8 (ref. to אֲחַפֵּשׂ, Zeph. I, 12) לא תהא קורא סמי"ך אלא שי"ן אֲחַפֵּשׁ וכ' read not the word with Samme but with Shin, ‘I shall deliver &c.’; Yalk. Zeph. 567.
Kerith. 11 a (ref. to Lev. XIX, 20) מכלל דהוא ח' this implies that he (her betrothed) has been liberated, is a freedman.
. Pesik. R. s. 8 (ref. to Zeph. I, 1

sense.definition: מוציא אני אותה לח' I shall lead her out to liberty (v. preced.); a. fr.— masc.
sense.notes: free, exempt. Nidd. 61 b, a. e. (ref. to Ps. LXXXVIII, 6) כיון … נעשה ח' וכ' when one is dead, one is free from religious duties. Tanḥ. Emor 2 (ref. to ויתחפש, I Sam. XXVIII, 8) נעשה ה' מן המלכות divested himself of the (insignia of) government; Lev. R. s. 26 (not למלכות); Midr. Sam. ch. XXIV, v. פָּגָנִיקָא; a. fr.
Lam. R. introd. (R. Abbahu 2), (interpreting Ezek. XXIV, 6) דחַפְשׁוּשִׁיתָהּ בגווה whose sediments (lowest classes) remain within her; (Ar. ed. Koh. יורה דחפישותא לגווה); Yalk. Ez. 362.

sense.definition: (חפף I, v. חִיפָּא) border of a garment ( limbus), a kind of front bosom in which things can be hidden.
sense.notes: Sabb. X, 3 (92 a) ובח' חלוקו Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note, ed. ובשפת) in the bosom of his shirt. Yoma 77 b ובלבד … מח' חלוקו Ms. M. (ed. מתחת ח') provided he takes not his hand out of the bosom of his shirt (to throw his cloak over his shoulder). Sabb. 96 b, v. חִיפָּא.—Denom.

sense.definition: to provide with a bosom or border.
sense.notes: Part. pass. חָפוּת. Shek. III, 2 אין התורם … בפרגוד ח' he who takes the money out of the Temple cell must not enter with a bordered cloak (in order not to create suspicion; Ms. M. האפות, Mish. Pes. הֶחָפוּת, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.).— Pl. חֲפוּתִין. Midr. Sam. ch. XXI נמצאו ח' וכ' the garments were found (to fit David) forming a bosom, not dragging along &c.; (Lev. R. s. 26, a. e. עשויין לו as if made for him).
Tosef. Ber. VII, 18 לחַפּוֹת לו חלוק והוא לא הי' וכ' ed. Zuck. (Var. הפך) to form the bosom of his shirt, while he never had &c.
ch., v. next w.

Gen. R. s. 75 יהיבתיה בחֵפְתִי (בחי') I put him in my pocket, i.e. I outwitted him.—Denom. חֲפַת, part. pass. pl. חֲפִיתִין bosomed. Ib. s. 100; Y. Kil. IX, 32 b top (מאנין) חיורין ח' white, bosomed garments; Y. Keth. XII, 35 a top חפותין. Y. M. Kat. III, 83 c top (expl. סנטיריה) מאנין רלא ח' garments without bosoms; (Gen. R. s. 100 דלא בזיעין, v. סַנְטֵרָא).

sense.definition: to put in the bosom, i.e. to outwit.
sense.notes: Gen. R. s. 80 סברון למַחֲפַת ואִתְחַפְּתוּן they intended to outwit (Jacob), and they were outwitted.

Mikv. X, 8 חץ שהוא תחוב באדם an arrow sticking in a person’s body; Tosef. ib. VII (VIII), 9. Arakh. 15 b חץ עד מ"ה אמה the range of an arrow is forty five cubits. Ib. אין חץ אלא לשון arrow means (an evil) tongue (ref. to Jer. IX, 7); a. fr. [Y. Keth. II., beg. 26 a שחיצה, read: שחֶצְיָהּ]— Pl. חִצִּים, חִצִּין, חִי'. Lam. R. to III, 12 (expl. כמטרה לחץ ib.) כקורת ח' וכ' like the post for arrows (for military practice) at which all shoot &c.—Tanḥ. Nitsab. 1 (ref. to Deut. XXXII, 23) חִצַּי כלין וכ' my arrows will be spent, but they (Israel) shall not cease; ib. חִצָּיו כלין וכ' his arrows will be spent, but the post will remain; Sot. 9 a. B. Kam. 22 a אשו משום חִצָּיו he is responsible for his fire, because it is his arrows (i.e. his action), opp. משום ממונו because it is his property which caused the damage. Ib. חציו דכלב it is the action of (his) dog; חציו דגמל of his camel; a. fr.
— Pl. as ab. Succ. 12 b; 15 a ה' זכרים plain shafts, opp. נקבות shafts with a hole into which the arrow-head is sat.
, v. חצי

Tosef. Yoma I, 6 כשהוא חוֹצֵב engaged in stone-breaking; Sifra Emor ch. I, Par. 2; Tanḥ. Emor 4 ח' אבנים; Lev. R. s. 26 ח' באבנים. Y. M. Kat. I, 80 d לא יַחְצוֹב one must not cut stones &c. Yalk. Deut. 854 אתה חֲצוֹב וכ' chisel thou the tablets &c.; a. fr.—Part. pass. חָצוּב, f. חֲצוּבָה; pl. חֲצוּבִים, חֲצוּבוֹת. Y. M. Kat. l. c. Y. Shek. VI, 49 d bot.; a. e.

Y. Yoma III, 40 c bot. בקודש יֵחָצֵבוּ on sacred ground they must be chiselled.—Trnsf. (cmp. גזר) to be decided, decreed. Lev. R. s. 5 (ref. to Is. XXII, 16) ממרום נ' עליו from on high it has been decreed over him; Yalk. Is. 291 נֶחְצְבָה עליו גזירה.
ch.

sense.definition: same.; interch. with חֲצַד q. v.—Part.
sense.notes: pass. חֲצִיב, v. חֲצִיבָא.—

sense.definition: (used of the Cistus) to cut through the ground, to grow.
sense.notes: Pes. 111 b, v. חֲצוּבָא II.—[Lev. R. s. 25 ח' חצובן, v. חֲצַד I.]
Targ. Is. LI, 1.
B. Mets. 118 b הח' … לסתת after the stone-cutter has surrendered (the stone) to the polisher; Y. ib. X, 12 c bot. החוֹצֵב לגַמָּל.— Pl. חֹוצְבִין. Y. Shek. VI, 48 a top.
— Pl. חֲצָבִים, חֲצָבִין. Men. VIII, 7. Kel. II, 2; Tosef. ib. B. Kam. II, 2.

sense.definition: a species or variety of dates (v. Löw Pfl., p. 109, sq.).
sense.notes: Ab. Zar. I, 5 (Y. ed. חצר, with ר). Ib. 14 b, expl. קשבא. Y. ib. I, 39 d bot. חצד, v. חֲצָדָא II. [Maim.: sugar cane, v. Löw l. c.]

sense.definition: (חצב) [ cutter,] a shrubby plant, with deep and straight roots, used for hedges to mark boundaries, prob. cistus.
sense.notes: B. Bath. 55 a המצר והח' וכ' a landmark (stone &c.) and the ḥ azab form a legal boundary &c. Ib. 56 a, v. חֲצוּבָא I. Tosef. Sabb. XIV (XV), 8; Y. ib. XVIII, 16 c bot; Bab. ib. 128 a מטלטלין את הח' וכ' you may (on the Sabbath) handle the (cut) ḥ ., because it is food for gazelles. Kil. I, 8 חצוב (Ar. חצב).— Pl., v. חֲצוּבָה I.
ch. v. חֲצוּבָא II

Succ. 29 a. Ber. 22 a bot. תקן ח' בת וכ' (Ms. M. חוצבא) ordained that a pitcher containing nine kab must be used for purification. Ib. אתבר חַצְבֵּיה וכ' R. N.’s pitcher is broken (the rule he laid down is rejected). Bets. 30 a; a. fr.— Pl. חַצְבִּין, חַצְבֵּי. Targ. II Esth. III, 8 מלקטין פישרי טבת ויתיבין בחַצְבֵּי תמוז they collect the thawing snows of the winter and put them in summer pitchers (coolers).—Bets. l. c. מליין חַצְבַּיְיהוּ וכ' filled their pitchers with water. Ber. 28 a ח' חוורין וכ' white pitchers full of ashes (unworthy students). Ib. 58 a, v. יֵא I.

sense.definition: a species or variety of dates, v. חֲצָב I.
(cmp. חצב) to cut, mow (corresp. to h. קָצַר).
sense.notes: Targ. Deut. XXIV, 19; a. fr.—M. Kat. 9 b דתזרע ולא תִחְצַד that you may sow but not cut (that your children may not die in your life time). Taan. 10 a עתירה בבל דחַצְדָּא וכ' (Ms. M. עתידה … דחצרא) Babylonia is rich because she harvests without rain (independent of rain-fall on account of her canalization). Koh. R. to II, 20; Lev. R. s. 25 קאים וחָצֵיד חצובין וכ' (וחָצֵיב, also וחצד, והצב) cutting down cistus shrubs to plant shoots of fig-trees; a. fr. [Y. Dem. III, 23 b bot. מיחצד, מחצדן, v. חֲצֵי.]
Targ. Ps. CXXIX, 7; v. חָצוֹדָא.
Targ. Gen. VIII, 22.—Targ. Lev. XIX, 9; a. fr.—M. Kat. 12 b חצדו ליה ח' וכ' had his crop cut &c. Ib. ח' דחיטי הוה it was the wheat crop; a. e.
m. = h. חֲצָד or חֲצָב I. Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39 d bot. (ref. to חצד, Mish.) מין הוא ושמו ח' it is a species (of dates) named Ḥ.
, v. חָצוֹדָא
Yoma 77 b אמברא דח' at the ford of Ḥ. [Var. הצדד, בי ה', חצידר, הצדר, הינדר, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 8.]
, v. חצי
, v. חֲצָב II
, v. חֲצוּבָה II

B. Bath. 56 a ח' שבו תיחם וכ' (Ms. O. חצב, Rashi חצובה) it is the ḥ. which Joshua introduced as landmarks. Bets. 25 b ח' מקטע וכ' (some ed. חצובה) the ḥ . cuts the feet of (convicts) the wicked (who remove the boundary lines).—Pes. 111 b בטולא דחצבא דלא חצב גרמידא (Rashi: דחצובא) in the shade of a ḥ that has not cut through (grown) to an arm’s length (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); Yalk. Deut. 945.

sense.definition: , v. חֲצָב II, a. preced.— Pl. חֲצוּבוֹת.
sense.notes: Y. Peah II, beg. 16 d ח' מפסיקין לפיאה cistus shrubs (between two fields) form a boundary line with regard to the poor man’s corner. Gen. R. s. 31, end.

sense.definition: (v. חָצָב) a stand for a pitcher, tripod.
sense.notes: —כח' in the shape of a tripod, triangulary arranged. B. Mets. 25 a כח' מהו (Ms. H. כחוצבא) if coins are found lying in a triangle; (Y. ib. II, 8 b, sq. מצובה, expl. קרפיפא). B. Bath. 83 b (also כחצובא) planted in a triangle. Erub. 85 b דקיימי כח' (Ms. M. דעבידת כי חציבא, read: חצובא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the three ruins between two buildings stand in a triangle (so as to make only the central ruin equally near to both dwellings).
Targ. Am. IX, 13. Targ. Jer. IX, 21 ed. Lag. חצו' (oth. ed. חַצָּדָא).— Pl. חֲצוֹדַיָּא. Targ. Ruth II, 3, sq.
, v. חֲצוֹצַרְתָּא
, v. next w.

of חצר) [ closed all around,] trumpet. Y. Sabb. XVII, beg. 16 a ח' תוקע וכ' as to the trumpet, he blows for the third time (announcing the Sabbath) and deposits it in the place designated for it (on the roof, v. Bab. ib. 35 b bot.).— Pl. חֲצוֹצְרוֹת. R. Hash. III, 4 שתי ח'; a. e.

Targ. Hos. V, 8 (ed. Lag. חֲצֹצַ').—Sabb. 36 a; Succ. 34 a ח' שופרא וכ' what (before the destruction of the Temple) was called Shofar is now called ḥ ãtsotsereth &c.— Pl. חֲצוֹצְרָן, חֲצוֹצְרָתָא. Targ. Num. X, 2; 8; a. e.
Ber. I, 1; a. fr.
B. Bath. 3 a שרצו לַחֲצוֹת, v. מְחִיצָה.
Tosef. Bets. III, 18, v. חָצַץ I.

sense.definition: to order a division, to assign half, divide.
sense.notes: B. Kam. 34 a פחת שפחתתו מיתה מַחֲצִין בחי Ms. M. a. Rashi (ed. שפחתו) half of the loss of value which death has caused, is collected from the living animal; Y. ib. I, end, 2 c מחצין את הנזק the loss is divided.
Targ. Prov. XXX, 17.—Y. Ḥall. IV, end, 60 b מִיחֲצִי שיניי (not ניח') to pick my teeth with; Y. Dem. III, 23 b bot. מיחצד, מחצדן (corr. acc.).

B. Kam. IV, 9 חֲ' נזק half the damage. Gitt. IV, 5 מי שחֶצְיוֹ עבד וכ' he who is half a slave and half a freedman (having been emancipated by one of the partners); a. v. fr.— Pl. חֲצָיִים, חֲצָיִין, חֲצָאִים, חֲצָאִין. Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., ch. X, Par. 9 לא יביאנה ח' he must not offer it in parts. Ned. 83 a אין נזירות לח' there is no nazaritism by halves, i.e. one cannot vow to be a nazarite by partial abstinence; ואין קרבן לח' nor is there a sacrifice for partial nazaritism. Y. Hor. I, 46 b top אין הפסח לה' the Passover offering does not take place in divisions (of clean and unclean parties). Kerith. 5 a מפטם לח' taking only a part of each ingredient; Y. Yoma IV, 41 d bot. פיטמה ח'; a. fr.
Targ. Is. LI, 1.— Pl. חֲצִיבִין chiselled stones. Targ. Y. Ex. XX, 22.
, Erub. 85 b, Ms. M., v. חֲצוּבָה II
Y. Yoma II, 40 c bot. חֲצִיבָתָן בקדש their chiseling must take place in holiness.—[Y. Peah II, beg. 16 d חציבות, some ed., v. חֲצוּבָה I.]

sense.definition: (חצי) carpenter’s adze, also pick-axe or spade (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Dolabra).
sense.notes: Targ. Is. XLIV, 12 (h. text מעצד); a. e.—Sabb. 123 b ח' דנגרי carpenters’ adze. B. Bath. 73 b נפל ליה ח' וכ' Ms. M. a. Ar. (ed. חציצא) a carpenter lost his adze there. Erub. 77 b, v. מָרָא II; a. e.— Pl. חֲצִינֵי. B. Kam. 119 b באתרא … תרי ח' וכ' in the place of our Tanna (in the Mishnah) there are two ḥ ãtsiné a large one called כשיל (axe), and a small one called מעצד (adze). Yoma 37 b; Bets. 33 b, v. נַרְגָּא.

Targ. Ps. XVII, 4. Targ. Koh. VIII, 1 חֲצִיף אפין (constr.); a. e.—Ber. 34 b; Sot. 7 b ח' עלי מאן וכ' I consider him impertinent who &c. Kidd. 33 a כמה ח' האי גברא how irreverently behaves this man; a. e.— Fem. חֲצִיפָא, חֲצִיפְתָּא. M. Kat. 16 b. Y. Taan. III, 66 d top.—Pl. m. חֲצִיפִין, constr. חֲצִיפֵי. Targ. Y. Ex. XXVIII, 37; a. e.

Yalk. Koh. 989, v. נָטוֹרָא. Pesik. Shub., p. 161 a ח' נצח לבישא וכ' the persevering (in prayer) conquers even the bad man, so much the more the Good One of the world; Y. Taan. II, 65 b חֲצִיפָח … לכשירא (corr. acc.); Yalk. Jon. 550.

sense.definition: (v. חֲצִיצָה) intermediate contact, shaking an object between which and the person causing the vibration there is a partition.
sense.notes: Tosef. Ḥag. III, 21 וחֲצִיצוֹ ed. Zuck. (missing in oth. editions). V. חֲצָצוֹת.
, B. Bath. 73 b, v. חֲצִינָא
v. חֲצָצָא

B. Kam. 82 a bot. משום ח' to prevent an interposition (to remove anything sticking to the body or in the hair before bathing). Zeb. 19 a ותיפוק ליה משום ח' ought it not to be forbidden as an unlawful interposition between the priest’s hand and the object he has to handle?; a. fr.— Pl. חֲצִיצִין the laws concerning interpositions. Erub. 4 a; Succ. 5 b
, v. חָצֵר

sense.definition:
חצר to cut, be small,
cmp. Targ. of חציר, Num. XI, 5) leek.
sense.notes: — Pl. חֲצִירִים, constr. חֲצִירֵי. Kel. XVII, 5; Tosef. ib. B. Mets. VI, 10 (ed. Zuck. חצר, R. S. to Kel. l. c. חצירי); Y. Orl. III, 63 a bot. חריצי (corr. acc.), v. גֶּבַע. [In b. h. חציר also grass, moss.]
Targ. Ps. CXXIX, 6 (ed. Lag. חֲצַר, Var. חֲצַד).

sense.definition: (cmp. חָסַף a. P. Sm. 1353 חצפא = ch. חספא) to peel off, bare; part. pass.
sense.notes: חָצוּף (sub. אפיים); f. חֲצוּפָה
Snh. 3 a ב"ד ח' an arrogant court (two sitting in judgment instead of three). Y. Taan. III, 66 d top אחת ח' ואחת כשירה one was unabashed, the other chaste. Ned. 20 b; a. e.

Tanḥ. Vayera 23 הנפש ח' היא the instinct of life is strong. Ex. R. s. 42 ג' חֲצוּפִים הם ח' בחיה וכ' (Bets. 25 b עז) three (creatures) are persevering (undaunted by failure or opposition), among beasts it is the dog &c. Y. Taan. IV, 69 b מה חציפה וכ' (read: חצו') how irrepressible is the Land of Israel that it still is productive (after all devastations).— Pl. חֲצוּפִים, f. חֲצוּפוֹת. Ex. R. l. c., v. supra.—Y. Ber. V, 8 d bot. שעות הח' וכ' those irresistible, hard and evil times.

sense.definition: to bare (one’s face), to act irreverently.
sense.notes: Koh. R. to IX, 18 כל המַחֲצִיף פניו וכ' whoever speaks irreverently of &c. Ib. III, 9 מַחֲצִיפִין אתם you embolden yourselves.
part. pass. חָצִיף q. v.

sense.definition: as preced. Hif. Targ. Prov. VII, 13.
sense.notes: Ib. XXI, 29. Targ. Ez. XIII, 6 מַחְצְפִין וכ' (Var. מְחַצְּפִין) they boldly insist upon it &c. [Dan. II, 15; III, 22 part. pass. insisted upon, urgent.]

sense.definition: to drive a wedge in (v. Prov. XXX, 27).
sense.notes: —Denom. חֵץ.
Bets. IV, 6 לַחֲצוֹץ וכ'; (Tosef. ib. III, 18 לחצות, v. חָצָה).
Zeb. 19 a מהו שיָחוֹצּוּ (or שיָחוּצוּ). Ib. אפי' נימא אחת חוֹצֶצֶת even one thread forms an unlawful interposition. Ib. חוֹצְצוֹת; a. fr.
Y. Sabb. VIII, end, 11 c; Ḥull. 16 b אין מְחַצְּצִין וכ' one must not use it for &c.

sense.definition: (b. h.) to cut off, divide; to line a wall so as to leave a space (חָצָץ) between the two partitions.
sense.notes: Ohol. XV, 4 בית שחֲצָצוֹ וכ' a room which one partitioned off with boards or tapestry on the sides (walls) or on the ceiling. Ib. 5 ח' מארצו if he partitioned it off from the floor (laying an additional floor with a vacuum between); Tosef. ib. XV, 4.
Ohol. XV, 4; 5; Tosef. ib. XV, 4. [In b. h. חָצָץ (v. חָצַץ I) wedge-like objects, gravel, sand.]

sense.definition: , Pa. חַצֵּץ (denom. of חֵץ, v. חָצַץ) to sharpen, or to shoot an arrow.
sense.notes: Targ. Jud. V, 8. מְחַצְצֵי גיריא (missing in ed. Lag.)

sense.definition: (= b. h. חָצָץ, v. חָצָץ, end) gravel, sand.
sense.notes: Targ. Prov. XX, 17 (Ms. חֲצִיצָא).— Pl. חֲצָצֵי. Lam. R. introd. (R. Joh.
סגיתון בטורי בח' וכ' you have to walk over rocks and gravel without shoes &c.

sense.definition: (v. חֲצִיצָה) intermediate contacts, laws concerning the shaking of an object by an unclean person through a partition (v. חָצִיץ).
sense.notes: Y. Ḥag. II, end, 78 c (v. emendation in R. S. to Toh. VII, 5).

sense.definition: (denom. of חצוצר) to blow the trumpet.
sense.notes: Targ. I Chr. XV, 24 מְחַצְצְרִין. Targ. II Chr. XIII, 14 מְחַצְּרִין.—V. מְחַצְּרָא.
&c., v. חְצוֹצְ'

sense.definition: (v. חָצַץ II, a. חצי; cmp. בָּצַע) arbitration, דייני דח' untrained judges who arbitrate from ignorance of the law.
sense.notes: B. Bath. 133 b, v. מְגִיזְתָּא II. [R. Ḥãn.: ח' cemetery, from חוּץ II = חוּץ לעיר.]
Taan. 10 a עתידה בבל דחַצְרָא וכ' Ms. M. (v. חֲצַד) Babylonia shall in the future harvest without rain (on account of the canalization introduced). Cmp. חָצִיר.—[מְחַצְּרִין, v. חַצְצַר.]

sense.definition:
c. (b. h.;
חצר, v. preced. wds.
sense.notes: ; cmp. גָּזַר a. גִּזְרָה &c.) court, yard, in gen. private property. B. Mets. 11 a חֲצֵרוֹ של אדם וכ' the ground belonging to a person takes possession for him (of what is found there) even without his knowledge. Ib. ח' המשתמרת a well-guarded ground (fenced-in). B. Kam. 12 a; Gitt. 21 a, a. e. ח' מהלכת a moving ground, e.g. the back of a slave. Erub. VI, 1 הדר עם … בח' if one dwells in the same court yard with a gentile. Ib. 3 אנשי ח' the residents of dwellings in one court yard; a. v. fr.—ח' הצירית Tyrian yard (with a lodge at the entrance). Maasr. III, 5; Nidd. 47 b.—חֲצַר הקבר the excavated ground to which all the caves of a cemetery open. Ohol. XV, 8; Tosef. ib. XV, 7.—חֲ' הכירה the rim of the cooking range. Kel. VII, 3; Tosef. ib. B. Kam. V, 5.—חֲ' הכבד (= b. h. יֹתֶרֶת) lobe of the liver. Yoma VIII, 6; a. e.—חֲ' מות cemetery, v. supra. Ber. 18 b.— Pl. חֲצֵרוֹת, חֲצֵי'. Erub. IV, 6. Ib. VI, 8; a. fr.
, constr. חֲצַר ch. same.—ח' דעל כבדא, ח' כבדא = h. חֲצַר הכבד, v. preced. Targ. Ex. XXIX, 13; a. e. (h. text יתרת). Targ. II Chr. XVIII, 33.
, v. חָקַק, חֲקַק.
, v. חוֹק, חוּקָּה.
, v. חקי
= חַקְלָא. Y. Dem. IV, 24 a top מן דבר ח' וכ' when the manager of the estate came out to him.
Y. Peah I, 16 c bot.; a. e. Y. Gitt. III, 45 a top אי … Ib. VIII, 49 c bot. חֲקוּלָה.
, v. חִיקוֹק
—ח' דִּין judging ability. Ab. VI, beg.
חִיקָּה (b. h.; denom. of חֹק)
Gen. R. s. 39, end (ref. to Gen. XII, 9) מְהַקֶּה והולך וכ' surveying as he went along, with the direction towards the Temple.

sense.definition: to imitate a person’s customs, to follow a person’s footsteps.
sense.notes: Sifra K’dosh. beg. (ref. to Lev. XIX, 2) פמליא של מלך מה עליה להיות מְחַקָּה למלך Rab. (ed. פ' למלך ומה וכ') what is the duty of the King’s retinue?—To follow in the wake of the King; (Yalk. Lev. 604 מְחַכָּה). Ḥull. II, 9 שלא יְחַקֶּה וכ' that he may not appear to imitate the customs of the heretics.
, v. חֲקַק
= חַקְלָא. Targ. Y. Gen. XXVII, 27 (some ed. חֲקַל). Ib. XXIII, 19 חֲקֵיל (constr.).—Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41 d top; (Y. Sabb. I, 3 d top בטורא; Y. Ter. VIII, 45 d bot. בחלא, read: בחקלא).
, v. חֲקַק
Gitt. 20 a ח' לאו כתיבה היא engraving is not writing (for legal purposes).

Y. Keth. VII, 31 c bot., a. e. נדר … חֲקִירַת חכם a vow which requires the study of a scholar (to find out means of absolving).—Esp. examination of witnesses, cross-examination. R. Hash. 25 b חקירת העדים the hearing of witnesses (testifying to having seen the first appearance of the new crescent). Snh. IV, 1 בדרישה וח' require investigation and examination of witnesses; a. fr.— Pl. חֲקִירוֹת cross-examination referring to date, time and place, contrad. to בדיקות referring to accompanying circumstances. Ib. V, 1 היו … בשבע ח' (in capital cases) they examined by means of seven questions, what year-week, what year, month, day, hour and place. Ib. 2 מה בין ח' לבדיקות what is the difference in point of law between &c.? Ib. 40 b שמונה ח' eight questions; a. fr.
Targ. Gen. II, 5. Targ. O. Num. XX, 17; a. fr.—Gen. R. s. 74, v. אִיזְגָּרָא; a. fr.— Pl. חַקְלִין, חַקְלַיָּא. Targ. Jer. XXXII, 15. Targ. Joel I, 10; a. fr.

Targ. Is. V, 8.—Y. Snh. II, 20 b bot.; Ruth R. to II, 9; Midr. Sam. ch. XX (translat. of (א)פס דמים, I Sam. XVII, 1, I Chr. XI, 13) חקל סומקתא Red Field.— Pl. חַקְלָן, חַקְלָתָא. Targ. Jer. IV, 17. Targ. O. Ex. VIII, 9.—חֲקַלְוָון, חֲקַלְוָותָא. Y. Keth. X, end, 34 a. Pesik. B’shall. p. 93 a

sense.definition: (preced.) field-laborer, peasant; trnsf. boor, ignorant man.
sense.notes: Meg. 7 b, v. דִּיקוּלָא. Keth. 79 a חזי מר נחמן ח' see, sir, how this ignoramus Naḥman &c.— Pl. חַקְלָאֵי. Ber. 37 b.—Mixed pl. חַקְלָיָיתָא peasantry. Sabb. 12 a אבל דח' וכ' Ms. M. (ed. דבני חַקְלָיָתָא) but the garments of the peasantry are easily distinguishable (as to men’s or women’s).
, v. חַקְלָא II

definition.italic: to draw a circle, to limit;

sense.notes: Y. Kil. I, 27 b top, a. e. שחָקַקְתִּי, v. חוֹק. Num. R. s. 19, beg., v. חוּקָּה; a. fr.

sense.definition: to hollow out, to shape a receptacle.
sense.notes: Y. Bets. I, 60 b bot. קערה שחֲקָקָהּ קוף a dish which an ape has hollowed out.—Part. pass. חָקוּק, f. חֲקוּקָה. Tosef. B. Bath. III, 1; B. Bath. 65 b, a. e. מכתשת הח' the mortar which has been hollowed out (of stone &c.), opp. הקבועה stationary in the ground.

sense.definition: to engrave, write with the stilus.
sense.notes: Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 14, v. הָרַט. Gitt. 20 a וכתב ולא וח' ‘he writes’ (Deut. XXIV, 1) but not ‘he engraves’ (on tablets &c.). Ib. חָק תוכות he chisels out the surroundings (making the letters come out in relief); חק יריכות he digs the sides, i.e. he engraves the letters. Gen. R. s. 68; s. 78 שאיקונין שלך חֲקוּקָה וכ' whose picture is engraven above (in the heavenly throne). Y. Yoma IV, beg. 41 b חֲקוּקִים היו the inscriptions were engraven (not written with ink). Y. Ned. VI, 40 a top מפני צלמי … שחקוקים וכ' on account of the Chaldean images which were engraven on the walls (Ez. XXIII, 1
Y. Erub. II, 20 a top אם תֵּיחָקֵק if the block be hollowed out. Sot. 36 b שיֵחָקֵק על וכ' (not שיחקוק) to have his name engraven on the jewels &c.; a. e.

Lev. R. s. 6 נטל … וחַקְקֵיה he took a reed and hollowed it out. Ḥull. 25 a; Sabb. 103 a חַק קפיזא וכ' he hollowed out &c., v. חֲטַט I.—Part. pass. חָקִיק, חֲקִיק engraven, marked. Targ. Y. Ex. XXVIII, 11 (Ar. חקיין). Targ. Y. Lev. XIX, 28 (h. text קעקע). Targ. Cant. II, 9; a. fr.

sense.definition: to be engraven, to engrave itself.
sense.notes: Targ. Y. Ex. XX, 2; 3.

sense.definition: (b. h.) to go around, to espy, to examine; esp. to cross-examine, v. חֲקִירָה.
sense.notes: Ab. I, 9 הוי מרבה לַחְקוֹר וכ' cross-examine witnesses as much as possible. Snh. 40 b מדהוי ליה … חָקוֹר תַּחְקוֹר the text might have read (for emphasis) thou shalt diligently inquire, or thou shalt diligently investigate (instead of the unusual phrase ודרשת היטב, Deut. XVII, 4); a. e.

Koh. R. to I, 16 הלב נ' the heart is examined (by the Lord). R. Hash. III, 1 נֶחְקְרוּ העדים when the evidence was closed. Tosef. Snh. VI, 4 עד שתֵּחָקֵר עדותן וכ' until their examination in court has been closed; נֶחְקְרָה עדותן וכ' after it has been closed, they cannot retract. Ib. 5; a. fr.
Targ. II Sam. X, 3. Targ. Ps. CXXXIX, 23; a. e.
—אין (להם) ח' unsearchable, innumerable. Num. R. s. 19; Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 20.
חָקַר m. (preced. wds.) examiner. Targ. Jer. XVII, 10.
Targ. II Sam. V, 9 (h. text מצדה); a. fr.—Targ. Y. Num. XXXII, 17 קִרְוֵי ח' ed. Amst. (some ed. קרוין, incorr.) fortified cities.— Pl. חַקְרִין. Ib. XIII, 20.—V. אַקְרָא.
f. h. same. Arakh. IX, 6 ח' של וכ' the fort of Giscala.
Pl. חַקְרָנִים. Sifré Num. 131, v. נַקְרָן.
, v. חֲרַר
, v, חוֹר II, חוֹרָא II.

sense.definition: (= אחרא, v. חוֹרִי), יומא ח' next day, v. יוֹמָחְרָא.
sense.notes: Targ. II Chr. XX, 16 (ed. Lag. אחרא).—B. Mets. 17 a למחר וליומא ח' (Ms. H. a. oth. אוחרא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 30) to-morrow or the day after.
, v. חָרֵי

sense.definition: (b. h.) to be burned, dried up, ruined, waste.
sense.notes: Snh. 22 a כאלו ח' בה"מ וכ' as if the Temple had been destroyed in his days. Tosef. Men. XIII, 22 מפני מה חָרְבָה וכ' why was Shiloh destroyed?; Yoma 9 a. Kil. IV, 1 (expl. קרחת הכרם) כרם שח' באמצעו a vineyard the central part of which is laid waste. Ib. V, 1; a. fr. [Num. R. s. 7, end בבל ח' מקדש, read: החריב. Taan. 29 a כשח' טורנוס, read: כשחרש, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.]
Erub. 18 b. Yoma 39 b שסופך עתיד לֵיחָרֵב that it is thy final destiny to be destroyed; a. fr.
same. Pesik. R. s. 31 שיִתְחָרֵב. [Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXXIII, v. חָרַךְ.]
Tosef. M. Kat. I, 5 מַחֲרִיבִין חורי וכ' you may destroy ant-stores (during the festive week). Num. R. s. 7, end שהֶחֱרִיבוּ בה"מ for they (the Romans) destroyed the Temple; a. fr.

Pes. 42 b (ref. to Ez. XXVI, 2) אי מלאה זו הָחְרְבָה זו Ms. M. (ed. חרבה, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 9) when the one (Jerusalem) is populated, the other (Caesarea) is laid waste; Yalk. Gen. 110 חֲרֵיבָה.

Targ. Ez. XXVI, 2. Targ. Hos. XIII, 15. Targ. Is. XIX, 5; a. fr.—Naz. 32 b דח' בה"מ that the Temple has been destroyed. Ib. דיִחְרוֹב that it will be destroyed. Gitt. 56 a דלא לִיחֲרוֹב וכ' that Jerusalem may not be destroyed. Y. Ber. II, 5 a top דברגליה חריב with whose arrival it was destroyed; a. fr.
Targ. Is. XLII, 15. Targ. Jud. XVI, 24; a. fr.—Yoma 69 b דאַחְרְבֵיה וכ' who destroyed the Temple. Taan. 29 a top לאַחְרוּבֵי Ms. M. a. Rashi (ed. לַחְרוּבֵי); Gitt. 56 a לַחְרוּבֵי; a. fr.
Y. Ber. l. c.

Y. Ber. IV, 8 a. Yalk. Gen. 110, p. חָרֵב I; a. fr.— Pl. חֲרֵבִים, חֲרֵי'; f. חֲרֵבוֹת, חֲרֵי'. Ex. R. s. 31 (ref. to Num. XXIV, 5) ומַשְׁכנותיך כשהם ח' thy pledges, when they are in ruins, v. מַשְׁכּוֹן; a. fr.
Y. Sot. III, beg. 18 c ח' של חטין the dry (oil-less) offering of wheat, opp. בלול. Kidd. 62 a top; a. e.
ch., v. חָרוֹב

Ḥull. 3 a, v. חָלָל I. B. Bath. 8 b ח' קשה וכ' death in war is a greater affliction than natural death. Snh. 116 a מהם הרגו בח' some of them they put to death by the sword. Tanḥ. Balak 8; Num. R. s. 20 אא"כ שלף חַרְבּוֹ without drawing his sword. Ib. בח' חייהם live on their sword. Taan. III, 5 על הח' on the sword, i.e. when armies are passing the country. Ib. 22 a ח' של שלום a friendly army passing; a. fr.

definition.italic: the sword-shaped handle of a plough.

sense.notes: Kel. XXI, 2. Tosef. ib. B. Bath. I, 7.— Pl. חֲרָבוֹת. Pesik. R. s. 21 ח' מכאן וכ' (soldiers with) swords here &c.; a. e.
Targ. Gen. XXXIV, 26. Ib. III, 24; a. fr.—Sabb. 123 b, v. אוּשְׁכָּפָא; (Ar. scraping knife).
Targ. Y. Deut. XXVIII, 27 Ar. ed. Koh. חרב (oth. ed. חרבא, חרבונא; Targ. ed. גרבא; h. text גרב).
, v. חוּרְבָּא a. חָרוֹב.
Shebi. VIII, 6 קוצץ אותם בח' (Ar. ed. Koh. בחורבה, R. S. בחרבא) you may cut them with a knife, opp. to מוקצה the tool especially intended for cutting figs.
, v. חַרְבָּא II

sense.definition: (b. h.) Harbona, one of King Ahasver’s eunuchs. Gen. R. s. 49; Treat. Sof’rim XIV, 6 (צ"ל) גם ח' זכור לטוב one must say, Ḥ.
sense.notes: , too, be remembered &c. Meg. 16 a; a. e.
, v. חַרְחֲבִינָה
, v. חוֹרְבָּן
, v. חֲבַרְבְּרֵי
חַרְגַּת (חרג, v. P. Sm. 1366) [ rough sound, sawing,] dying agony. Targ. Deut. XXXII, 25. Targ. Lam. I, 20 ed. Lag. (oth. ed. הַרְגַּת).
Yoma 20 b האי ח' דיומא לא וכ' those sun-motes are called la (Dan. IV, 32).

language-reference.xref: חַרְגֹּל; חגל with ר inserted; cmp. חגב)

sense.notes: Sabb. VI, 10 (67 a) ביצת הח' the egg of a ḥ argol (carried in the ear for ear-ache).
Targ. O. Lev. XI, 22 (ed. Berl. חַרְגְּלָא).

sense.definition: (comp. of חר a. גִּינָּה, v. חַרְחֲבִינָה) garden-ivy, the leaves of which may be used for bitter herbs on the Passover night.
sense.notes: Pes. 39 a ed. (Ms. M. 1 הוגנין read with Ms. M. 2: הַרְגִּנִּין).
, v. חַרְגּוֹלָא

sense.definition: (b. h.) to be excited, to tremble.
sense.notes: Gen. R. s. 67 (ref. to מאד, Gen. XXVII, 33) מחרדה שח' וכ' more than the trembling which he felt on the altar; (Yalk. ib. 115 שהֶחֱרִיד). Tanḥ. Tol’d 13 שתי חרדות ח' וכ' twice did Isaac tremble. Gen. R. l. c. חָרֵיד is he frightened?; Yalk. l. c. חָרֵד; a. e.

Gen. R. l. c. חרדה שה' יעקב וכ' the fright which Jacob caused to Isaac; Tanḥ. l. c.; Ruth R. to III, 8. Ib. חרדה שהֶחֱרִידָה וכ' the alarm which Ruth caused &c. Ib. שהן מַחְרִידוֹת וכ' they (the fowl) excite the man (who tries to catch them); a. e.
, Lev. R. S. 24, v. חֲרָרָא.

sense.definition: preced. art.) excitement, anxiety, fear, reverence.
sense.notes: Gen. R. s. 67; Ruth R. to III, 8, a. e., v. חָרֵד. Nidd. IV, 7, a. e. ח' מסלקת וכ' excitement prevents the regular menstruation. Ber. 30 b (ref. to Ps. XXIX, 2) א"ת בהדרת קדש אלא בחֶרְדַּת קדש Ms. M. read not ‘in the glory’ of the sanctuary, but in reverence of &c.; Yalk. Sam. 78; Y. Ber. V, 8 d bot.—[Tanḥ. K’dosh. 9 כחרדת דם, v. חֲרָרָה.]— Pl. חֲרָדוֹת. Tanḥ. Tol’d. 13, v. חָרַד.
Y. Ber. VIII, 12 b; Gen. R. s. 82, end; (Ḥull. 127 a צב).

Targ. Y. Lev. XI, 29 ed. pr. (ed. הדרונא, Ar. חדרונא; h. text צב; v. Fl. to Levy Targ. Dict. I, 425 2). Targ. I Chr. XI, 22 ed. Lag. a. oth. (ed. Beck חרדנא, ed. Wil. חדרונא).—Y. Ber. I, 3 d top דלא יעביד כהדין חַרְדּוֹנָה he must not (in bowing at prayers) bend like the ḥ ardon (with head erect).

sense.definition: (חד, with ר inserted; cmp. גַּד I) mustard.
sense.notes: Kil. I, 2 ח' וח' המצרי common mustard and Egyptian mustard. Ber. 40 a הרגיל בח' וכ' he who is used to take mustard once in &c. Ib. 31 a, a. e. כח' as large as a grain of mustard; a. fr.— Pl. חַרְדְּלִים, חַרְדְּלִין. Cant. R. to VI, 11 כמה ח' ever so many grains of &c. B. Bath. 25 b הרחק דבורך מן חַרְדְּלַיי keep thy bee-hive from my mustard plants; ib. 18 a חַרְדְּלַאי (Ms. F. a. R. חרדלַי).
Gen. R. s. 98. Sabb. 63 a top יין ח' (an obscene disguise for a dark-complected woman), v. גּוּרְדְּלִי.

definition.italic: rain water rushing down a slope, torrent.

sense.notes: Eduy. V, 2; Mikv. V, 6; expl. Tosef. ib. IV, 10, v. מִדְּרוֹן. Ḥag. 19 a ח' של גשמים; Tosef. Mikv. III, 4 חַרְדֶּלֶת; a. e.
, v. חַרְדּוֹנָא
, v. חרי
, v. חֲרֵב

Targ. Hag. I, 4; 9 (Levita חריב). Targ. Ps. LX, 11 (ed. Wil. חֲ', Ms. חריבא). Targ. Ez. XXVI, 19 חרו' ed. Lag. (ed. Ven. I חֲרֵבָא, ed. Wil. חָרְבָא).— Pl. fem. חֲרֵיבָן, חֲרֵבָ', חָרְבָתָא. Targ. Ez. XXXVI, 38. Ib. 35. Targ. Is. LXI, 4; a. e.

B. Bath. IV, 8 ח' שאינו מורכב a carob-tree which has not yet been ingrafted (bears no fruit). B. Mets. 59 b; a. fr.— Pl. חֲרוּבִים, חֲרוּבִין. R. Hash. 15 b. B. Bath. 70 a. Lev. R. s. 35, a. e. (play on חרב תאכלו, Is. I, 20) ח' תֹּאכְלוּ (some ed. וחרבין, corr. acc.) ye shall eat carobs (live in poverty); a. fr.

sense.definition: a variety of beans, the pods of which resemble the carob, v. חֲרוּבָא.
sense.notes: Kil. I, 2.
, in Northern Palestine. Y. Shebi. VI, 36 c; Tosef. ib. IV, 11 (v. Hildesh. Beitr. p. 37).

sense.definition: כפר ח' K’far ( Village of) Ḥ.
sense.notes: Y. Dem. II, 22 d top, כפר וח' (corr. acc.); v. חֲרוּבָא II.

Lev. R. s. 35 צריכין ישראל לח' וכ' Israel needs carob (poverty) to do repentance; Yalk. Is. 256; Lev. R. s. 13 (not לחיר'). Y. Kil. I, 27 a (expl. חרוב Mish. ib. I, 2) כמין פול מצרי (פרסי) הוא … דמיין לח' it is a variety of the Egyptian (Persian?) bean, and its pods look like those of the carob. Y. Succ. III, 53 d top.

sense.definition: K’far Ḥ ãruba, on the lake of Genezareth (v. Hildesh. Beitr. p. 37).
sense.notes: Y. Taan. IV, 69 a כ' חריבה; Lam. R. to II, 2 (ed. Wil. חרוכא, corr. acc.); Yalk. Deut. 946 כפר חנניא.
, v. next wds.

Num. R. s. 9 (p. 232 b ed. Amst.); Midr. Sam. ch. XIII כח' גדולה היה Absalom was as tall as a large carob-tree; ib. ch. XXVII; Y. Sot I, 17 b top (not … בות). Pesik. R. s. 4 פערה הח' וכ' the carob tree opened itself and swallowed him (Isaiah).
Y. Sot. I, 17 b top (not חרובו'); Num. R. s. 9; a. e.
, Treat. S’maḥ. ch. IX, end, read: רָדִיד.
, Targ. Y. II, Deut. XVIII, 10, v. חָרוֹרָא
, v. חֲרוּתָא a. חָרֵי.

sense.definition: (חֲרַז) a stringer of pearls; trnsf. one who combines verses from various Biblical books for homiletical purposes.
sense.notes: Cant. R. to I, 10, v. קָדוֹחָא.
, v. חַרְזָא
, v. חֲדוּיִין

Bets. 32 b ואזדהר מח' but guard against its becoming charred (by touching a solid object in the oven). Pes. 41 a דשוייה ח' Ms. M. (ed. דשויא) he made (the Passover lamb) charred meat (instead of roast). Zeb. 106 a; Yoma 68 b דשויא ח' if it has been reduced to lumps of charred flesh (instead of being burnt to ashes), v. נָתַךְ.—B. Mets. 85 a they surnamed R. Zeira ח' קטיו שקיה Ms. M. (ed. קטין חֲרִיךְ ש') the burnt one with dwarfed legs: Snh. 37 a חֲרִיכָא (early prints חרו'); (Ber. 46 a קטינא חריך שקי).—[Lam. R. to II, 2 כפר חרוכא, some ed., v. חֲרוּבָא II.]

sense.definition:
חרל to sting, burn,
cmp. חרר) thorn, nettle.
sense.notes: — Pl. חֲרוּלִים, constr. חֲרוּלֵי. Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXX; Yalk. Gen. 95.
, v. חָרַם
, v. חֵירוּם

Gen. R. s. 70 (play on מחרן, Gen. XXIX, 4) מחֲרוֹנוֹ של וכ' we flee from the anger of the Lord; Yalk. ib. 123. Zeb. 102 a כל חרון אף וכ' wherever in the Scriptures the expression ‘anger of the Lord’ is used, there remains a lasting mark of it; Yalk. Ex. 173.

sense.definition: (חרס; cmp. הַרְסָנָא) a pap made of fruits and spices with wine or vinegar, used for sweetening the bitter herb on the Passover night.
sense.notes: Pes. X, 3. Ib. 116 a (play on חֶרֶס I) ח' זכר לטיט, v. זֵכֶר. Tosef. ib. X, 9; a. e.
, v. חֵיר'
— Pl. חָרוֹפוֹת. Shebi. V, 4 בח' של עץ Ms. M. (ed. במַאֲרוֹפוֹת) with wooden rakes.

Kidd. 6 a האומר חֲרוּפָתִי וכ' if one says to a woman, Be my ḥ ãrufah, she is betrothed, for in Judæa they call the betrothed (אֲרוּסָה) ḥ ãrufah.—Esp. שפחה ח' (v. Lev. XIX, 20) a handmaid designated to become the wife of one selected by her master. Gitt. 43 a איזוהי שפחה ח' (Ker. II, 5 only שפחה) what is the legal condition meant in the law concerning the designated handmaid?—Tosef. Ker. I, 19 אשם ש' ח' the sacrifice due for sleeping with an engaged handmaid. Ib. 16; a. fr.— Pl. חֲרוּפוֹת. Ker. 9 a; a. e.

sense.definition: one having an abnormal incision or cavity on his body (Lev. XXII, 22).
sense.notes: Bekh. 41 a ח' במקום עצם having the depression in a bone, ח' במקום בשר in a fleshy part. V. חָרִיץ.

sense.definition: (חור, v. חִיוַּרְוָרַיָּא; cmp. P. Sm. 1226, sq.
sense.notes: s. v. חור) dazzling the eye, deceiver.— Pl. חָרוֹרִין, constr. (חֲרוּ') חֲרוֹרֵי, with עיינין. Targ. Y. I Deut. XVIII, 10 (Y. II ed. Amst. חָרוֹדֵי, corr. acc.); ib. 14 (h. text מְעֹנֵן, derived fr. עוּן, v. Snh. 65 b quot. s. v. זְכוּרוּ). [Targ. Y. Lev. XIX, 26 ולא אחורי סנהדרין עיינין, read: ולא חרורי עיינין, the word סנהדרין being a glossator’s reference to Snh. l. c.]
, Yoma 68 b Ar. ed. Koh., v. הֲדוּרָא

sense.definition: (חוֹר II) one belonging to the class, having the status, of freedmen.
sense.notes: Kidd. IV, 1.

sense.definition: (v. preced.) claims of liberation from slavery.
sense.notes: Gitt. 86 a (in a formula of sale of a slave) ופטיר ועטיר מן ח' וכ' and is free and guarded from any claims of liberation.
Pes. 110 a bot. נשי דח' Ms. M. (ed. v. חַרְשִׁי) women practicing witchcraft.
, v. חֵירוּת

sense.definition: (חרת, sec. r. of חרה, v. חֶרְיָה) dried up by heat, shrunk.
sense.notes: Succ. 32 a top ח' פסול if the palm-branch is dried up, it is unfit for use; דומה לח' if it only looks as if dried up (blackish) &c.— Fem. חֲרוּתָה. Ḥull III, 2 ח' בידי שמים if the animal’s lungs are shrunk (wood-like) through an accident; ib. 55 b ח' בידי אדם by violence done to it. Tosef. ib. III, 12 אי זוהי ח' וכ' what animal is called ḥ ãrutha?—Answ. whose lungs are shrunk.
[Y. B. Bath. IV, 14 c bot. חרותין, v. דּוּת.]
, v. חֶרֶת

sense.definition: (preced.) = h. חֶרְיָה, a dried-up twig, hardened palm-twig, opp. כפות flexible.
sense.notes: Succ. 32 a. B. Bath. 161 b; Gitt. 36, a. e. צייר ח' drew a palm-twig (as his signature). [Targ. Is. LX, 21 דחרותי ed. Ven., read: דחדותי, v. חֶדְוָא.]— Pl. חֶרְוָתָא, חֶרְוָו'. B. Bath. 101 b דעביד להו כי ח' he makes the burial caves like palm-twigs (in the shape of a fan). Pes. 82 a קני ותרוותא Ms. M. 2 (Ms. M. 1 קני דחרות', corr. וח', ed. וחריואתא, read: וחֶרְוָואתָא; Ar. חֶרְיָתָא, fr. חֶרְיָא) reeds and twigs. Y. Shebi. II, 33 d bot. בכנישתא חדתא וחֶרְוָותָה (read: דח') with a new broom of palm-twigs.
, v. חֵיר'
Nidd. 20 a, v. חֶרֶת. [Kidd. 81 b אנא ח', v. חַדְוְתָא.]

sense.definition: (b. h.) [ to bore holes, to carry thread through a hole,]

sense.notes: Cant. R. to I, 10 (ref. to בחרוזים ib.) שחוֹרְזִים צואריהם וכ' (not שחוזרין) who squeeze their necks (through window holes, open doors &c.) to hear the words of the Law (v. Yoma 35 b; Ber. 6 b; v. דּוּחֲקָא); Yalk. ib. 983 שהם חוזרים אחרי וכ' (read: חוֹרְזִים אחוֹרֵי).

Ex. R. s. 20 ישב וח' וכ' he sat down and strung (assorting) the larger pearls separately &c.—Part. pass. חָרוּז, pl. חֲרוּזִים, חֲרוּזִין. Cant. R. l. c. [read:] אלו ע' זקנים שהיו חֲרוּזִים אחריהם כליניא וכ' (v. Yalk. l. c.) those are the seventy elders who were strung (arranged) behind them (Moses and Aaron) like a string of pearls.—Ḥull. 95 b בחרוזין (Ar. חֲרִיזִים, noun) if the pieces of meat are strung together. Lam. R. to V, 13 ג' מאות … ח' וכ' three hundred children were found strung up on the branches of one tree.—Trnsf. to draw parallels between Biblical passages, to explain one passage by another. Cant. R. l. c. הייתי יושב וחוֹרֵז וכ' I was sitting and comparing verses of the Pentateuch, and Pentateuch with Prophets &c.—Ib. שהיו חוֹרְזִים וכ'; Yalk. l. c. חוזרים (corr. acc.). Cant. R. l. c. שהן חֲרוּזוֹת וכ' which are strung together (illustrate one another).
same. Lev. R. s. 16 מַחֲרִיז ד"ת וכ' I was comparing &c.
Yeb. 75 b top חַרְזֵיה סילוא וכ' a thorn wounded him &c. Ab. Zar. 28 b זיבורא ודחרזיה וכ' he who suffers from the sting of a wasp, or of a thorn.

sense.definition: to string beads; trnsf. to compare verses (v. preced.).
sense.notes: Cant. R. to I, 10 אית דידע למֶיחֲרוֹז וכ' some know how to string but not how to bore pearls, i.e. some know how to bring on parallels without having the ability to enter into the depth of a subject.

sense.definition: to cause to sting, to prickle.
sense.notes: Gitt. 84 a מַחֲרֵיז Ar., v. בְּרַז.
, v. חִירְזָא

B. Kam. 80 a (expl. חולדת הסנאים) שרצא הוצא וא"ד ח' דקטיני וכ' Ms. M. (ed. שרצא חרצא; for oth. var. v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 20; marginal vers. שרצא חרצא וא"ד חרצא) a creeping animal (which is) prickly, and some use the word ḥ arza (spiny), with tiny legs. But why ‘creeping’?—Because its legs are low. V. חַרְצָא.—Fem. חַרְזִיתָא, pl. חַרְזְיָיתָא. Erub. 26 b אצוותא ח' Ms. M. (ed. חֲרוּזְיָאחָא, חֲרוּזְיָת'), v. אַצְוָוא.
, v. הַרְזֵק

sense.definition: , Pa. חָרֵחַ (= h. חִרְחֵר) to inflame.
sense.notes: Targ. Prov. XXVI, 21 מְחָרֵח Ms. (ed. Lag. מחרחר, oth. ed. מחרחי, corr. acc.; ed. Wil. מְחַרֵה, fr. חֲרַהּ).

sense.definition: (a comp. of חרח = חרחר, to bore, sting, v. חֲרַר II, a. בּוּן, v. בִּינָא III, בִּינְתָא II) a hair-like creeper, creeper on palm-trees (cmp. חַרְגִּינִּין, הַרְדֹּופַנִּין).
sense.notes: Tosef. Shebi. V, 3 הרחבינה ed. Zuck. (Var. החרח'). Pes. II, 6, expl. ib. 39 a, v. אַצְוָוא.— Pl. חַרְחֲבִינִין. Ib. בחרחלין ובח' ed. (Ms. M. 1 ובחרחבנין; Ms. M. 2 ובחרבנין), v. חִרְחַלִּין. Ib. ובחַרְבִּינִין ובחרגינין וכ' ed. (Ms. M. ובחרחבינה, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 200) with palm-ivy, garden-ivy and wall-ivy.

sense.definition: (reduplic. of חור, v. חָרַר I) [ point of a lance, v. Maim. to Kel. XIII, 3 ed. Dehr.
sense.notes: ,] the coulter, inserted into the horizontal pole (מַרְדֵּעַ) in front of the ploughshare (דָּרְבָן). Kel. XIII, 3. Ib. XXV, 2, v. תָּוֶךְ. Tosef. ib. B. Mets. III, 7. Tosef. ib. B. Bath. III, 5.

sense.definition: (חִרְחֵר) burnt part of a loaf, burnt crust.
sense.notes: Teb. Yom I, 3, sq. Cmp. חֲרוֹכָא.
. Targ. O. Deut. XXVIII, 22.
Pl. constr. חַרְחוּרֵי. Targ. Y. Deut. l. c. ח' דלוחי (some ed. ה') the frightful fantasies of &c.

sense.definition: (redupl. of חרל, v. חָרוּל) a prickly plant, thistle, (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Carduus).
sense.notes: Pes. 39 a בח' ובחרחבינין וכ' (you may use for bitter herb) thistles, palm-ivy &c.

sense.definition: (onompatop.) ḥ ar ḥ ar, a word in an incantation for choking.
sense.notes: Sabb. 67 a ח' נחית בלע Ar. (ed. חד חד, Ms. O. both versions combined, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90) ḥ ., go down swallowed thing.

sense.definition: to set twigs on fire for driving out the bees.
sense.notes: Ukts. III, 11 משיְחַרְחֵר from the moment he smokes the bees out; [Maim.: he heats the honey-comb; Var. in Ar.: משיְהַרְהֵר].
Cant. R. to VIII, 13 ולא תְחַרְתֲרוּ זה עם זה do not quarrel with one another.
Lev. R. s. 17, v. הִרְהֵר. [Y. Kidd. I, 58 c top מחרחרין מוזהרין, a cacography of מוזהרין; in ed. Amst. only מוזהרין.]
ch., v. חֲרר III
Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 14 below the Israelites were sitting חוֹרְטִין את העגל וכ' chiselling the calf …, and above the Lord engraving the tablets.

Pirké d’R. El. ch. III אם איני מַחֲרִיט … יסודותיו וכ' unless he models … its foundations and its entrances and exits, he does not begin to build. Ib. הקב"ה ה' לפניו וכ' the Lord modelled before Him the world, but it would not stand.

sense.definition: [ to scratch one’s self,] to regret, feel sorry.
sense.notes: Ḥag. 5 a ומִתְחָרֵט בו and feels sorry for it. Nidd. 31 b מִתְחָרֶטֶת she regrets (her vow of abstinence); a. fr. V. חֲרָטָה.
Targ. Cant. V, 4 למֶחְרַט to repent.—Pes. 113 a ותֶחְרַט, v. זְבַן.

sense.definition: (preced. wds.) regret, esp. the expression, before a court, of regret for a vow made under misapprehension.
sense.notes: Nidd. 31 b ובח' תליא מילתא and the case is dependent on a formal declaration (and decision by a court). Ned. 8 b שליח לחֲרָטַת אשתו a deputy to declare his wife’s regret (and procure absolution). Ib. 77 b פותחין בח' the court begins with suggesting reasons for regret; a. e.

sense.definition: pl. חַרְטֻמִּים; חרט; prob. an adapt.
sense.notes: of the Egyptian ḥ er-tum) charmer, magician.— Pl. חַרְטוּמִּים. Ex. R. s. 10. Num. R. s. 18 כל חַרְטוּמֵּי העולם all the magicians of the world; a. fr.—Tanḥ. Sh’moth. 11 חַרְטוּמִּין (חַרְטֻמִּין, sub. מעשי) deceptions

sense.definition: (חטם, with ר inserted) = חוֹטָם, nose, beak.
sense.notes: Toh. I, 2. Sifra Aḥãré, Par. 8, ch. XII פרט לח' וכ' except the beak, the nails, feathers &c. [Tam. IV, 3 Ar. (ed. חוטמו) the nostrils.]

sense.definition: , esp. (v. חוֹטָם 4) the knotted straps of the shoe.
sense.notes: Lam. R. to I, 1 רבתי (חד מאת' 8) איפסיק ח' דסנדליה Ar. (ed. חד סנד') the straps of his sandal were broken.
, v. חֲרָרָה

sense.definition: (b. h.) to be hot, to glow.
sense.notes: Yalk. Sam. 158 ח' אפו וכ' His anger is enkindled &c., v. אַפִּילוֹן.
Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 8 מְחָרֶה אפו He stirs up His anger.

Targ. Ps. LVII, 5 חָרְיָא Lev. (ed. Lag. חָיְירָא, oth. ed. חָיְרָא fr. חוּר; Ms. דָּיְירָא, v. דּוּר ch.; ed. Wil. חדיא, corr. acc.). [Targ. Prov. XVII, 24 חַרְיָן, quot. in Luzz. Philox. p. 106, glowing (with wisdom).]—[Gitt. 69 a וליחרו לכלבא, v. נְחַר.]
Ab. Zar. 38 b ואתא ישראל וחרי חרורי Ar. (prob. חָרוּיֵי; ed. וחתה בה חתויי) and raked the fire. Ḥag. 5 a top ומְחַרְיָא תנורא and raked the fire in the oven (Rashi: out of the oven).

Taan. 9 b חריא דעיזי excrements of goats (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 7). Pes. 110 a bot. ח' חמימי וכ' hot excrements in broken baskets (words in an incantation). Gitt. 70 a קורטמי דחרי Ar. (ed. דחחי) carthamus growing in dunged fields.
, v. חֲרוּתָא
, v. חָרֵב a. חָרוֹב.
, v. חֲרַד
, Targ. Y. Ex. XII, 39 some ed., v. חֲרָרָא

sense.definition: dried branches, twigs used for fuel.
sense.notes: Succ. IV, 6, v. חִיבּוּט. Y. Sabb. III, beg. 5 c שיורי ח' remnants of twigs (in the stove); a. fr.
Meg. 25 b ח' דביונים ed. (expl. in Ar. a. Rashi Ms. חָרֵי יוֹנִים excrements of doves?) for ḥ eryonim they substituted &c., v. דִּבְיוֹנִים.
, v. חֶרְיָנ'
v. חֲרַךְ
, v. חֲרוֹכָא
= אַחֲרִינָא. Y. Ter. II, 41 c top, v. חוֹרָן
Targ. Prov. XXX, 33 (ed. Wil. חַרְ'). Ib. XXI, 24 (ed. Wil. חדי', corr. acc.). Ib. XXII, 8.
Targ. Prov. X, 24 (h. text מגורה, v. גָּרַר).
, v. חַרְסִית

sense.definition: (Syr. חריע yellowish, cmp. b. h. חרוץ gold; cmp. חרה) Bastard safron (Carthamus tinctorius, cmp. κνῆκος a. κνηκός).
sense.notes: Kil. II, 8. Tosef. Maas. Sh. I, 13 (Chald. form) בנת חריעא ed. Zuck. (Var. בנות ח') the seeds of &c.; חלות ח' lozenges made of &c. (v. Löw Pfl. p. 218). Y. Kil. II, 28 a (expl. מוריקא); a. fr.
Ḥull. 110 b חֲרִיפַת טובא thou art quick of perception.

Targ. Ps. LII, 4. Targ. Is. VII, 20; a. fr.—Hor. 14 a ח' ומקשה is acute and inclined to raise questions. Nidd. 45 b דח' טפי that she is very bright (for her age). B. Bath. 111 b, a. e. סכינא ח' דמפסקא וכ' a sharp knife which cuts verses apart (interpreting without regard to syntax). Ḥull. 77 a דח' סכיניה whose knife is sharp (who reasons well); Yeb. 122 a דחריף סכינא. Meg. 7 a, a. e. (prov.) טבא חדא פילפלתא ח' וכ' one grain of pepper is worth more than a basketful of pumpkins, i.e. a reasoning mind is worth more than learning. Ned. 31 b top זבינא ח' goods which sell quickly, v. מִיצְעָא; a. fr.— Pl. חֲרִיפִין, חֲרִיפֵי. Targ. Josh. V, 2. Targ. Hab. I, 8.—Ber. 59 b האי דח' בני וכ' the reason that the men of Maḥuza are acute. Kidd. 39 a, a. e. ח' דפומבדיתא the ingenious students of Pumb’ditha (Efa and Abimi); a. e.
B. Mets. 44 a sq. כספא דח' silver coin which is current, is considered coin, gold being less current is considered a produce.— Pl. חֲרִיפֵי. Ib. ח' טפי וכ' are easier passed than &c.
Targ. Y. Gen. XXV, 15 (h. text חֲדַד).
. Targ. Job XXIX, 4.

sense.definition: rapid current, water-course in the river.
sense.notes: Keth. 85 a מח' דנהרא from the current of the river (not near the shore); Kidd. 73 b חֲרִיפְתָּא.
, v. preced., a. חָרִיף.

Kil. V, 3. Ib. II, 8. Meg. 14 a top.—Sabb. 22 a לעשות ח' to make a rut in the floor; Y. ib. III, 6 a top; Y. Bets. II, end, 61 d חֶרֶץ.—Ḥull. 55 b top מקום ח' (Ar. חרץ) at the indentation in the kidneys. Men. 34 b אם אין חֲרִיצָן ניכר (Ar. חַרְצָן; Ms. M. חוט, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) if the grooves marking the partitions in the T’fillin are not distinguishable; a. fr.— Pl. חָרִיצִים, חָרִיצִין. B. Kam. V, 5; a. fr.
Bekh. VI, 2 (38 a) ח' של עין Ar. (Mish. רִיס, Talm. ed. הרִיס). Gitt. 56 a בח' של עין Ar. (ed. בדוֹקִין).

sense.definition: an abnormal depression or cavity in the body.
sense.notes: Bekh. 41 a bot. ח' במקום בשר, v. חָרוּץ.
— Pl. חֲרִיצִין, constr. חֲרִיצֵי. Targ. Job XXXVIII, 25. Targ. Josh. XI, 8 ח' ימא Kimḥi (ed. חַרְצֵי) channels for the manufacture of salt (h. text משדפות).

sense.definition: (preced. wds.) pressing into a channel; חֲרִיצַת לשון putting the tongue between the lips, effort in speaking.
sense.notes: Midr. Till. to Ps. LXII, beg. (cmp. Ex. XI, 7). [Gen. R. s. 70 ואינון בחריצה, some ed., read בחַרְצֵיה.]
, Targ. Prov. X, 24 some ed., read: חֶרְיָינוּתָא. [Targ. I Kings III, 6 ובחריצות, read with best editions: ובתְרִיצוּת.]

sense.definition: (הֲ' Ar.) m. (חֲרַק) gap; בַּחֲרִיק־ in the gap caused by the absence of, in the place of.
sense.notes: Keth. 61 a עיילית לך איתתא בַחֲרִיקָאִי I brought thee a wife in my place (a hand-maid for domestic labors otherwise resting on the wife). Ib. 105 a הבו לי … בחריקאי get me a man to irrigate my fields in my stead. Yoma 77 a (in a passage omitted in later eds.) בחֲרִיקֵיה (Ms. M. בהֲרִיקִי) in his (my) place. Arakh. 27 b bot. בחֲרִיקָין in our stead.
m., (חֲרִירָה f.), v. חוֹר I
v. חֲרַר
, v. חֲרָרָא
, v. חֲרַשׁ
. Mekh. Vayakhel (ref. to Ex. XXXIV, 2
שבות מח' וכ' cease from ploughing &c. R. Hash. 9 a ח' של ערב וכ' a ploughing at the eve of the Sabbatical year (in the sixth year) which enters into (effects the growth of) the Sabbatical year; a. e.

Sabb. 70 a. Ex. R. s. 6; Koh. R. to VII, 7, a. e. בחֲרִישַׁת הקבר concerning a grave which has been ploughed over; a. fr.—Trnsf. sexual connection.— Pl. חֲרִישׁוֹת. Y. Yeb. I. beg. 2 b. Gen. R. s. 98.
. Sifré Num. 153 sq. (with ref. to Num. XXX, 5; 8; 1
—2) (חָרַשׁ II Pi.) making deaf, deafening. B. Kam. 86 a לפי שא"א לח' וכ' (Ms. M. להַחֲרִישׁ) because it is not possible to cause deafness without afflicting a wound, a drop of blood &c.; ib. 98 a

sense.definition: (v. חוֹרֶשׁ) thicket, only in חֲרִישַׁת קנים a thicket of reeds.
sense.notes: Gen. R. s. 12, beg.; Koh. R. to II, 12; (Cant. R. to I, 1 חורשא של וכ'); v. חִישָׁה.
Sifra K’dosh. Par. 4, ch. IX שכן חֲרִישׁוּתוֹ גרמה לו where his deafness may be the reason why we must not curse him; Snh. 66 a חֲרִישָׁתוֹ.
Targ. Y. Gen XXII, 13.
part. pass. of חֲרַת.
, v. חֲרוּתָא

sense.definition: to char, burn bread so as to make it uneatable; to prepare a wick by charring.
sense.notes: Pes. 21 b חֵירְכוֹ קודם וכ' he charred the leavened bread before the time appointed for the removal of leavened matter. Y. Sabb. II, 5 a top מְחָרְכִין (לין) לן they char them (the wicks).—Part. pass. מְחוֹרָךְ, fem. מְחוֹרֶכֶת, pl. מְחוֹרָכִין, מְחוֹרָכוֹת. Tosef. Sabb. II, 1 (v. Var. ed. Zuck.); Sabb. 29 a (v. Tosaf. a. l.).

Tanḥ. Noah 13 נ' שער וכ' the hair of his head and beard was singed. Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXXIII נִתְחָרְכוּ וכ' (not ב) his hair was singed. Y. Sabb. XVI, 15 c הדורשה מִתְחָרֵךְ he who preaches it (the Agadah) will burn himself (at the fire of the Law); (Treat. Sof’rim XVI, 2 מתברך, corr. acc.)
Targ. Job XXX, 30 (h. text חרה). Targ. Jer. VI, 29 חֲרֵיךְ. Targ. Is. IX, 18 חֲרוֹכַת (ed. Lag. חרובת).
Pes. 40 a לא לִיחֲרוֹךְ וכ' one must not roast two ears &c.—Part. pass. חֲרִיךְ. B. Mets. 85 a; Ber. 46 a, a. e., v. חֲרוֹכָא.

sense.definition: to burn, singe the hair off.
sense.notes: Kidd. 41 a מְחָרֵיךְ רישא he himself singed the hair off the animal’s head (in preparing for the Sabbath). Ab. Zar. 38 a

sense.definition: to be burnt &c. Targ. Y. Gen. XXI, 15 אתח' he was parched (with fever).
sense.notes: Targ. Y. Ex. XII, 37.—B. Mets. 85 a אִיחַרְכוּ שקיה (Ar. חרכו) his legs were burnt. B. Bath. 74 a אִיחֲרַךְ אִיחֲרוּכֵי Ms. M. 2 (ed. … הוה איח', v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) it (the wool) was singed. Nidd. 28 a איחרך אִיחֲרוּכֵי Rashi (ed. איחרכי, corr. acc.) it (the corpse) was charred (not burnt to ashes).

sense.definition: [ burn, v. preced.] ḥ erekh, a verbal substitute or ḥ erem (חֵרֶם), v. כִּינּוּי.
sense.notes: Ned. I, 2.— Pl. חֲרָכִים, v. חֲרָכַיָּיא.

entry.language-reference: חֲרַכִּים; חרך, cmp. חרק a. חרם)

sense.notes: Pesik. Haḥod., p. 49 b כשם … בין חלון לח' as there is a difference between (the light as it comes through) an open window and a latticed window, so &c.; Num. R. s. 11; Pesik. R. s. 15; Yalk. Cant. 986 בין חלון לחלון (corr. acc.).— Pl. חֲרַכִּים, חֲרַכִּין,. Gen. R. s. 98.
Pes. 116 a; [oth. opin. vendors sitting behind lattices, v. preced.—Var. הָדֵךְ, v. דּוּךְ, pounded spices].
Targ. Y. Ex. XXII, 1 (h. text מחתרת).
Targ. I Chr. XV, 29; Targ. II Sam. VI, 16 (h. text חלון); a. e.— Pl. חֲרַכִּין, חֲרַכַּיָּא. Targ. Y. Gen. VIII, 2. Targ. Cant. II, 9; a. e.

sense.definition: (חֲרַךְ) [ burnings,] hãrakhaya, a verbal substitute of חֵרֶךְ, q. v. Ned. 10 b, Rashi (ed. חֲרָכִים) v. חֲרָקַיָּיא.
(b. h.) [ to perforate, break through (cmp. Arab. ḫ aram, a. חֲרָךְ I),]

sense.notes: Men. 37 a top ר' יוסי החוֹרֵם R. J. the net-maker (or fisher); [Rashi, reading החָרוּם, (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l., note 100), v. infra].

Part. pass. חָרוּם (b. h. חָרֻם) one whose nose is so flattened as to show its holes, flat-nosed. Bekh. VII, 3 איזהו ח' הכוחל וכ' a ḥ arum is he who can paint both of his eyes with one movement. Ib. 43 b ח' שחוטמו שקוע ḥ. is one whose nose is sunk.

sense.definition: to cut off, to set outside (cmp. Arab. ḥ aram), v. infra, a. חֵרֶם.
to burn, cmp. חָרַךְ, חָרֵב; v. חוּרְמַן.
(denom. of חֵרֶם) [ to set outside, apart,]
to dedicate for priestly or sacred use (Lev. XXVII, 28, sq.); to renounce private use.
sense.notes: Arakh. VIII, 4 מַחֲרִים אדם וכ' a man may renounce a portion of his sheep &c.; ואם ה' את כולם אינן מוּחֲרָמִין but if he renounces all of them, they are not dedicated (his vow is invalid). Ib. מה אם לגבוה להַחֲרִים וכ' since man is not permitted to renounce all his property even for a sacred purpose &c. Ib. 7 מח' אדם את קדשיו וכ' one may declare ḥ erem one’s own designated offerings (in which case he has to pay their value to the priest or the sanctuary); a. v. fr.—Part. pass. מוּחֳרָם, pl. מוּחֳרָמִין, מוּחֳרָמִים. Ib. 4, sq., v. supra; a. fr.

sense.definition: to excommunicate, to pronounce the higher ban (which includes the withdrawal of protection of property).
sense.notes: M. Kat. 16 a מנדין … ומַחֲרִימִין וכ' the smaller ban is pronounced (over one disregarding a legal summons) at once …, the great ban after sixty days.
Part. pass. חֲרִים, חָרִים flat-nosed, v. preced. Targ. O. Lev. XXI, 18.

Targ. Josh. VI, 18 תְחַרְמוּן (Var. תַחַרְ', read: תַחְרְ'). Targ. I Sam. XV, 21 די חַרְמוּן (ed. Lag. a. oth. דיַחְרְמוּן).—Targ. O. Lev. XXVII, 28.—Arakh. 28 a כל דאית ליה לא לַחְרֵים … ליחַרְמֵיה כוליה one must not renounce (for sacred purposes) all his property, but of one kind he may renounce all he has.

M. Kat. 16 a מנלן דמַחְרְמִינָן (or דמְחַרְמִי') whence is it proven that we (the court) have a right to excommunicate a recreant person?—Y. ib. III, 81 d top אילולא דלא חַרְמִית … מְחַרֵם וכ' were it not that I never in my life excommunicated a person, I should have excommunicated that man; a. e.—Part. pass. מְחַרַם, pl. מְחַרְמִין. Ib. bot. ייא ההוא גברא מ' this man (thou) be excommunicated. Ib. ליהוון ההיא עמא מח' those people (you) be excommunicated.

sense.definition: to he declared חֵרֶם, to be dedicated.
sense.notes: Targ. O. Lev. XXVII, 29 דיִתְחֲ' ed. Berl. (oth. דיִתַּחֲ').
Kel. XXIII, 5; XXVIII, 9, v. זֶוֶט; a. fr.—Ned. II, 5, v. infra.

sense.definition: a place adapted for catching fish in nets, fishing coast, fishery.
sense.notes: B. Kam. 81 b מלא חבל ח' בדרומה a rope’s length (district) of fishing coast south of it (the Lake of Tiberias); Tosef. ib. VIII, 18 Var. ed. Zuck.—Erub. 47 b ח' שבין וכ' a fishpond between two territories.

sense.definition: [ cut off, excluded, cmp. חוּלִּין, הֶפְקֵר,] ḥ erem, property set apart for priest’s or Temple use; doomed to destruction.
sense.notes: Ned. II, 4 אם כח' של שמים if (he said, This shall be to me) like the ḥ erem consecrated to the Temple, opp. ח' של כהנים assigned to the private use of priests. Ib. 5 נדר בח' … בחֶרְמוֹ של ים if he made a vow of abstinence using the word ḥ erem, and he says, I meant the ḥ erem of the sea (fisher’s net). Ib. I, 2 כינויין לח' verbal substitutes for ḥ erem (effecting prohibition); a. fr.

M. Kat. 17 a.— Pl. חֲרָמִים, חֲרָמִין. Snh. 43 b מעל עכן בג' ח' Akhan committed three sacrileges. Ned. II, 4 סתם ח' containing the expression ḥ erem unqualified. Ib. חַרְמֵי הכהנים the dedications as priestly property. Arakh. VIII, 6 סתם ח' לבדק הבית unqualified dedications (this be ḥ erem) go to the repair of the Temple; a. fr.—[Y. Kil. IX, 32 a top שצבעה בחרם, read: בחֶרֶת.]—V. חֵירוּם.
— Pl. חָרָמִים, חָרָמִין, constr. חָרָמֵי. Y. M. Kat. II, end, 81 b; Y. Pes. IV, 30 d top ח' טבריה the net-fishers of Tiberias.

—Tosef. Ab. Zar. VII (VIII), 6; Ab. Zar. 58 a. Tosef. B. Mets. III, 19; Y. ib. IV, end, 9 d a defective coin must not be given לתגר … ולא לח' וכ' to a travelling merchant, to a highwayman, or to an oppressor, because they will cheat &c.— Pl. as ab. Ned. III, 4; B. Kam. 113 a, v. נָדַר.
. Targ. Hab. I, 15.
= חֵרֶם 3). Targ. O. Lev. XXVII, 21 (ed. Berl. חִירְמָא).—Targ. Josh. VI, 17, sq. (ed. Lag. חיר'; some ed. חָרְ'); a. fr.
Targ. Num. XXI, 3 (ed. Berl. חוּרְמָה). Targ. O. ib. XIV, 45 (ed. Berl. חור'; Y. שֵׁצְיוּ).
, v. הַרְמִינֵי
, v. חוֹרָ'
Sabb. 110 b ח' דהיגתא וכ' (Ar. הַרְנ'; Ms. M. הרגנא), v. הֵיגְתָא.—V. הַרְנוֹגָא.
, v. חוֹר'

sense.definition: חֶרֶשׂ; חרס to be rough; to scrape)

sense.notes: כלי ח' earthen vessel. Kel. III, 1 (ed. Dehr. חרש); a. v. fr.—Ib. 4 היה בה ח' if there remained of it a (sound) piece large enough to contain &c.—Tanḥ. Sh’laḥ. 1 (ref. to חֶרֶשׁ, Josh. II, 1) קרי ביה ח' read it ḥ eres (with earthware, in the disguise of potters); Num. R. s. 16, beg. חרשׂ; a. fr.—Esp. (v. חַסְפָּא) potsherd. Y. Ned. I, 37 a top; Y. Naz. I, beg. 51 a והתני … לא חספא did not Bar K. say, ḥ eres is a substitute for ḥ erem (חֵרֶם)? now, does not this mean a sherd (which has no reference to anything forbidden either as sacred or as doomed to destruction)?; v. next w.— Pl. חֲרָסִים, חֲרָסִין. Kel. III, 4. Ib. IX, 5 (Ar. חֲרָשִׂין); a. e.—Ḥag. 13 b (expl. בזק, Ez. I, 14) כאור … מבין הח' like the flames from between the perforated earthen pieces (used in smelting gold).

sense.definition: חרס to glow; cmp. חָרָה) the sun.
sense.notes: Men. 110 a (ref. to Is. XIX, 18) מאי עיר הח' (late eds. הה', v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) what is Ir ha- Ḥ eres? קרתא דבית שמשא the city of Beth-Shemesh; מאי משמע דהאי ח' לישנא וכ' where is the evidence that ḥ eres means sun? (Answ. ref. to Job IX, 7). Y. Ned. I, 37 a top; Y. Naz. I, beg. 51 a ח' לשון גבוה הוא ḥ eres (as a substitute for חֵרֶם, v. preced.) has reference to Deity, (as we read) ‘who speaks to the sun’ (Job l. c.).

sense.definition:
cmp. preced. a.
שְׁחִין) an eruption of the skin.
sense.notes: Bekh. 41 a גרב זה הח' garab (v. גָּרָב) is the same as ḥ eres
Targ. O. Deut. XXVIII, 27 (Y. quot. in Ar. חַרְסוֹנָא, v. חִיכּוּכָא).

—Yoma 9 a; Y. ib. III, 40 d אלעזר בן ח' (or אליעזר) El b. Ḥ. a highpriest; Tosef. ib. I, 22 חרסות ed. Zuck. (Var. סום …).—Yoma 35 b R. El b. Ḥ. a rich scholar; Lam. R. to II, 2 (some ed. חַרְסָנָה) Treat. S’maḥoth ch. IX בימי ח' (prob. to be read: בן ח') in the days (of persecution) of &c.
Koh. R. to IV, 8 גביני בן ח' G. b. H., a rich heir (cmp. preced.).
, v. חֲרַס
, v. חַרְסוּם

sense.definition: (b. h.) pr. n., שער הח' Gate of Ḥ arsith, one of the Jerusalem gates.
sense.notes: Y. Erub. V, 22 c (the Eastern gate) was called שער חריסית שהוא מכוון וכ' (corr. acc.) Gate of Ḥ., because it was facing the East; v. חֶרֶס II.
Maas. Sh. V, 1 בח' must be marked off with burned clay. Ḥull VI, 7 בח'; ib. 88 a שחיקת ח' powdered burned clay. Kel. III, 7; a. fr.—[Tosef. Ter. IX, 3 חרסיות, v. חָסִית I.]
Tosef. Ter. X, 13; Tosef. Toh. V, 3; Y. Ter. XI, 48 a הריוסן (corr. acc.). [Ar. ed. Koh., s. v. הרסנא, reads הַרְסָן.]
, v. חַרְסוּם
, v. next w.

sense.definition: (חסף with ר inserted, v. חַסְפְּנִיתָא) scales.
sense.notes: Targ. Y. Lev. XI, 9, sq. Targ. Y. Deut. XIV, 9 sq.—Pesik. R. s. 14 דמיין לחַרְסְפוּתַיָּיא דנוני, v. חַסְפְּנִיתָא; Pesik. Par., p. 35 a להחרפותא דיונה (corr. acc.).

sense.definition: (next w.) [ shame,] ḥ eref, a phonetic substitute for חֵרֶם.
sense.notes: Ned. I, 2.— Pl. חֲרָפִים, v. חֲרָפַיָּיא.
—Part. pass. חָרוּף, f. חֲרוּפָה, pl. חֲרוּפוֹת. Pesik. R. s. 21 פנים ח' sharp (severe) countenance (Var. הדופות).—Trnsf. to deflour, v. infra.

sense.definition: (cmp. חלף) to change, transform; to change possession.
sense.notes: Part. pass. f. חֲרוּפָה designated for change of condition, v. חֲרוּפָה.

sense.definition: (of grist) (of grist) to be ground; trnsf. to be defloured, have intercourse.
sense.notes: Y. Kidd. I, 59 a top (expl. Lev. XIX, 20) נֶחֱרֶפֶת … בכתושה לפני איש ‘ne ḥ ĕ refeth by a man’ means crushed before a man (with ref. to Prov. XXVII, 22, v. הֲרִיפוֹת).

Kerith. 11 a (ref. to נחרפת explained by בְּעוּלָה) מאי משמע … דשנויי הוא (Rashi: דשינויא) what proof is there that ne ḥ ĕ refeth has the meaning of change from natural condition? Answ. ref. to הָרִיפוֹת (II Sam. XVII, 19) and to Prov. l. c.

sense.definition: (cmp. גָּרַף, גָּדַף) [ to scrape off,] to revile, blaspheme, shame.
sense.notes: Lev. R. s. 7, end מְחָרֶפֶת ומגדפת she (Rome) blasphemes and reviles. Num. R. s. 10 מְחָרְפָם, v. גָּדַף. Snh. 94 a, sq. שחי' ע"י וכ' who blasphemed (the Lord) through a messenger; a. fr.
Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXIV, end שמִתְחָרֵף ומתנאץ which is reviled and blasphemed. Ib. to Ps. XVIII, 1 עד שנִתְחָרַפְתִּי until I was reviled; a. e.
Tanḥ. B’resh. 12 (play on קיץ וחרף) שתהיו מתקייצין ופניכם מִתְחָרְפִין (some ed. מתחפרין) that you will feel nauseous and your faces become pale.
Targ. I Sam. XIII, 20, sq. Targ. Job XVI, 9 (not חָרִיף; h. text ילטש).—Part. pass. מְחַרַף. Targ. Jer. IX, 7 ed. Lag. (oth. ed. מְחָרֵיף, corr. acc.). Targ. Is. V, 28.
Targ. Y. Lev. XXIV, 11.; a. fr.—[Ib. 15, sq. יֶחֱרַף Pe.!]
Snh. 70 b אַחֲרִיפוּ ועולו וכ' go in early (before sunset), and leave early, that people may take notice of you. Sabb. 115 a דהוו קא מַחְרְפֵי that they did it earlier (than they were told to).
, v. חוֹרֶף

B. Bath. 90 b תרעא ח' וכ' the early market (soon after the crop) at the early market price, opp. תרעא אפלא later market.— Pl. חָרְפֵי. Targ. Koh. XI, 2 early seeds.—Taan. 3 b בח' concerning early clouds (when rain is gathering). Nidd. 65 b, v. אֲפֵילָא.— Fem. pl. חֲרָפָתָא. R. Hash. 8 a Ar. (ed. חָרְפְּיָיתָא), v. אֲפֵילָא.
Gen. R. s. 80. Sabb. 88 b, a. e. שומעין חֶרְפָּתָן וכ' hear themselves reviled and answer not.

sense.definition: (v. חֵרֶף) ḥ ãrafaya, a phonetic substitute of חֵרֶף in place of חֵרֶם.
sense.notes: Ned. 10 b, v. חֲרָקַיָּיא.
v. חֲרָפָא; cmp. חוּרְפָא.
ch. = h. חֶרְפָּה. Targ. Ps. XXII, 7 חֶרְפַּת Ms. (ed. חִיסּוּדֵי).
Targ. Y. II Deut. XIV, 18 (Y. I ערפדא).

sense.definition: to dig a cavity, to cut a trench of even width all through.
sense.notes: Y. Kil. VII, 31 b bot. חפר ח' נעץ וכ' if (on the Sabbath) one dug (a pit), made a trench, and cut a wedge-like ditch (narrow below), he is guilty of one act; Y. Sabb. VII, 9 d bot.; a. fr.

Tanḥ. B’ḥuck. 1 (ref. to Job XIV, 5) ח' ימיו וכ' He designated the duration of life of every creature.— Part. pass. חָרוּץ, f. חֲרוּצָה; pl. חֲרוּצִים, חֲרוּצוֹת a) grooved. Sabb. 98 b ח' היו הקרשים וב' the boards of the Tabernacle were grooved, and the sockets hollowed out correspondingly.—b) decreed, decided; determined. Gen. R. s. 67 (ref. to Prov. XII, 27) the blessings שמעיקר העולם חרוצות לו which were designated to him from primeval days. Ib. חרוצה ביד וכ' it is a decided fact known to the righteous that they will in this world receive none &c. Deut. R. s. 1 שידיך חדות וח' that thy hands are quick and determined.—c) flat-nosed, v. חָרוּץ.

sense.definition: to be cut into, dug, ploughed.
sense.notes: Y. Nidd. I, 49 a bot. a soil is called virgin כל שלא נ' בה מימיה when it has never been cut into; v. חֶרֶץ.

Part. pass. חָרִיץ. Gitt. 20 a רושמא מִיחֲרַץ ח' וכ' is the stamp of a coin dug into (are the devices formed with a loss of substance), or is it pressed into (by compressing the substance)?—Bekh. 41 a מיחרץ ח' (a dry scab is) cut into (deeper than the surface).

sense.definition: to be cut into, v. supra.
(preced.) incision, groove, mark of a seam.
sense.notes: Y. Nidd. I, 49 a bot. כל שאין בה ח' (a virgin soil is) such as shows no grooves. Y. Maasr. I, 48 d bot. משיתמלא הח' from the time the incision in the growing fruits begins to fill up.—Y. Bets. II, end, 61 d, a. e., v. חֲרִיץ.
B. Kam. 80 a (marginal version) שרצא ח' וא"ד ח' a digging animal, and some use only the word ḥ artsa: digger; v. חַרְזָא.

Targ. Deut. XXXIII, 11 (Y. II חֶרֶץ).—Targ. Gen. XXXVII, 34 (Y. חַרְצוֹי pl.); a. fr.— Pl. חַרְצִין, constr. חַרְצֵי. Targ. O. Ex. XXVIII, 42 (some ed. חַרְצָן their loins); Y. ib. אתר קטור חַרְצֵיהוֹן חַרְצֵיהוֹן the place of the knot of their loins (belt). Targ. Y. Gen. L. 11; a. fr.
, v. חַרְצָנִיתָא

sense.definition: , pl. חַרְצַנִּים (b. h.) a pomace of kernels or shells of grapes; v. זָג.
sense.notes: Naz. VI, 2. Ib. 35 a; a. fr.—Ib. 38 b אכל חרצן if he ate the shell (or the interior) of one berry. Ḥull. 82 b זרע חטה וח' if he sowed a wheat grain and a kernel; a. fr.—V. גּוּחַרְקָא II.
Y. Maasr. I, 48 d שתהא ח' שלהן וכ' their kernels must be seen through the berries.

Tanḥ. Vaëra 14 כהדא פרטתא דרמונא דח' מתחמיא מלגאו like the berry of a pome-granate whose stones are seen from within (shining through); Pesik. Vayhi, p. 3 b דחרצנייתא (read: דחַרְצִינִיתָא); Ex. R. s. 12 דחַרְצִינִיתֵיה; Num. R. s. 12 דחרצינתה (corr. acc.); Cant. R. to III, 11 דכל הדא פיטרתא (read: … חרצנתא); Yalk. Ex. 186 דחרצנתי (read: … תֵּיה); Yalk. Job 912 (corr. acc.).

sense.definition: (next w.) [ cleft,] ḥ erek, a phonetic substitute for ḥ erem (חֵרֶם).
sense.notes: Ned. I, 2.— Pl. חֲרָקִים, v. חֲרָקַיָּיא.

sense.definition: (b. h.) to cut a gap; to squeeze into a gap; to prick.
sense.notes: Part. pass. חָרוּק, f. חֲרוּקָה; pl. חֲרוּקִים, חֲרוּקוֹת a) having incisions, edged, serried. Ḥull. 59 b ed., v. חָדַק.—b) wedged in. Par. XII, 8 החרוקות (Var. החֲדוּקוֹת) those handles which are squeezed into holes, opp. הקדוחות bored handles; Tosef. ib. XII (XI), 17 אף הרוק וצואה וכ' (read: אף החרוקות · צואה וכ').

sense.definition: [ to set at edge,] (with שֵׁן) to gnash, grind the teeth.
sense.notes: Pesik. R. s. 37 מְחָרְקִין שיניהם ground their teeth (in sneer). Ex. R. s. 5; Tanḥ. Vaëra 6 התחיל מְחָרֵק עליהם וכ' he began to gnash his teeth against them (in rage).
Sabb. 67 a לִיחֲרוֹק ביה פורתא let him cut a little notch into it. Part. חָרֵיק. Y. Kil. IX, 32 c bot. וח' בשינוי and gnashing his teeth; Y. Keth. XII, 35 b וחרוק (corr. acc.).
same. Y. Kil. l. c. הויתא א' בשינייך thou wast gnashing thy teeth; Y. Keth. l. c. הוות א' בשינוי (corr. acc.).

. Ḥull. 59 b והוא דמיבלע חִירְקַיְיהוּ provided the edges of their horns run irregularly into one another. Sabb. 46 a דאית בה חרקי Ar. it has indentations (making the candlestick appear as if composed of movable parts), v. חדְקָא.

sense.definition: (preced.) [ incisions,] ḥ ãrakaya, a Chaldaic substitute of חֵרֶק which is itself a substitute of חֵרֶם.
sense.notes: Ned. 10 b what are the substitutes of ḥ erem? ח' חרכייא חרפייא Rashi (Ar. הר'; ed. חֲרָקִים &c., h. pl. of חֵרֶק &c.).
חֵרֵר (v. חוֹר I) to break through, to cave. Ohol. III, 7; Succ. 20 b חור שחֵרְרוּהוּ מים (or שחֲרָרוּהוּ) a cavity made by water, by animals &c.
— Part. pass. חֲרִיר discharging (v. חָרַיָּא). Targ. Y. Lev. XV, 3 חֲ' … ית וכ' (some ed. חָרֵיר part. act.) his membrum discharges &c.

חֵרֵר (denom. of חוֹר II) to set free.— Part. pass. מְחוֹרָר freed, free. Gen. R. s. 14, end (ref. to Gen. II, 7 נפש חיה) עבד מח' בפני עצמו וכ' (Var. מכודן, v. כָּדַן) a freed slave left to himself for a living.—Keth. 51 b; B. Kam. 95 a המְחוֹרָרִין (נכסים) unencumbered property. [Shaf. שִׁחֲרֵר.]
Targ. Y. Gen. XVI, 2 אַחְרְרִינָהּ I will liberate her. Ib. 3 חֲרַרְתָּהּ (not … תא). Ib. 5.
Targ. Lev. XIX, 20.

sense.definition: [ to be rough, excited,] to glow.
sense.notes: Pilp. חִרְחֵר, q. v.

sense.definition: , to burn, to be blackened, charred.
sense.notes: Targ. Ps. II, 12 יֵיחוֹר. Ib. CII, 4. Targ. Ez. XV, 4, sq. חַר; a. e.
Ab. Zar. 38 b חָרוּרֵי, v. חֲרֵי.]
Targ. II Esth. V, 1.
same. Targ. Ps. LXIX, 4.

sense.definition: (cmp. חרר I) to heap up, round.
sense.notes: Denom. חֲרָרָה, חוֹרָר.
— Pa. חָרֵיר to round, make a חֲרָרָא. Targ. Ez. IV, 12 (some ed. תַּחְרְ' Af.; h. text תעגינה).
— pl. חֲרָרִין, v. חֲרָרָה.

Targ. Jud. VII, 13 (h. text צליל). Targ. I Kings XVII, 13 (h. text עגה); a. fr.—Pesik. R. s. 18 [read:] תמן אמרין עבדין מיניה ח' לכלבא ולא טעמיה there (in Babylonia) they say, they made out of it a cake for a dog, but he would not taste it (v. Erub. 81 a); Pesik. Haomer, p. 71 b חֲרָרָה.— Pl. חֲרָרָן. Targ. Y. I Num. XI, 8. Targ. Y. Ex. XII, 39 (some ed. חֲרִירָן; חרידן, corr. acc.).
Lev. R. s. 24 ח' דדמא (ed. חרדא, חרדה, corr. acc.) a clot of blood.

sense.definition: a thick cake baked on coals.
sense.notes: Kidd. 59 a, v. הָפַךְ (v. also Rashi a. l. a. infra). Sabb. I, 10. Tosef. Ḥag. III, 12; Y. ib. III, 79 b, v. תָּחַב. B. Kam. II, 3 שנטל ח' that took a cake (with live coals sticking to it).— Pl. חֲרָרִין. Bets. II, 6 (21 b) גריצין וח' Bab. ed., v. גְּרִיצָה (Mish. ed. חוֹרִי, Y. ed. חֹרִי b. h., collect. noun: cakes); Y. ib. 61 c bot. (play on חֳרִי, Deut. XXIX, 23, a. on חֹרִי, Gen. XL, 16).

sense.definition: pile of sheaves, temporary stack in the field.
sense.notes: Peah V, 8 לח' for the purpose of temporary piling, opp. לגוֹרֶן. [Kidd. 59 a עני המהפך בח' a poor man moving about a stack (waiting for its removal to take up eventually a forgotten sheaf); cmp. Peah l. c.; oth. defin. v. הָפַךְ.]—Y. Peah V, end, 19 a, expl. ח' with גַּלְגַּל a globular heap.

sense.definition: חֲרָרַת דם a clot of blood.
sense.notes: Bekh. III, 1 (21 b). Nidd. 66 a; a. e.—Tanḥ. K’dosh. 9 כחרדת (corr. acc.)
Kel. XI, 3 he who makes vessels מן הח' of iron ore (before it is smelted).
, v. חֶרֶס
Koh. R. to I, 16 הלב חוֹרֵשׁ the heart designs.

Macc. III, 9 יש חוֹרֵשׁ תלם וכ' one may plough one bed and &c. Taan. 29 a וח' את העיר Ms. M. and passed the plough over the city of Jerusalem. Sabb. VII, 2; a. fr.—Trnsf. to have sexual intercourse. Y. Yeb. I, 2 b top. Gen. R. s. 98; a. e.
Taan. IV, 6 נֶחְרְשָׁה העיר the plough was passed over the city of Jerusalem; a. e.

חֵרֵשׁ, חֵי' (denom. of חֵרֵשׁ) to deafen, make deaf. B. Kam. 86 a שחֵירְשׁוֹ וכ' when he made him deaf without wounding him. Ib. החוֹרֵשׁ את אביו (Ms. H. a. R. חֵרֵשׁ); ib. 98 a חֵרְשׁוֹ לאביו if one injured his father’s hearing; v. חֲרִישָׁה II. Kidd. 24 b.—Sabb. 109 a top. יד מְחָרֶשֶׁת the unwashed hand put to the ear causes deafness.
B. Kam. 86 a להַחֲרִישׁ, v. חֲרִישָׁה II.
Y. Pes. IX, end. 37 a (ref. to Prov. XVII, 28) ואין צ"ל חכם מַחֲרִישׁ and it is needless to say the same of a wise man keeping silence. [Usu. שָׁתַק.]
Yeb. XIV, 1; Tosef. Ter. I, 1 פיקח ונ' if he had been well-hearing and became etc.; v. חֵרֵשׁ.
. Targ. Job VIII, 17.
Gen. R. s. 81 (prov.) מהולתך חַרְשָׁה וכ' if thy sieve is choked, knock at it (when you are forgetful of your duties, the Lord will remind you through affliction); v. טְרַשׁ II.
Ib. s. 86 באתר דחרשין חֲרִישִׁין where there are sorcerers witchcraft is practiced.
Targ. Ez. XIII, 20 (h. text צדד).
